What we appreciated was her empathy and awareness to speak translate English and Spanish, no matter how little the comment or question. Review of: From Santiago: Bahai Temple and Cousiño Macul Vineyard What a wonderful compliment to Fernanda! 😊 We're so happy to hear that her knowledge, passion, and empathy made your tour experience special. It’s great to know that she was attentive to everyone’s needs, whether in English or Spanish. We’ll be sure to share your kind words with her! Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts, and we hope to see you again soon! 🌟
title: Baha’i Temple and Wine Country

review_text: As you approach there are food markets outside with seafood to vegetables. Inside is an old village which goes bavk over 400 years and is nos dedicated to artesans who make all sorts of jewellery and other craft items. A few restaurants and the buildings are old style and interesting. Def worth seeing
title: Fascinating history

review_text: Wonderful stay, very lively Guide Chile a wonderful country we love and we make plans to return, even more Chile!!!
title: Excellent

review_text: Here is the largest open pit copper mine in the world. I always wanted to visit it. Got to go for work. An impressive mining engineering work.
title: The largest Open pit Copper mine in the world

review_text: 360 Views at 65 stories high. The entrance is inside the Shopping Center Admission is 10000 CLP or around US$15, but worth the cost. Try the sunset for added spectacle.
title: Magnificent Views and Architecture

review_text: I have visited the shopping centre briefly. Huge, modern and it has it all. Recommended for shopping lovers.
title: BIG

review_text: The views were amazing! It was a very funny, beautiful and fun ride. The guide Felipe was excellent, always with good humor and attentive! I recommend for everyone!! Review of: Private Day Trip to Cajón del Maipo & El Yeso Dam from Santiago.
title: Great ride!

review_text: Incredibly energetic guide (Christian) filled with great stories and into. It was a wonderful tour. Highly recommended! Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago Our guides and their personalities are hand picked to ensure unique experiences. Thank you for your review.
title: Amazing day trip from Santiago

review_text: I was hesitant to go on this excursion alone but it ended up being the perfect day. Gregorio was a safe driver and Rodrigo was a great guide! The time in the van was well worth it especially because we learned so much along the ride there about Chile’s history, landscapes and geology. Would definitely recommend this tour! Review of: Inca Lagoon in Andes Mountain Range - Visit Local Vineyard with Tasting included
title: Amazing excursion, even solo!

review_text: We went on a sunday afternoon to check out the house, eventhough we both have lived in Santiago for ages, we had never gone. The ticket is $5.000 CLP, which is a little pricey, but it's Pablo Neruda and it includes audio tour.... There' a little room where you can see an informative video before you start the tour. The audio tour is good, it gives out information that's interesting and the house is really fun (as all his houses are) It definitely is a good way to spend a nice quite weekend afternoon.
title: Nice sunday

review_text: The scenery is spectacular and is no doubt one of the most beautiful places on earth. I did the Circuit in about 9 days in the high tourist season. So the weather was great but the trails were jammed with people. Most of the camping sites charge a ridiculous amount to simply throw down your tent. Some of the sites looked like refugee camps with many poorly behaved tourist. This is worth doing but do not expect to have a solitary peaceful wilderness experience. The trails are well maintained and there is an abundance of overly priced resources along the way.
title: Amazing but very crowded and expensive

review_text: Atacama is simply incredible! The energy of this place is unique! I recommend Feel Atacama for tours! They were attentive, punctual and had delicious snacks! The Isis guide stood out for its friendliness, playlist and great photos!
title: Atacama lovers

review_text: An amazing trip from Punta Arenas to Ushuaia on the MV Stella Australis. Although it's billed as a 5 day cruise, you board on the evening of Day One and disembark on the morning of Day Five... so it's more like 3 full days, but the experience is completely worth it. You get to experience Patagonia and the extreme south of world up close with daily trips out on the zodiacs to glaciers, penguin colonies, Cape Horn and places of natural and historic interest. the boat has great accommodation and isn't too large (sleeps about 150 - 200 people) to feel overwhelming. We didn't see a single other boat or person the entire time we were there - it was like having the whole of the end of the world to yourself :-) Food and beverage was fine and generous and the guides were friendly and knowledgeable. If you're in Patagonia this is a 'must-do' experience!
title: Stella Australis 5 day cruise

review_text: We spent two days with Chile Private Tours and couldn't have been happier. Christian took us (two couples disembarking a cruise ship) through Valparaiso and along the adjoining coast, showing us everything from frolicking seals to the town's hip and colorful graffiti. Thomas had arranged lunch in a delightful restaurant with a terrace overlooking the ocean. The following day Thomas drove us into the Andes for a closer look at lakes and mountains outside of Santiago. We stopped to stroll through small town squares and ate empanadas at a roadside cafe. Thomas and Christian were both exceptional guides -- knowledgable, engaging, personable. The vans were large and comfortable and the drivers equally likeable. On both days, we could do whatever we wished at our own pace, but with expert guidance and advice. I would highly recommend Thomas and his company.
title: From urban graffiti to majestic Andes

review_text: Nice place to visit as a family, in July we could see a lot of flamingos and other native animals. You can go in particular but with the ticket that is purchased via web since they ask for it at the entrance! The sun is very strong so it is recommended to bring sunscreen and water!
title: Visita Laguna Chaxa

review_text: Jimmy was an awesome tour guide and gave us the experience of a lifetime, I strongly recommend anybody do this trip! If you only had one day in the area this would be the one thing you should definitely do. Absolutely incredible experience. Review of: Wild Penguins,Birds,Sandboard,Chilean Drinks & Food/From Valpo
title: Amazing tour!

review_text: Fantastic place. I got say it was even better because if was snowing, and it was the first time I saw snow, so the view was completely outstanding. It is a full-day tour, and every place you go is just awesome.
title: The best to do in San Pedro

review_text: Tour guide / driver gave no welcome, or you are going to the correct tour. Along the route we were wondering if we were on the wrong tour. Upon arrival at the winery we were told to be back to van at 18:00! Tour itself was good. But the second part (the premium part) did not start til 18:00. It was rushed as we were wondering if we would have a ride back. Luckily van was still there. The other 2 tours we took was last on, first off Or first on, last off. This tour we were last on and last off. Was he upset with us because our tour, rightfully booked and paid for, was longer than he wanted?! Review of: New Concha y Toro Tour Marques with class, extra tasting y food Thank you for your feedback, it helps us be better, we're glad you could enjoy the tour in general. Best regards, MTO Tour Team
title: Tour company was disappointing

review_text: The sandy road to reach the entrance to the lagunas was already a good experience, could do it without 4WD. Entrance was clp3000 pp what was fair, toilets included. These two lagunas were beautiful and sourrounded by mountains, but overall not the most special lagoons we saw around San Pedro. But overall worth to go there, if its included in a tour, even better.
title: Nice landscape

review_text: Parque Arauco is a very good place to visit especially for tourists. It is easy to access and there are many shops and restaurants. You can also enjoy beautiful park. If you want to travel Santiago, you can make reservation on Red bus tour in Parque Arauco.
title: Great shopping center

review_text: On our 72 days cruise around South America, the segment around the Cape Horn was one of the most sensational one. Since the cold water from the Antarctica met the warmer water from the Atlantic Ocean, the turbulence created quite some strong waves. The whole experience of cruising around the Cape Horn prepared us for our future expedition cruise to the Antarctica.
title: Great Sensation!

review_text: My husband and I did a half day ride with Antilco and really enjoyed it. You do actually get to gallop and control your own horse rather than being sat on an old nag that just plods along a well know track. It was fun and exciting and I would recommend them.
title: Half day ride

review_text: Thus was my first visit to Santiago- I was on a canceled cruise and had 5 days in Santiago- how lucky I was that my hotel recommended Turistik tours - I booked 4 tours all good but Maipo Canyon was outstanding and I am sure a big reason was that Daniel was our Tour Guide. He knows so much and his love of Chile really comes through. From the start of the tour his attention and caring for each person comes through in a very sincere way. Maipo Canyon is beautiful I highly recommend but try and get Daniel as your tour guide and I promise you will have one of the best tours ever! Review of: Tour to Valle Nevado We appreciate your comment dear traveler, it is very important for us to know about your experience.
title: Maipo Canyon Outstanding Vistas

review_text: Nice church inside, old Spanish-style building with huge pillars and beautiful Catholic artwork inside. Also very enjoyable during hot summer days, as it is fresh inside!
title: Chile's best decorated church

review_text: Had absolutely the best experience with Mawida Adventures & our guides for the trek up Volcan Villarrica. This company was recommended to me as was Rodrigo Vera by a teacher who came and lectured at my university in Villarrica so I already knew going into it they had an excellent reputation and skill set. The trip up the volcano was one of the coolest things I’ve ever done in my entire life, and also very challenging. Rodrigo did an incredible job of managing our group safely, he encouraged us, got us to the summit and down safely. We skinned up and then skied down, he picked wonderful ski lines and offered excellent advice to help make the physical challenge easier. Him and his team pay very very close attention to their group, with radio contact with all of their guides on the whole mountain. They watched every single one of us and set a pace everyone could follow. We had a mixed group of skiers and hikers and everyone came away happy and most importantly safe. This company is by far the best in terms of safety, value for money, professionalism, preparedness, and experience. We met two days prior to get fitted for gear, we were explained all of the risks involved, and when we arrived on the morning of the climb everything (gear) was laid out organized nice and nearly. This company values client safety and experience over a quick buck, I would recommend going with them for every single activity you do in Pucón. All photos taken by Rodrigo himself!
title: Volcan Villarrica / Ruka Pillan

review_text: We suppose to go on 31 of December, but for emergency situation they cannot send English speaker tour guide to the trip, they re schedule on 2nd,of January. We got an very basic English speaker on the tour but it was OK, nit to much information about culture or history but OK, the breakfast please was literally useless, all drinks landed in the bin,was very bad 😞,the spa was fantastic, but the changing room and toilet was disappointing, after the dinner place was so so okay but far to expensive what they give us as they called buffet 😞,after we stopped in a chocolate place,wasn't needed after dinner.After we went back to same place where the breakfast was they called picnic, it was just okay.So overall this trip could finish around 2pm,but they just take us to places to spend more money unnecessarily. I gave 4 stars review because of the spa experience, not because the whole day trip. Review of: Cajón del Maipo + Termas de Colina
title: Thermal was great. Buffet was okay. Picnic could have been skipped and it could have ended sooner

review_text: The tour was very good. The water in the tub was not very warm. We would like that the tour guide was not referring to other nationalities with stereotypes for example "marias" to Mexican women. Tour good, food good, beautiful landscap, Galan Amaro sisters. Review of: Cajon Del Maipo Including Wine with Picnic and Empanada
title: Cajon del Maipo and Spa

review_text: Amazing tour, Juan is an excellent driver and guide. The place needs no comments, we will definitely be back in winter
title: Embalse del Yeso Tour

review_text: Do not expect Rome and you'll be happy. This cathedral is grand in its own way, and perched at the end of a large public park. Enjoy the humble colonial grandeur.
title: Colonial Style

review_text: The baths are state-of-the-art, the facilities very nice and the place of dream. Very recommendable. In addition, Excellent cafeteria food
title: We arrived early and there were few people so we enjoyed concho. I highly recommend going

review_text: This was a full day packed with sight-seeing. From Santiago. It takes about 1 1/2 hours to get to Vina Dela Mar. You visit the Flower Clock and Moai Statue. You do not go into the Fronck Museum. Then onto Valparaíso - a few minutes down the road. There is a lot to see and photograph in Valparaíso and a short amount of time to do it. So if it seems rushed - it is. This tour is an introduction to Valparaíso come back and spend more time here - according to our tour guide. I liked the stop into the photo shop of Alberto Lagos - Hiperfocal, Lautaro Rosas 392, Carro Alegre. Alberto uses an ancient photographic process called Gum Bichromate to create one-of-a-kind art works. No one on our trip liked the lunch stop. Very over priced menu and the food disappointing. Service was slooow and too much time wasted at the restaurant. The stop at Casona Veramonte in Casablanca was basically just a bathroom stop. A sip of white and a sip of red and back on the van. I would recommend this trip but only with the understanding you may feel rushed but you see a lot. Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago
title: Rushed but Worth It

review_text: Lots of info, plan to spend 2-3 hours looking and listening to everything. Be sure to get one of the wireless translator gizmos. They're $4 and you get them at the entrance desk. Well worth it, unless your spanish is perfect.
title: Excellent historical review of the end of Chilean dictatorship.

review_text: WOW! The streets are painted! Beautiful murals everywhere on buildings, streets and staircases! Take the walk and enjoy the art! It is so worth it.
title: Fantastic Walk!

review_text: Very good tour, with historical lessons, our guide Luiz Antônio provided valuable information for our tour. Congratulations!
title: Great experience Valparaiso and Viña del Mar

review_text: I participated in a day horseback riding trip outside of Santiago and it was awesome! The family, guide, driver were amazing - friendly, helpful, communicated very well and the adventure was wonderful. This was the highlight of my trip to Chile! The region is just beautiful and the horses are amazing - very easy to handle, sure footed - a great ride! The lunch they provided on the trail was also great - fabulous, fresh, refreshing! I can't wait to return to Chile to do this again and bring others along - it was truly wonderful and I want to thank everyone with Horse Riding Chile for providing such an incredible experience. I recommend this to everyone - no need to be an experienced rider! It is a fabulous adventure. Thank you! Thank you for such a lovely review - it really helps to get reviews like this and it stimulates us to further efforts to make sure we keep earning them!
title: Awesome Trip!

review_text: We took two tours whilst in Santiago - the traditional city tour (not the hop-on hop-off bus) and a wine tour to Underraga. I would suggest you book late as we had booked early for a different wine tour and at the last minute we noticed they had removed the English option, so with the aid of our Spanish speaker we negotiated a chnage of tour. For one of the tours they forgot to arrange collection from the hotel, but realised, rang reception, and paid for a taxi to take us to the pick up point - so a good recovery. Santiago was less impressive than I had expected - lots of colonial style building which we can easily see in Europe. The wine tour was very good - an excellent tour with a wine tasting to conclude (and no pressure to buy from the shop) We appreciate your comment dear traveler, it is very important for us to know about your experience.
title: Good tours, but as ever it depends on the guide and the organisation

review_text: I don't think enough reviews have mentioned how important the Moon is for this experience (as well as a clear night). We went 6 days before the Moon was full and it felt very disappointing. Many times the guide was saying "if we had a clear night you could see this . . . and this . . ." You only get the stunning naked-eye view of the milky way, etc when there is no moon (less than 10%). Otherwise even the "observatory hotspot" of La Serena is a bit lacklustre.
title: Only worth it with no moon

review_text: In August this year, I had the pleasure of enjoying all the beautiful sights and treasures Chile has to offer. Crafted by Esteban at Private Tours Santiago and organised by Treasury Wine Estates. As a group of 35 the quality and detailing that was supplied throughout my trip was brilliant. I highly recommend you give them a try. Below are to name but a few of the quality features and services experienced on my trip. Jeanette – our tour guide was EXCELLENT and really went the extra mile to make everyone feel very welcome and pulled out all stops to find the best places to visit and where to purchase items etc. there really was no request too big or small. I found Jeanette to be very knowledgeable with perfect English and extremely easy to approach. Edwardo – Our talented bus driver was a great safe driver. Edwardo manipulated our bus through tight spots with ease and was quick to help in any way he could along with taking the group to shopping highlights ensuring we found the perfect gifts to remember our trip. From meeting us at the airport on arrival and organising our peerless accommodation at W to visiting a variety of restaurants with delicious food and an array of wineries. We learned of the enthralling heritage and history of Chile while experiencing the spectacular beauty of the snow-capped mountains and meeting the friendly faces from the many cities and towns we visited; Private Tours Santiago organised it all to perfection. Delivering us safely back and guiding us through the airport for our return flight – they hosted us perfectly. Thank You for looking after our group so well and making my trip so memorable. First of all I would like to thank you for taking the time for sharing the experience you had with PrivateTours.cl. We love to read that you enjoyed all the itineraries and activities organized together with Nicole from Treasury Wine Estates. The planification was really exhaustive (it tooked around 3 months), taking care of all the details. On the other hand, we really want to thanks to Jeanette and Edwardo, their support and proactivity definitely were a key factor to the successful development of the itineraries. Thanks once again and please do not hesitate contacting us if you visit Santiago de Chile again.
title: Incentive Trip – Highly recommended

review_text: This leading mass-market wine producer has conceived a mass-market tour for those willing to see a few wines for the first time. In fact, not much is covered about the wine process. The tour felt like a branding campaign, including a 3 minutes light show explaining the origin of their most famous brand: Casillero del Diablo. Having said this, the property is gorgeous, and well cared. The tour host was attentive and engaging, as well as informative. The wines we tasted included decent-quality brands such as Terruno, even on the basic Tour. The premium tasting was worth the extra money as it incorporated a sommelier and an individual cheese plate. We tasted 4 extra wines. The winery can be reached by a subway & bus connection from Santiago.
title: Touristified wine tour. Premium Tour worth the upgrade.

review_text: If you come to Santiago you cannot miss the Patio Bellavista, located in the Providencia Community and close to three important university campuses, which makes the place always lively and busy. Patio Bellavista will impress the visitor with shops of typical chilean products in leather, silver, lapizlazuli stone, and differents crafts. At the same time there are many fine restaurants, of different character. Some offer peruvian food, chinese, mexican, and local cuisine as well. Sometimes of the year Patio Bellavista can be really crowded, like Christmas or end of the year. It is a tourist´s delight, since you cand find there nice gifts, such as jewelry or fine arts and crafts. A great place to see!
title: Amazing place to shop and to eat

review_text: I give it five stars because I love it. This was my 4th visit and as always, it stood out. The decoration, colours, and drinks make an AWESOME combination. But to be fair I must say this is an EXPENSIVE bar in Santiago. Each drink costs at leats 11 bucks and then you have to add an extra 10% for the tip. Dear Jose, Thanks for your comments, is very important for us. However, we regret that you have had that perception about our product. Tell us when you return and we can show you our different promotions. Kind regard, Lysyen Marín Rooms Ambassador The Hip Hotel Santiago
title: Best bar in Santiago, but extremely expensive

review_text: Very good treatment from the staff, first time I have taken one in Chile and no problems, clean buses and easy to understand the route. Next summer I took one with my family. Review of: Tourist bus around Santiago for a day Hola! Muchas garcias por dejarnos tus comentarios. Nos alegra saber que disfrutaste de la experiencia y gracias por mencionar a nuestro equipo de trabajo. Saludos!
title: Excellent service from Camila Martínez

review_text: Nice view, medium hike, more for easy, takes about 40-45 minutes to go up. From the top the view is very beautiful, even though the winds are very strong. Upstairs we had the opportunity to see a condor flying very close.
title: Hike to Mirador Condor

review_text: Incredible and unforgettable experience, landscapes to cry about how beautiful Bochinche serious company full of good vibes Totally recommended!!! Review of: Rafting Azul a Macal - Futaleufu River
title: Rafting in the Futa with Bochinche

review_text: Santiago is a pretty large city and the best way to truly see how far it extends is through the sky Costanera. Easy to access as it's close to the Tobalaba Metro Station. The cost for an adult to go up is 10,000 pesos, which I think is pretty ok considering other similar buildings around the world are more expensive. The view at the top is wonderful, you see the Andes Mountains just getting off the elevator. Binoculars are FREE and there is FREE Wifi too, no password needed. Try the top floor as well as you can get out and catch some wind.
title: Probably the best way to see the city of Santiago

review_text: Very nice tour with the super nice Fabian! Not only the driver but also the guide, the fotographer and the chef for the aperitif with Pisco Sour at the Sunset! We took a bath in the floating and salty waters of laguna piedritas, a funny experience!
title: Nice tour, recommended!

review_text: In Pucón, everyone is raving about the volcano, overshadowing other worthwhile attractions. It is, indeed, a spectacular sight, especially from afar. But I was disappointed by the climb. First, because there is nothing to see on the way up : no secondary craters, no fumaroles... common on many volcanoes. Second, because the crater itself is quite small, although deep, so it's not overly impressive. And last, because the traditional way to go down - sliding on the snow - is extremely scary, although safer than walking down it seems. So I regret my 100 US dollars and those 3 hours spent climbing in the snow and loose scree. I do think one should try to go up, though - it is a unique experience. But don't go with too high expectations.
title: Not quite worth the effort and the price?

review_text: Highly recommend this tour! We visited artsy Valparaiso, Viña Del Mar, a local fish market, and a picturesque winery for a tasting. Our guide Pablo was so knowledgeable, kind, and full of enthusiasm. He shared many interesting facts about Chile and the places we visited and gave us many recommendations for places to visit and things to try in Santiago. He knew everyone’s names and shared photos of our day he had taken with Jim’s new camera with us afterwards. DJ Jorge was a great driver and kept us on the road and entertained with great music. The tour is extremely convenient and well organized as they will pick you up from your hotel in the morning and drop you off at the end of the day. One of the best day excursions I’ve ever had! Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago Pablo is an expert in making the tours feel personable. We're glad you had a great time. Thank you for your review.
title: Wonderful day trip to Valparaiso!

review_text: We booked two tours with Uncorked and had a lovely experience both times. Our tour of the market and cooking class was lots of fun. Felipe showed our group around Vega Central Market (which visiting alone would be quite intimidating). We then had a great time cooking and laughing during our class. Felipe did a nice job balancing fun with learning during our experience. Our tour of the Colchagua Valley was led by Christian, who I should say was my favorite guide in Chile! He was exceptionally knowledgeable and receptive to our interests and needs. In fact, at many times, he knew more about wine than the vineyard guides! I especially enjoyed our visits to Vina Neyen and Vina Clos de Apalta. The one thing that I would change about this tour would be a quick stop in Santa Cruz.
title: Great Guides: Cooking Class + Casablanca Wine Tour

review_text: We stopped here while on a tour, the building is very impressive from the road set high on a hill. The view looking out from the building is fantastic! The wine was quite good. Take time to taste and enjoy a glass of wine on the deck.
title: Wonderful views and great wines

review_text: Wonderful experience! We got some unexpected snow at the lake, but at the same time it was magical because many in the group hadn't seen snow before. Afterwards, the trip to the thermal baths was sensational and the picnic with that view was very special. The driver Mário drove very well and our guide Alejandro was very good, always giving good information. Food was great! I recommend!
title: Great experience

review_text: I was very happy with Ollagua Travel in particular with my guide Patricio. He was very friendly, efficient and helpful. He suggested places I could visit that I had not thought of myself. He went out of the way to provide historical context to many of the places we visited.Patricio and his team are a wonderful group of people.Hi Patricio - just want to thank you and Kristian for all your help and I wish you the very best and hope to see you in Australia someday!Thiru
title: Santiago day tour

review_text: Beautiful place with a great story. Nice to know the grape trees and to try 3 different kinds of wine. Casillero de Diablo is a great surprise!
title: Amazing

review_text: This cathedral is beautiful and open to the public. It faces a gorgeous park and is a great place to relax, listen to music or just people watch. BE careful though: Pick pockets abound!
title: Beautiful Cathedral in city center

review_text: Spectacular. Amazing place, with Francisco being a top host. Explained technical details, attentive to everyone. Perfect breakfast. Worries about the client. Review of: Half Day Tour to Geysers del Tatio
title: Sensational place

review_text: Manfred is a great tour guide and driver. He met us at the SCL airport and led us around Santiago. He is very friendly, respectful and is a good driver. His English is excellent and we were super happy with our experience. We would highly recommend him for tours in Chile.
title: Great tour guide & driver

review_text: Our guide was top notch! He had good knowledge, a great personality, and made the trip interesting and fun. I'm writing a few extra words because we need 100 characters Review of: Inca Lagoon in Andes Mountain Range - Visit Local Vineyard with Tasting included
title: Inc Lake

review_text: Excellent tour! Pame the best! 100% recommended. The tour allows you to learn the origin of Pisco Mistral, lasts 1 hour, fair and price... then have lunch at the distillery restaurant... good panorama
title: Tour plus lunch, recommended!

review_text: We loved our visit to Awasi, including an incredible night of star-gazing with Jorge Corante. The sky was spectacularly full of stars, planets and galaxies, and Jorge brought it all to life with his enthusiasm for and knowledge of the sky. While serving us lovely Chilean wines, Jorge gave us a fantastic out-of-doors astronomy class, complete with laser pointer and telescope. From the Southern Cross to the rings of Saturn, we enjoyed a star-studded evening. A must do. Dear David, Thank you very much for your review. Probably the highlight of Atacama Desert Stargazing is a very personalized tour in where small group allow a good teaching and observation of the night sky. The several objets who we can find are the result of the patience, time and interest of all guests wait while I´m searching for difficult object finally ends with a unique and memorable satisfaction. Warmest Regards Jorge Corante F.
title: Awesome star-gazing in the Atacama Desert

review_text: Had an incredible time on our tour of the Casablanca Valley led by our very knowledgeable, charismatic and entertaining guide, Bryan. The vineyards were very interesting, great wines and very knowledgeable staff that conducted the tastings. We had our 9 year old son with us and he also had a great day. The food was incredible our favorite being the amazingly delicious empanadas we had on our first stop of the morning. Oh how I wish I could have one now!!!
title: Bryan was amazing!

review_text: The guides very friendly and amazing, very dedicated and concerned all the time, plus attentive to the weather conditions which allows to have a safe trip. Highly recommended.
title: Tour San Pedro - Uyuni - San Pedro

review_text: In a van with no AC in such heat can be rather difficult. Driver so unpleasant and rude. He went crazy on a guy because he stepped out of the pathway and that would damage the park. I understand and agree we shouldn’t affect the environment when visiting but that was way over board. When it came to the Whipala or something like that (company doing the tour) they harassed me for money to pay the entry to the park in cash. They sent me texts and it was so unneeded and ouch, why can’t we all just make money with honesty? The van and the driver/guide were not as bad as this agency. I wish I had booked my tickets at Caracoles street there are so many agencies and they are all kinds of people there selling all kinds of tour. Lesson learned for me. Never again. Review of: Small-Group Tour to Moon Valley from San Pedro de Atacama
title: Never again. Unpleasant. Uncomfortable. Not worth it. Caracoles Street has a lot better options.

review_text: Best tour ever! Sebastian was friendly, knowledgeable and funny. This tour is great “bang for buck”. We had a beautiful lunch too, follow his recommendation of the restaurant “with a view”. The wine was fantastic too. Thank you Sebastian for a fantastic day, 10/10 best tour, the seals made my day! Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago
title: BEST TOUR EVER if you’re stay in Chile is brief! We saw LOADS!

review_text: Guidance was crucial Careful and attentive towards the whole group He enthusiastically told us the history of the various places with perfect English and Spanish. The tour was personalized for the group and the guide made us feel comfortable. The information shared was in-depth, you sensed an intimate knowledge of these magical places
title: Wonderful.

review_text: We booked 4 tours with whipala and we really enjoy the company and the service. - Valle de la Luna: the tour is very good, and Ernesto (our guide) told us a lot of information and explained a lot of things. We finish the tour with an amazing sunset - Laguna Cejar: was a nice and easy tour. We floated in one of the lagoons with a good view to the Licancabur. Javier was our guide and was very good. We would just escape the cocktail in the end. The days in the desert are very tiring, so we would rather arrive earlier at the hotel than have the cocktail - Geysers del Tatio: one of my favourite tours. Alex was a really good guide. We stopped halfway to acclimatize and we could see the sky full of stars. He told us a lot of tips to acclimating properly. The walk in the geysers was incredible! It was very impressive. In the end my boyfriend didn't feel so well and almost fainted and everyone was very kind with us. The breakfast was great and so the rest of the tour - Piedras Rojas: our favourite tour in Atacama! Javier was our guide again and he's really really good. He told us a lot of things. We went to laguna chaxa and saw a lot of flamingos. After we had an amazing breakfast on capricorn tropic. After that we went to piedras rojas, definitely the highlight of the day for us. We also stop in laguna miscanti with a nice view. We had lunch with at an amazing place. We were starving and was late but Javier explained us that this late lunch is because it's harder to have lunch and continuing to go up, so we totally understood. The pick up at the hotel for the early tours worked really well. The communication with the company as well. We would like to have done a stargazing tour and they were really honest saying thay the weather was not good for that. In resume, we think that Whipala is a great company to do the tours! They always text you the day before. They send you a message saying what you need to bring to the tour. Book with them!!!
title: Book with Whipala! They are great!

review_text: I did the Salares Route tour with the mediator company Desertour and I loved the tour. The group was big, but the guide managed to give us time in each location for photos and live the experience. Breakfast in front of the "People's Mountain" was a unique experience. It is a beautiful region and stop looking at this place and its strength and its beauty is to leave us in meditative state without effort. I suggest you go with a group. It starts to be in a higher region and it's really impactful and nothing safe to drive if you don't have experience. More photos and videos of the places on Instagram @emanuellemlopes (but I am not an expert ^^ )
title: Cafe in front of the "People's Mountain" - Licancabur

review_text: We visited the alto plano and the lagoons as part of a full day excursion from the Explora lodge in San Pedro de Atacama. The scenery and location is breathtaking - partly because at 4000m above sea level there is a lot less oxygen in the air, but mainly because of the visual impact of the scenery. Beautiful lagoons dotted with flamingos, grazing llamas and other wildlife. Absolutely clear air so the surrounding high mountains seem much closer. The high desert landscape is so different from anything else I had experienced, what I would expect Mars to look like. We were there in June so it was quite cold, especially when the wind was blowing, but we were well prepared and very comfortable. Explora provided a really comfortable vehicle with driver and a very knowledgeable guide. They also provided a gourmet lunch which we enjoyed in a sheltered location with great views of the lagoon and mountains. Well worth the time and effort to visit!
title: Breathtaking Excursion

review_text: We, a tall group of 13 people, started our journey at Friday in the morning, with 2 cars. Every day of 4 Days were perfectly organized. With food, something to drink and a place to rest and sleep. They thought at everything we might need and going to need! Viktor and Jana, two very good experienced guys, showed us beautiful places, sometimes Viktor is telling a Story and for these who don't speak Spanish, Jana is going to translate very well in German or English. So, when you are looking for activities in Chile and around Santiago,keep FLECHA EXTREMA in mind! :)
title: Journey in the South of Chile, Atacama Desert

review_text: From the first minute they were concerned about making us feel a wonderful experience, both Don Raúl and Emeterio, our guide during the 4 days, were very concerned that our experience was unique and it was, together with my family we are very grateful for their attention and care, I definitely recommend it 100%
title: Excellent tourism service

review_text: One of the absolute best hikes of my life! I highly recommend this tour to anyone that wants to get out of Santiago for the day. Review of: Andes Day Volcano 8K - Cajón del Maipo Thanks for the review! Cajón del Maipo is a magical place with awesome landscapes :)
title: Incredible Day Trip

review_text: We had built up high expectations for the tour because of the excellent reviews and becasue it was so close to where we were staying in santiago. First thing that should be clearer is that the tour is not free but instead they were very pushy with the amount of money you should pay for the tour. We had Felipe who seemed like a nice guy, wasnt really interested in talking to the group and seemed to be rattling the information off to ge the tour over with. We were a bit offput by the price and his attitude and decided to leave around half way through.
title: Not Free, Not That Great

review_text: The landscapes are beautiful, the agency is very organized and the Isi guide was very professional, led the tour very well, in addition to having taught us a lot about the local culture in a light and fun way! Review of: Half Day Tour to Geysers del Tatio
title: I recommend Pukarumi

review_text: A tenner. It is a very beautiful tour with spectacular landscapes, where the salt flat and the lagoons that are visited, are impressive. Also, if you do the tour with Marlon, the experience becomes more cultural and immersive. Marlon is an excellent guide, for his effort and dedication Review of: Red Stones and Altiplanic Lagoons
title: Excellent tour

review_text: Such an insightful guide to the stars. beautiful presentation, well versed in multiple languages. I could have stayed and listened for hours. Wonderful encounter.
title: Seeing some of the same constellations I know from the northern hemisphere in the southern

review_text: Perfect day with Chile Dream Tours as we experienced adventure on the rapids and relaxing wine tasting in the vineyards. Sean, our guide, went above and beyond to make sure we had the time of our lives. We laughed and had 11 hours of non-stop fun while Sean navigated our day. Will def tour with Sean again!! Review of: Andes Whitewater Rafting Adventure plus Winery Tour and Tasting Thank you so much, Sonya, for this nice review! It was a real pleasure being your guide on this fun tour. I look forward to seeing you and your crew again for more adventures in Chile! Take care and safe travels! Best regards, Sean Casey Tour Coordinator/Guide Chile Dream Tours
title: Perfect Day in Chile with Chile Dream Tours and our guide, Sean!!!

review_text: PASSIONED by the service of Araya! We left Brazil with everything paid, all the pre-scheduled tours and the route specially thought out by the agency (considering the adaptation to altitude, climate, etc.). Arriving in San Pedro, we didn’t have to worry about anything at all! They were impeccable! In punctuality, logistics, professionalism and capricho with us! We were delighted with all the guides and, most importantly, the quality of the meals! Note MIL! Worth every penny! They made our experience in the Atacama Desert UNIC!!! ZERO perrengue, só lazer!
title: I RECOMMEND ABSOLUTELY!!!

review_text: The experience of taking the tours with Danny travel was sensational!!! Attentive, fun, friendly, punctual and the freedom he gave us to enjoy each place at our leisure made all the difference. The trips were extremely comfortable and pleasant. Thank you for providing us with the best tours! É incrível receber esse tipo de Feedback, muito obrigada <3
title: Trip to Chile

review_text: You surprised me positively, especially because I found you on the internet and hadn't had any recommendations, but you are CONGRATULATIONS, since the beginning of the service with Amanda Gallão, who has always been very helpful and attentive in recommending tours and tips. Once there, Amanda herself asked me if I had had a good trip and had been impeccably taken care of. Then the communication of the tours with times and names of the days and driver, I thought was excellent. Guide Carla takes care and affection with all the tours, accompanying the group step by step, providing us with unforgettable experiences and memories. The guide Roxana was good, but I think she lacked a little follow-up and patience compared to our perceptions. Regarding breakfast and picnic in Cajon Del Maipo, I believe there should have been a little more "plenty", it was a bit too short, considering that there are quite a few hours without eating anything, although they recommend bringing water and a snack . The driver Leonardo was also super attentive to us. Review of: Coastal Gems: Viña del Mar & Valparaíso Olá Soraya, muito obrigado pela avaliação é gratificante para nossos guias e toda a nossa equipe receber feedback positivos como o seu, saber que temos contribuído para uma excelente experiência nos deixa muito felizes. Até nossa próxima aventura juntos.
title: SCL Trip - Full Tour

review_text: I found Atacama Magic through Google Maps and got in touch after seeing the very good prices on the agency's website. From the beginning, the service on WhatsApp was very attentive. Micah answered all questions, gave clear guidance and was always available with quick contact. We were able to make payments by transfer through Wise, which made it a lot easier too. We took 4 tours in total with the agency: Valle de la Luna, Astronomico, Lagunas Baltinache and Geysers. All very good. The tours were punctual, with incredible guides (unfortunately I only remember the name of one, Rodrigo) and clear communication at all times. The vans were good, with the exception of one that was very small and cramped. We were with tall people and it wasn't so comfortable for them. It only happened once. Another point worth highlighting is the lack of water available in the snacks offered on the tours. Just juice and pisco. I know that Atacama has a water problem, but I consider it important to provide water at least at this time. Despite these points of attention, as a whole it was very worth signing up with Atacama Magic.
title: Very good agency with fair prices!

review_text: Beautiful tour , with a very attentive and close guide , Monserrat excellent guide with data and information of each visited site, congratulations on the great service
title: Tour beach the virgin!! Recommended anyway

review_text: Very beautiful Santiago architecture, Valentina and Scarlett clear explanations and good attitude to service, would return again Review of: Cable Car, Funicular and Sightseeing Bus in Santiago one day Estimado viajero, nos alegra saber que disfruto de su recorrido, muchas gracias por compartir su experiencia con nosotros. ¡Esperamos su pronta visita!
title: I love the bus

review_text: This is the place! Great tracks for skiing and not very touristy! I loved the instructors and the sights. Road is curvy and long so get your dramamine!
title: Looking for adventure?

review_text: The valley is not far away from Santiago, and it´s on the way to Valparaiso and Vina del Mar. Many wineries, some only sell wine, others also have wine tgours, and some have very good restaurants, specially the "Vina Casas del Bosque" and the "Vina Matetic"
title: An interesting wine route

review_text: Excellent tour, for those who want to know and appreciate the most exclusive wines of the Casablanca region, I recommend the one offered by the operator Best Trip Chile and the guide João, excellent service. Review of: Casablanca world class wines, 4 vineyards & Tanino lunch stop Agradecemos muito seus comentários, Casablanca é um destino que vale muito a pena conhecer e ficamos felizes em saber que você gostou com nossa equipe. Muito obrigado por nos recomendar, esperamos vê-lo novamente em nosso lindo país.
title: Wine tasting in Casablanca

review_text: This tour became more personal and engaging as the day progressed. We were encouraged to share our expectations and the tour delivered- five stars!! Review of: Valpo in 1 day: Authentic + Famous! Semi-private walking tour & public transport
title: This Tour Delivers

review_text: This was a great tour. I booked this trip via Booking.com. The company contacted me on Whatsapp with the guide (Miguel's) details and he then made contact prior to departure date. I was picked up early morning from my accommodation in Providencia early morning and returned afterwards. The tour guide Miguel, and our driver were excellent throughout the day with great explanations and stories. We explored Valparaiso quite extensively, going to a number of sites by vehicle and and then on foot. The UNESCO World Heritage area was superb, the location, colours and art amazing. It was nice to go through some local fish markets also and watch as they fed the Sealions, and enjoy some local food for lunch in the area. On the way back we stopped at a Winery. I think the location of the specific winery was changed from original plan but the tour which included wine tasting was okay. A great day all round and well worth doing the tour. Miguel enhanced the experience. Highly recommended as a full day tour from Santiago for those with limited time. Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago
title: Valparaiso and Winery Day Tour from Santiago

review_text: Santiago's architecture was very different from what I expected. It seemed even more European than Buenos Aires. This frothy wedding cake of building is a good example of this.
title: Architecture

review_text: guided tour with guides giving the impression to be tired (of tourists). Save the money and buy a good bottle instead.
title: better buy a good bottle for half the price

review_text: I loved this tour. The laguna was almost white because of the high concentration of salt and evaporation which makes the view quite impressive because of the mix of colours. Add do that the view of the Licancabur Volcano. We were not luck to see the sunset at this place but I bet it must be wonderful.
title: So many colours

review_text: We made the ascent by the cable car (Oasis station in the Metropolitan Park at the end of Pedro de Valdivia street) and we descended in the last station, Cumbre, where the attractions of the Cerro de San Cristobal are concentrated. After knowing the place, we descended by the funicular and went to walk by the Bellavista district. It's possible make the opposite, and descend in Providencia district. It's worth looking at the site to check the opening hours and price.
title: Great option of tour in Santiago

review_text: Excellent very good tour I recommend, wines are super rich But I liked the wine that's taken most with sweet things
title: Very good

review_text: Extremely pleasant tour! And what made it more special was the presence of Lorena and Emerson! Best travel companions!
title: Travel to Embalse el Yeso

review_text: Very good service, excellent tour since you learn a lot. Thank you very much and I hope to return for more pisco!!
title: Excellent experience

review_text: Even though we experienced some typical Lake District weather (a few showers, some pretty heavy!) we still had a great time with Raffaele who helped us see some of the local specialities in a range of habitats. We were also very lucky to see the rare Pudu (very small deer) in the rainforest. Raffaele was an excellent, enthusisatic guide and very knowledgable, not just about the birds but about about all the nature we saw. We had a very enjoyable day out.
title: Poor weather ... Great day out!

review_text: Emblematic place to enjoy equestrianism and also history. Its facilities are clean, the staff's attention is gentle and at least, the whole time we were there, you see a highly recommended place to go with family, children and share.
title: Hippica and history

review_text: I enjoyed very much the setting of this sweet place. It was towards the end of the day so lots of stores were closed but it is very sweet. We were very lucky because there were not many people there which I think it also made a big difference. As for the goods, you can find souvenirs from Chile all in one place. Not too bad.
title: Sweet little place

review_text: Our driver took us to one he recommended called Casas del bosque and it indeed turned out to be a great experience!! The tour was in English and the guide was very thorough with the entire tour and ready to answer any questions. He was fun and tried to engage everyone. The tasting itself was amazing, we all got seated by a big dinner table and tried 4 different wines - 2 white and 2 red. Everything about the wines were explained along with teaching us the right techniques of holding, smelling, drinking and opening a wine. The tour was 15.000clp. We ended up only visiting Casas del bosque as the tour was really good and almost 2hrs long.
title: One of the best wine tours I've tried

review_text: Juan Carlos was AWESOME! He was already waiting for us even though we got in early, he helped carry our luggage to the car, and then we hit the road around Santiago for a wonderful tour that was exactly what we had requested. We saw all the highlights, had a nice ride up on the cable car, and then he took us to a fantastic little local spot for some great food before we had to head back. He was a great guide, and we highly recommend him for your tours in the Santiago area!
title: Our long layover turned out great!

review_text: Concha y Toro is a historic vinyard and an interesting Devil's Cellar, complete with a story and tongue in cheek histrionics. All tasting are outdoors as you tour the vines. The grow many varieties and allow small sampling of grapes that are ripe. Very interesting opportunity I thought. Also the home of the fairly recently rediscovered native grape called Carminiere or Carménère, a robust red with a distinct flavor. A pleasant stop.
title: Yup, grapes and wine

review_text: I did three tours with La Biciclete Verde, walking tour of Valparaiso, Bicycle tour of three wineries, and walking tour of Santiago. All three tours were great, especially the walking tour of Santiago, where we saw the typical touristy things but also were taken to off the wall places we'd never have seen on our own, a great day. The guides were all fantastic, great energy and personalities. The only downside to any of the tours is I had hoped for more time to browse the shops and markets in Valparaiso but this was not factored into the tour.
title: Not just bicycles, they walk too!

review_text: The patio is full of nice places to eat, drik and by nice stuff. We have a very nice experience. People were very kind in all the shops and restaurants.
title: A nice place to visit!

review_text: Beautiful scenery, would return again. There were some details that I did not like, among them the stop in the square is unnecessary, has no appeal and you waste time. Another thing is time, too fast everything, when I was 5 minutes in the pool and we had to leave. Not to mention that the spa has no hot water in the bathroom and the largest pool is cold water. It would be preferable that they do not offer the spa and that they give more time to enjoy, because although the spa is not mandatory to go, when they offer it seems a wonderful thing and you will relax and it is not. The Benja, the Guide, without words, a love, recanchero, friendly and fun, plus he explains everything during the trip. The very prudent and friendly driver too. Review of: Cajon del Maipo: El Yeso & Spa reservoir in El Morado Estimado viajero, nos complace saber que su experiencia en el tour Cajón del Maipo fue satisfactoria y que nuestro equipo ha contribuido positivamente en el tour. Lamentamos que algunos puntos no hayan cumplido con sus expectativas, agradecemos sus comentarios para asi seguir mejorando el servicio. ¡Que tenga un buen dia!
title: Excursion to Cajon del Maipo

review_text: The place is very lively! They have a lot of shops to shop there with a variety of stuff to pick up. I picked up the copper earrings and some clothes which are the speciality from there. Also I picked up some blue stone (lapis lazuli) speciality from there. I picked up a ring, earrings and a lighter from there. A must visit if your in Santiago! 😊
title: Shops and restaurants

review_text: “We bought two tickets to travel and were informed that there were seats available, but one of us had to stop. Why lie about availability if in the end one of us ends up without a seat?" One pays to go comfortable and they go without shame to sell.
title: Lying in order to sell

review_text: One of the most beautiful churches I have ever been. Although the plaza outside was packed with tourists, the church was very peaceful. It's very beautiful inside and you do not have to pay to entry. Definitely worth a visit.
title: Beautiful and peaceful

review_text: The Villarrica Volcano hike was an unforgettable experience! The knowledgeable mountain guides kept us informed about the volcano's status and safety measures, which added an extra layer of excitement to the adventure. I loved the group's enthusiasm and how the guides were attentive to everyone's varying fitness levels, ensuring that everyone felt included and comfortable. The journey was nothing short of spectacular, with breathtaking views at every turn. And the surprise at the end was the cherry on top, making the experience even more memorable! This hike is truly a must-do for anyone seeking an exhilarating outdoor adventure! Thank you so much for your amazing review! We're glad to hear that you enjoyed the climb to Villarrica Volcano. Our team strives to provide memorable experiences, and it's gratifying to know that we succeeded with you. We hope to see you again on future adventures. Thanks for recommending us!
title: Epic Adventure at Villarrica Volcano

review_text: Terrific views of the city and good hiking and parks up and down the mountain. There are two stop and I would suggest stopping a both as there is much to see at both levels.
title: A must

review_text: We spent the most amazing three days with Whalesound and their fantastic team Simon, Jonathan, Josselyne, Thierry and Luis. It was the highlight of our trip to Chile. We were blessed with reasonable weather and an incredible number of whale sightings. On two evenings different pairs of whales played alongside our boat for over an hour. They were so close I got a face full of whale blow! They danced in the water performing acrobatics, swam under and around the boat and showed off their flukes. The team are incredibly knowledgeable, passionate about their work and years of experience here helps them find the best sightings. We also saw the glacier up close and heard it creak and crash, saw colonies of sea lions and Magellanic penguins and so many birds. The camp is simple but cosy and the food and wine, and of course pisco sours, delicious. It’s hard to imagine a better experience than this for seeing whales up close and learning about them.
title: If you get the chance - do this trip

review_text: Interesting information and sights and I would never have driven out this way myself. Good tour guide and interesting Buffet at the Casino in Vina Del Mar. I was happy to experience the areas we travelled to. Very steep hills in Valporaiso that were challenging for many of the older people on our bus to walk down. Wendy: Muchas gracias por compartir su experiencia :)
title: Valporaiso Vina Del Mar

review_text: Great tour, Camila and Daniel are excellent hosts, very attentive, helpful, kindness and education. Congratulations to Horizonte for the excellent professionals. We will definitely return. Thank you very much!
title: Satisfaction and thanks

review_text: Great tour!! Alvaro was really lovely and had great knowledge about Valparaiso and Chilean history in general! Always able to answer any question no matter how random! Tour explored the great street art, churches, monuments and views with snippets of history! Top tour!
title: Sunday morning tour with Alvaro

review_text: Best time to go? Sunset!!!! If you want to appreciate the magnitude of the city and the mountains surronding it, this is a place to go.
title: Nice 360º view of Santiago

review_text: I just got back to my hostel after taking the "Good Morning Santiago" tour. I took the 2 p.m. tour hence my title. I am writing this immediately after because I have found that I always intend to write reviews of places and events and then end up never doing it. The tour was great! I just arrived in Santiago last night and I learned a lot about the city with respect to culture and its history as well cool spots to go out or to see this or that. I was the only one on the tour and had my guide, Pablo's undivided attention. He was very knowledgeable, personable, and professional while having a great sense of humor. I speak Spanish fairly well but Pablo spoke English fluently. I had an awesome time and enjoyed having the one on one attention however I would have preferred it if there were a couple more tourists just so that he could have received some more tips. My hostel, Princesa Insolente is the one that gave me the map from Spicy Chile and FYI it has to be the coolest most well thought out hostel ever! Bottom line come to Santiago, stay in Princesa Insolente and take Spicy Chile's "Good Morning Santiago" tour! Thanks Johnny!!! That´s an amazing comment!!! It´s great that you enjoyed the tour with our awesome guide, Pablo (we´ll tell him about this comment also!)!! As you´ve experienced our motto is to give every traveller what he deserves ether being 20 tourists or just one lucky guy like you they will make sure to give their best!! Have a safe trip and hope to see you back soon in the other 2 free walking tours that we have!! PS. And about your recommendation, it´s absolutely true that Princesa Insolente is a great choice for everyone coming to Santiago! :) It´s surely one of the hostel with more character of South America! Cheers!!
title: Buenas Tardes Santiago!

review_text: Steep sided peaks and narrow winding ravines give this place an eerie feel, and even though close to the road the place is silent. Very hot as there is no breeze. Excellent photo location. Worth a quick stop off.
title: Minutes away from San Pedro

review_text: Incredible, we had a great time, I loved the people, nothing to say, I recommend it 100%, I wish they would lower the adult entrance just a little bit, but everything was fine.
title: I felt BN when I saw the children enjoying themselves, we still had a lot to cover

review_text: We went on a 1-day excursion to Valparaíso and Viña del Mar. In general, the tour was okay, but lacked historical information and context about what we were actually looking it. It also did not include a typical elevator ride in Valparaíso, nor the historical center (just the hills). In Viña, the only thing we did was eat at a good (but somewhat overpriced restaurant), and have 30 minutes at the beach. On our way back the air conditioning in the van broke, so it was quite uncomfortable. Review of: Tour Valparaiso Viña del Mar Reñaca Beach from Santiago.
title: Lack of information and attractions

review_text: Helen and Juan were both delightful and very knowledgeable. It was a very laid back, easy, and enjoyable tour.
title: Valparaiso Tour

review_text: It was a great tour! Our guide Javiera was amazing, juggling between Spanish and English the whole day. She was great explaining the history of everything and was very attentive to our whole group and waited if needed. We also went to a very nice restaurant for lunch which I didn't expect. Overall, would recommend! Review of: From Santiago: Valparaíso, Viña del Mar and Neruda Museum Thank you very much for your comments.
title: Our tour with Javiera

review_text: This is one of the most amazing, awe-inspiring places on our Pale Blue Dot. It is simply amazing. The landscape is ever changing and spectacular. Walk the Q circuit, camp under stars (sunshine, rain, snow and wind!) and meet the locals. Just go I say,
title: A place of a lifetime.

review_text: A very nice experience and you learn a lot about the culture and history of the town and the pisco. 100% recommended the tour and the tasting of the types of pisco. It also has a lot of hours on offer.
title: An experience that you have to do if you come to Pisco Elqui

review_text: We came to the mall to burn a few hours before our walk up on the dunes. The mall is big enough to walk around in 20-30 minutes. It has most of the major stores. There are two skyways that open up to different shopping areas. Both areas have their own theater. Home center and lider are located in the basment of the other shopping area. There is a large parking area/ramp off of home center rhat is easier to get into and out of than the ramp below the mall. The first 30 minutes is free. Enjoy your time.
title: Good place to burn time.

review_text: Perfect guide and driver! Thank you very very much for arranging this team. I did hike around Torres des Paine and trek to the TORRES. Trek to the TORRES was difficult and high level for me because I don't exercise at all and was not custom to trek. However the guide met my pace until the last and support me very well! The hot tea he made gave me lots of energy! At last I could do it!! Also driver was also very kind. I had to move from Paine National Park to to El Calafate in Argentine by bus. (The bus ticket was also organized by this company.) Then the driver took me the bus station and waited for the bus with me until the bus departed. So I didn't have to worry anything! Of course I could arrive at El Calafafe. I was satisfied very very much!!! I appreciate for you from bottom of my heart. I will choose this company when I visit Patagonia again. Dear Akiko! Thank you very much for preferring our services. Delighted to have been part of your visit to Patagonia! If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact us. Best regards. Team Onteaiken Patagonia.
title: Perfect!!!

review_text: 2,600 pesos for the round trip on the funicular. Extensive views of the city on both sides of the funicular but the entrance side has cables that obscure the view. The statue faces west, so there are shadow issues with the sun behind her most of the day. I found a cool spot to sit and wait for a better photo op, but by 4:30pm the pigeons were roosting on her head and shoulders so I left.
title: City views and statue

review_text: Is impossible to not see it from the town, there is no a formal road to get to the top, but it is possible, and the view from there is just amazing, i went there in september and there was a forest covered in snow on the top, just wonderful !! if you want info about how to get there, a good idea is to try to contact the people who practice climbing in the city: there are two indoor boulders where you will find the rigth people :)
title: Breathtaking.

review_text: My husband booked a private custom wine tour for my birthday while we were visiting Santiago for the first time last week. It was a perfect way to spend the day and we both agreed one of the best expenditures we have made while travelling. Jose was the ultimate tour guide, speaking fluent English (our Spanish is non existent), picking us up at our hotel and answering our many questions during the drive out to the wine regions and back. He arranged to tour three wineries, two boutique and one medium size, as well as tapas on the deck of one winery, overlooking the valley, and a private lunch at another, overlooking a Spanish garden. He was able to accommodate us despite emailing him the day before we wished to go and on a Sunday (the day to rest and spend time with family in Chile). We will forever remember our perfect day with appreciation to Uncorked for their fabulous service. Review of: Best Wine Tasting in Santiago
title: The perfect birthday

review_text: Entertaining! Very interactive tour, we learned a lot, the place is beautiful and has a lot of history and tradition Highly recommended
title: Good.

review_text: We learned a lot about the history and geography of the region. Which was very nutritious for us and our kids... Review of: Private Pumas and Wildlife Watching Experience
title: Funny.

review_text: We did it with our car, it’s doable, even with small cars. You have to leave at dusk, so be well rested and be careful, but its an easy drive. The place is amazing! Entrance around 10.000 or 15.000, one of the most expensives, but you have to do it, so...
title: Must do!

review_text: A great option to walk and make some shopping, It is not cheap, but you can have a good walk and Entertainment. You can eat there as there are many restaurants.
title: Open mall

review_text: Left hotel at 0600 , dark & cold & drove into the desert as the sun rose. What a visually incredible experience, once in a lifetime! We arrived at -4*C to a barren landscape , over 4600m altitude,with steaming holes, surrounded by majestic snow capped volcanoes. The light as the sun rose added to the aura of what must have been an ancient ceremonial place. This is one of life's most memorable places.
title: Out of this world

review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed our one day tour of the park. We first went to the ski area hiking much of the way up in nice snow. After visiting the green lagoon, we went to the waterfalls which are great. Yes other falls in parts of the world are better but these are very beautiful for sure. I believe there are other hiking trails in the park as well. Views are very good.
title: Beautiful Park

review_text: Mari helped us a lot to facilitate the organization and experience, it was all perfect. Beautiful place and organized tours, 0 perrengue
title: Surreal Experience

review_text: The view and location were great but the service and prices were bad. We would advise you to avoid this place and pick one of the little restaurants to the right.

title: Valparaíso and Emiliana vineyard

review_text: This is winery visits 3.0. Very well designed tour. Professional staff. Mostly oriented to Brazilian clients therefore Portuguese but some English speaking staff. We had Milton. Retired Brazilian Navy and very personable. Great visit, great wine, and I wish we could get it in the US.
title: Best winery tour ever!

review_text: Great tour to the main places - and of course the to the most touristic ones - in the park which gives you a great overview of the landscape!
title: Full Day - Long Day

review_text: We loved our wine trip to the Colchagua valley so much we booked the Casablanca valley tour the following day. Food was delicious on both trips. The small group setting was great for meeting new people, but you didn't feel like you were stuck on a giant tour bus. Our guide was really knowledgeable and friendly. Great way to get out of the city for people who aren't renting a car. Wished you could pay with credit/card or paypal though.
title: best part of our trip...wine country!

review_text: Such good value for money. We were able to get a good idea of this beautiful city. A treat was the cable car and funicular and I recommend the two day pass because you need to go back to revisit special places. I found the staff very good and helpful especially Constanza Valdivieso and her assistant on our bus. Review of: Hop On Hop Off City Tour Santiago, 1 Day Plus Edition
title: Best value in town - Amust do before anything else.

review_text: We went to the Carabinieri's shift, a rather nostalgic Attraction. The Palace is beautiful, in its region there are good places to visit, but very careful, especially for the square of weapons... Almost a Plaza da Sé in São Paulo, very boring waiting to get the boat!!! In the area of the Palace, you will find the Cathedral of Santiago, Former Federal Senate, Court of Justice, Stock Exchange, street Paris/London among many other attractions!!! Always alert
title: Indispensable to visit the Palace!

review_text: The company is nice and the staff was fine. The buses clean and safe. This review is just about the heart of the tour. It was so boring that 4 out of 5 of us fell asleep. Not much to see at all or hear about. I would not spend the price for it. It was expensive. It was a covered hop on hop off which was great protection against the hot sun. Review of: Tourist bus around Santiago for a day thetravelteam, we regret that the experience lived through the Hop On Hop Off has seemed boring. Hopefully I can return soon to Santiago and live a new experience with us that will take away that acquired perception. Greetings to Minnesota.

review_text: The instructors were great! Patient, carrying and professionals. Had a great time and definitely will do it again

review_text: It is less expensive to rent a boat with other people but you loose the quiet enjoyment of this marvel. Try to decide if $60USD is acceptable and rent a boat by yourself. Kayak if you can. Prices for boat tour is the same (with all vendors) but you can bargain.
title: A must if you a close-by

review_text: Worth a visit if you happen to be in the Plaza de Armas, otherwise nothing really special here. Inside, there is nice architecture, a functional post office and a free museum of stamps, old mailboxes and telegraph machines.
title: If you're in the area

review_text: I took the tour to Portillo with the Guide and driver Cristian Castro. Excellent person, concerned with the interaction of everyone and always relaxing the environment. Good driver and great Guide. Portillo is very beautiful, worth seeing. At the end there is a delicious picnic that includes wines and juice.
title: Tour to Portillo

review_text: I hired the company Travel Chile in Brazil. My plan was to spend 7 days in Santiago, and after seeing the recommendations, payment conditions and the values presented by the company I closed a deal to conduct 7 guided tours by them (Isla Negra and Algarrobo + Vinicula Undurraga, Termas Valle, Viña del Mar + Valparaiso, Los Andes Sunset ( Com Piquenique ), Vinícola Concha y Toro, City tour, Portillo (Laguna del Inca)). They were amazing tours with nice guides who know the history, better places for photos, know how to captivate the group and are extremely competent. Special highlight for guide Johana, who has been with me on most tours is an excellent person. Everything that was previously agreed was executed and carried out by Travel Chile. This company is a reference for tourism in Chile, completely reliable, punctual and excellent cost benefit.
title: I recommend the trip Chile

review_text: Rodrigo was very, friendly, professional and knowledgable about the history and culture of santiago and chile. The tour was fun and very informative and provided an excellent overview - very handy as we had only arrived in santiago the day before . We did the full day tour, but TBH I found the morning more fun than the afternoon - although the afternoon tour provided a huge insight into the country's political background and current status - so wouldn't want to miss this. The morning's stop at Pablo Neruda's house was great. Rodrigo told us loads about him - and whetted our appetite to go back to the museum (which we did. We are not museum people - but this was very good - especially as we had the background from Rodrigo already). My feedback would be for the afternoon tour to add a stop off in Lastarria for Pisco sours - this would be a welcome addition to the afternoon tour and allows for questions or chat - as per the morning tour - The market stop (coffee and Sopadepillas) was good for a re-charge and learning a little more about local food etc. Review of: Santiago Bicycle Tour via Small Group: Parks, Markets and More Hi Claire! Thank you very much for your kind words!! It's great to hear that you loved the tours with Rodrigo, and you learnt a bit more about our beloved city! I'm taking in account your suggestion about a stop in Lastarria, it could be great indeed! Hope your are fine, Peter
title: Great intro to Santiago!

review_text: Very enjoyable, interesting, right pace, expert guide, great variety of sites. Overall, excellent value for money Review of: Frutillar, Puerto Varas, and Petrohué Waterfalls Excursion from Puerto Montt
title: Brilliant Tour and Value for Money

review_text: Our first destination this morning was Pueblito Artesan Village at Los Dominicos. It is a assemblage of about 100 small clay and thatch-roofed huts and workshop shacks that house artists and craftsmen, located adjacent to the San Vincent Ferrer Parish Church that is a National Monument. A bus load of Australian tourists had arrived just before we did, but they were dispersed quickly among the many small shops and a couple cafes. It is a very warm and comfortable area to stone paths and overhanging trees. There were jewellers and potters, knitwear scarves and shawls and rugs, painters, artists working in copper and tin and leather, furniture makers and basket weavers. There were also small animal and bird sellers and three large enclosures containing many birds including peacocks and parakeets and all manner of brightly-coloured feathered flyers, and you could buy a cage at the same time to house them. We window-shopped and only purchased some Chilean spice.
title: Cozy Village of Handicrafters

review_text: I usually visit cemeteries for their art and history and this one has both. The history of Chile is visited through it. Towering mausoleums of varied styles. It is not very well maintained which in certain places gives it a rather lugubrious look. I felt safe walking in it. Subway line 3 drops you off at the door.
title: Historic walk and beautiful architecture

review_text: 10 days of classical music is already good. The madrigalist choir showed me how opera was born. A gentleman played guitar as he was born: 4 double plastic strings with a sound so minimal that the current one would be a runaway scream.
title: Excellence, peace and joy. What more can you ask for?!

Success ❤️

review_text: We use the funicular to climb in the Cerro de San Cristóbal. It was quick to buy the entrance (we chose the combo with the cable car for descent). The trip is very pleasant.
