title: A great bike and winery tour in Casablanca!

review_text: We visited Neyen on February 20th, it was our second day in Santa Cruz, and we had visited a few other wineries. We heard that this winery was great by our chauffer but unfortunately what we were promised, and paid for, was only half of what was actually given to us. We had the tour and wine tasting with Sophia and things seemed well (we were tipsy after having had other wine at this point in time) but we are disappointed in learning after we left that the experience was not what we expected to receive for the price we paid. We did not visit the cellar nor get any cheese with our wines (only one piece of chocolate) and the "tour" was very short and basically just showed us 2 vines close to the visitors center. This leaves us feeling sad that the cost of this experience, $33,000 CLP, was so expensive and we did not even get half of what was promised to us. To add insult to injury, upon trying to get into contact with their Visitor and Hospitality manager, Roxana, after sending 2 emails immediately after we realized this grave oversight, there was absolutely no response. Lastly, the 3 wines we tasted, only 1 was decent, the other two were too young, considering they are reds and definitely not worth the price that we were charged. Be very careful of this winery and make sure that you received all of the services that they charge you for!
title: We were given half of the vertical tasting but charged the full price!

review_text: I really enjoyed my evening of stargazing. The bus picked us up and dropped us back which was great. The guide was a professional in the area of meteorology and the stars- he was young and very enthusiastic about the subject, which really made the trip for me. Bring warms layers. Popcorn and warm mulled wine was provided, very tasty.
title: Group Stargazing

review_text: Both on the way from the airport to the hotel and on the way back, the Transvip drivers provided very professional attention. ¡Gracias por tu comentario! Nos alegra saber que disfrutaste de nuestro servicio. Tu opinión positiva es nuestra mejor recompensa.
title: Professional transfer

review_text: A very well kept place, attentive staff Roberto's good explanation of the process and both lunch and tasting are amazing. Whether to check the toilets often because some passengers are not careful with hygiene. Nature the colors the dedication are noticeable. Nice team beautiful place Excellent products
title: Super recommended

review_text: We did a 3-day tour of Parque Lauca starting and ending in Arica and staying 2 nights in Putre. We had previously spent 4 days and nights in San Pedro de Atacama. The time spent at and above San Pedro’s 2400m probably helped acclimatize so that after a rather headachey first night we were fine at Putre’s 3500m and the highest point of the tour was 4600m. For us these 3 days were more enjoyable than the time spent in San Pedro because of the quietness, lack of other visitors to Parque Lauca and the richer wildlife. The infrastructure (toilets, changing facilities at hot springs, the tour company’s van, hotels, roads (miles and miles of washboard)) was poorer, but it is so much nicer it was well worth the hardship.
title: Stunning scenery, history and rich wildlife

review_text: We went up Sao Cristóvão Hill by cable car and went down by Funicular. It was a fun and different experience, especially for those going with children! Everything very clean and organized! I really liked it. Prezado visitante, ficamos felizes em saber que você teve uma boa experiência com nossos serviços. Esperamos vê-lo em breve!
title: Interesting tour

review_text: Or at least you can. The Laguna Cejar was interesting to look at with the mountains as a backdrop. There were people wading in the water which was very cold. The Ojos de Salar were 2 very large sink holes, very cool looking. Again no swimming as it was not very warm out and the water was freezing. The Laguna Tebinquiche was the most picturesque of the day.
title: Swim in Salt

review_text: The landscapes are beautiful, the driver Juan and the Guide Daniel of Turistik are sensational super educated, patient, helpful, simply the perfect ride, only compliments to the meal and receptivity of the whole perfect team and this place without words to describe so much beauty, only gratitude. Review of: Portillo and Laguna del Inca Tour Que bom saber de sua experiência! 🌟 Ficamos felizes que tenha apreciado a paisagem deslumbrante e que Juan e Daniel tenham prestado um serviço excepcional. Agradecemos seus elogios sobre a comida e a capacidade de resposta da equipe. É sempre um prazer ajudar nossos viajantes a vivenciar momentos memoráveis - esperamos vê-lo novamente em breve para mais aventuras! 🌄✨
title: Perfect in everything from departure to arrival

review_text: Booking process and 10/10 care ... in the booking were super understanding and patient to give me the available hours and Pedro, the therapist, was very attentive and with excellent service, very professional. Also, they have a very rich cold tea!! And you can pour yourself water, tea or coffee at ease. Thank you very much, I always recommend them.
title: We recommend

review_text: Angelmo is a little neighbourhood in Puerto Montt, not an actual town. It's small (takes about 10 minutes to walk end to end) and has a variety of craft stores (mostly local, though you can find some mass produced stuff as well) and at the end a smallish plaza with some buildings full of local restaurants. For a modest price you can also get a boat ride that takes you around the inner bay. We got to see a sea wolf up close tanning on a buoy and there are other animals you can see, so we recommend doing that. Also the scenery is beautiful with lots of opportunities to take nice pictures.
title: Nice place to walk around

review_text: I went on a one day tour to Valparaiso and Viña Del Mar with Somos tours in October 2017 and it was a very bad experience. I wouldn’t recommend anyone to go with them. The short (TRDL) version is: we only had 1 guide leading a group of 30 so we were constantly running behind schedule and in the end didn’t have time at all to explore the hills of Valparaiso, instead we just rushed through the area in a bus! If you would like to walk the hills of Valparaiso and enjoy some time taking pictures of the colourful houses, DO NOT GO WITH THEM! There are lots of good tour operators out there, but despite all the reciews, Somos is definitely not one of them. Most people take such tours only once, you don’t want to take your chances with them. So here is what happened. For a large group of 30 people, we only had 1 guide. He is constantly looking for people during the tour and try to gather everyone. Most other groups I saw on the way are 10-20 people. We visited Viña Del Mar in the morning, after lunch and a museum in Valparaiso, it was already 3.30pm so we had to rush to the wharf for a boat ride at 4pm which means we had no time at all to walk the hills of Valparaiso, instead we just rushed through a couple of famous streets in the bus and couldn’t take any decent photos, which was supposed to be the main purpose of the tour! Also I was the only person in the group that doesn’t speak Spanish/Portuguese and the guide explained everything only in Spanish. I don’t blame him because if you have this many people to manage, you wouldn’t have time to do your explanations twice. The tour was so badly organised that I believe they just wanted to grab as much money as possible without considering the experiences of the customers. Hi, Shaunimal, We are very sorry for what happened during your trip. We are always professionalizing so that we can offer the best tours and the best experiences to our clients and we will review the processes so that this does not happen again. Our team has been restructured and receives periodic training to always attend in an exceptional way. Our sincere apologies! Hugs, Team Digital Marketing Somos Tour
title: Valpraiso Not

review_text: My wife and I spent several hours at La Chascona and, even though we are not poetry-lovers or aficionados of South American history, we were quite taken with Neruda's personal story, political heroism, and bon vivant lifestyle. Don't miss this one.
title: A must-see in Santiago

review_text: A lovely day with Eduardo and Jose, exploring Viña del Mar and Valparaiso. The transport was very comfortable and relaxed and Eduardo’s commentary was insightful and delivered with humour and engagement. Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago A great option for those looking g to enjoy Valparaiso . Thank you for your review.
title: A great day out, sites and history combined

review_text: Our Tour Guide Alex was great and as well very helpful. Due to his jokes the Tour was very funny but as well informative. Thanks a lot for the great day. Review of: Private walking tour in Valparaíso
title: Great Guide and Tour

review_text: Never seen a Church constructed like this before. Wish we could have seen the inside Going into disrepair and I hope it is saved.
title: Interesting Buillding Material

review_text: The women that work here are scammers. They don’t operate their own tours and they selectively choose when they speak English. One of our tours was cancelled shortly after it started because of the rain. It was meant to be an all day tour. We asked the agency what happens to our money as we didn’t get what they promised. Suddenly their English was gone! No entendi! Crazy they spoke English before money was handed to them. We asked them what happens to our money if tomorrow’s tour is cancelled by the rain, they said “it probably won’t rain” The first sign something wasn’t right was when Martha wrote us a price for 5 days of tours and said everything is included. When we came back to pay, the owner was there and told us Martha forgot to charge us for this and for that and gave us a new price. They make it seem like the tour is operated by them but it’s another company. When you ask them what time the tour is, they don’t even know. Somewhere between 5:30am and 7 we were told. They won’t even look you in the eye when they’re talking to you. When you pass them on the street they don’t even say hello to you. They already have your money so they don’t care. Truly horrible people.
title: Their English was perfect until there was an issue. Suddenly it was “no entendi”.

review_text: Well worth a visit to the poet's house, which is full of his collections / adult toys. The house itself is also lovely design and the artist personality comes through. Good audio guide too. If you are a student, bring an ISIC card as you get 4000 pesos discount on entrance (general entry 6000 pesos, estudiantes 2000 pesos)
title: Intriguing and fun house

review_text: Unforgettable tour by Pedro, who gave us an excellent tasting. Excellent experience!! Very detailed explanation of the whole process of manufacturing the pisco.
title: Excellent tasting, very nice place and very friendly attention.

review_text: Matias was our morning tour guide eager to tell us about Chilean's daily lives here. By the end of the tour, I felt closer to this country, due mostly to Matias's personal touch during the tour. When our guide started explaining how the dictatorship started, there were local folks talking back to him (yes, some locals with a good command of English was listening to Matias was saying to us, and they were kind of disrupting our tour). Our guide, who is a proud Chilean, was speaking up against them. We didn't necessarily capture a good portion of the discussions as they were in Spanish, but I was able to see how the country could still be divided over what happened in their recent history, and Matias was taking a very candid approach, without trying to make the tour rosy just for us. I enjoyed the tour so much. I highly recommend this tour.
title: Lots of surprises

review_text: Lovely day trip out of the city Santiago to the beautiful country side and on to the twin coastal towns . From 8 am to 5.30 ish was a relaxed day with a good amount of attractions, information, sights and experiences. Vina del Mar and Valparaiso are historic, unique and colourful fishing villages expanded into cities but still retaining so much history and character. The street art is very cool and the architecture eclectic. Visiting a scenic winery for sampling on the way home was a lovely way to finish. Our guide Sebastian was knowledgeable, funny, clear, and accommodating. Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago This is a tour ment for those who want to escape to the coast visiting our culture, wines and more. We're glad you had a well round great trip with Sebastian, thank you for your review.
title: Perfect snapshot of Valparaiso and Vina del Mar

review_text: This coastal city is an old one and beautiful! Great food, breathtaking view and has deep history. The wall graffiti/murals are creative & colorful, exemplifying their Chilean culture. The city's unique labyrinth of cobbled alleys and colorful buildings reminds me a little of San Francisco, so be ready with good walking shoes to enjoy it. Eduardo from Turistik was an informative & great guide! We appreciate your comment dear traveler, it is very important for us to know about your experience.
title: Valparaiso, Chile is a must visit

review_text: Excellent place when you want to escape city traffic. You can take cable line up and walk down. Safe and nice.
title: Great part.

review_text: Venture Patagonia is a firm I highly recommend for first-time travelers to Torres Del Paine. Every step of the registration process was professional and detailed. Communication with Carrie and team in Chile was excellent. Torres base climb was terrific. I can honestly say that all seven members of the trip had a fantastic time. More importantly, though, I believe this is because we had an excellent guide (Victor) who prepared us well and made sure everyone was safe and comfortable. Our guide Victor really did an outstanding job communicating what to expect with the hike, every step of the way. He made sure we were all prepared and warned us of the potential hazards. I've been on far more technical hikes where the guide gave a quarter of the info Victor gave us for this relatively easy hike. Thank you again! Hello from team Venture Patagonia! We're so glad your day trek to the base of the towers with Victor as your guide worked out so well. We have wonderful local guides who truly love and appreciate Patagonia and enjoy sharing their lives and taking good care of our guests. We would enjoy welcoming you back to Puerto Natales for a longer stay should you have the chance to visit again. Best of luck on your next adventures! From all of us here in Chile, Carrie
title: Hike to the Base of the Towers, Torres Del Paine

review_text: The best way to get to know Santiago. It is a very comfortable and entertaining way to get to know and walk around the city. The people at Turistick are very friendly. Review of: Cable Car, Funicular and Sightseeing Bus in Santiago one day Estimado viajero, nos alegra saber que disfruto de su recorrido por nuestro Santiago, muchas gracias por compartir su experiencia con nosotros. ¡Esperamos su pronta visita!
title: Spectacular.

review_text: An amazing walk, an astronomy class with a teacher. He spoke about details of the constellations, showed the constellation of the flag of Brazil. The space dedicated to welcoming tourists is own with 4 telescopes. Super recomendo. I'm still waiting for the photos.
title: Cordiality

review_text: My husband and I booked 5 tours with Alabalti. The Piefra Rojas and Geiser del Tatio tours sere with Renata, an excellent guide. We definitely suggest Alabalti
title: Guided tours with Renata

review_text: Tour fine, punctual. Guides Matias and Gabriel very friendly. The rental experience: appalling, very disorganized (harder if you go with children, anyway, we all had suits). We went on a Wednesday in July and the park was oversold: 1 hour 40' to sledge; to climb to the other minimum level 35'. The tubbing we didn't even go because the queue was over an hour. The park very disorganized, slow, long waiting time between one sled group and the next; businesses ran out of water to sell. The place is beautiful but the experience in the park is very bad. A waste of time except for the landscapes and the inflatable for the little ones. Review of: Farellones Park Tour: Ticket Park, Transportation and Snow Clothing Agradecemos el tiempo que se tomó para comentarnos su experiencia.
title: Oversold park. Hard to enjoy.

review_text: Carolina met us in a cafe at 4:30 pm, shared recipes so that our group could choose what we wanted to make, took us to the open air market to choose our produce and protein and brought us back to the school to prepare and finally eat all our creations. We had a fantastic time and learned a lot about the Chilean cuisine. Traveling through Chile in the weeks that followed we had so much fun comparing the local takes on these same dishes! What an incredible dinner we made: baked clams, empanadas, pastel de choclo, pisco sours, a chilean salsa over delicious bread, tomato salad and flan; and how much more fun than just going to a restaurant. The school later sent us an email with all the recipes so we could make them at home. Carolina is a wonderful teacher and so much fun to spend the hours with. Our class was supposed to finish by 9:30 but we were having such an awesome festive evening I don't think we left until after 11 pm!!
title: wonderful way to spend the afternoon and evening in Valparaiso

review_text: We made the 3-day drive from San Pedro to Uyuni and what can I say? It was perfect! The organization and communication with Raúl was great! The tour was as promised. And it all worked. But the biggest highlight was our driver Eme! A real treasure. Super pleasant and safe driving style, friendly, calm and a walking lexicon. He responds super patiently to all wishes. Eme not only drove us safely through the Andes, he also took care in Uyuni that we got a good and safe transfer to Sucre. Best man! Anyone who has Eme as a driver for this adventurer has the best possible experience. Thanks to him for everything❤️
title: Awesome 3 days trip!

review_text: We wanted to see the Cerro de Santa Lucía on our last day in Santiago. Thought that a bit of green in the hurly burly of Santiago would be a good idea. The visit was not a disappointment although its virtually impossible to escape the sounds of traffic and the coy. Nonetheless, worth acvisit.
title: Oasis in the middle of Santiago

review_text: The walking tour through the market to pick up seasonal ingredients was very enlightening and beautiful. We saw common vegetables and meats, but also some preparations and varieties that were native to Chile. The chef was lovely and patient with all of us. I loved the smaller class, and the class location itself was BEAUTIFUL. The food and drinks were fresh and very delicious. What a great experience!
title: A Wonderful Way to Experience the Food and Culture of Santiago

review_text: We took the Milenko 1 boat at the caleta, we had to wait about 15 minutes till the tour started. The captain explains everything you are watching, and after 30 minutes, you arrive to the place where the “combate naval de Iquique” took place. The captain tells you the whole story about this Chilean heroes and when you arrive to the Boya, the place where the Esmeralda sunk, the chicken enthem starts and it’s really overwhelming. You take a trip to the past. A really nice and educating trip, you will enjoy it.
title: Nice trip

review_text: Took the morning market tour led by Karla. She is a great guide, very friendly and informative. She kept our group quite safe and organized in the streets. I learned a lot about the city on the tour in a very fun way. A highlight was Rojo, the dog, who accompanied us on the whole 3 hour tour! Great time!! I was so happy that I rented a bike for the afternoon and toured the city from end to end on my own. Well worth it! Very bike-friendly city!! Thank you so much majiemama for your 5 star review! Karla and Rojo are great tour leaders for sure. Hope to see you back on one of our green machines again soon! Take care, Peter
title: Santiago by bike is great!

review_text: A very scenic drive in a comfortable bus. Benjamin did a fine job telling us about the history and what we were seeing. The restaurant for lunch was nice overlooking the lake on this windy but sunny day. Review of: Inca Lagoon in Andes Mountain Range - Visit Local Vineyard with Tasting included
title: Very scenic drive

review_text: Very powerful photographic and video exhibits, mostly in Spanish, but some with English subtitles depicting human rights issues worldwide, and especially during the time of the military dictatorship in Chile. However, after awhile, it was hard to keep looking at the exhibits as the evidence of human cruelty was hard to take.
title: Very powerful exhibits

review_text: Hector and his team went above and beyond to make my and my boyfriend’s first visit to Santiago an exceptional one. We originally arranged private transfers with him to/from the airport and he was immediately welcoming and very informative as we drove into the city. Our plans with a different tour group for the next day fell through, so we reached out to HecTour for additional availability and he was very quick to put together an agenda similar to our original plans. He was able to get us into a wine tasting last minute, he showed us around Maipo Canyon and taught us a lot about the surrounding comunas and agriculture, and he took us to a wonderful mom-and-pop restaurant and some boutique shops based on our interests. We really appreciated his thoroughness and dedication in planning and historical knowledge. Experiencing the local culture is important to me when traveling and Hector really helped fulfill that. Hector is amazing at what he does and I recommend his service to anyone visiting Santiago!
title: Above and beyond!

review_text: Wonderful and flexible ship excursion at Puerto Montt to the area's lake cities.Miguel is enthusiastic, warm,informative and particularly helpful in dealing with our handicap accessible needs and accommodating our transfer chair. Requests to include outdoor art and horses in the tour were successfully met, above our expectations! Choices for a late morning cafe and and then an afternoon lunch in a well established Puerto Varas restaurant were gastronomic highlights. There's also a wonderful energy about Miguel that contributed to a wonderful day HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
title: Magical Ship Excursion

review_text: The trip to the Atacama desert was wonderful, only experiencing to feel every incredible record that the gaze made and the created memories that will be eternal. The program of the tours were well distributed in the days I stayed in San Pedro de Atacama. The experience with Mineiro in Chile was excellent, and “Chico” was very attentive in explaining the tours in the pre-sale and during the tours was very helpful when requested. Thank you Chico. Each tour I did had its particularity and all were performed with excellent guides, who clarified what each place was (origin, characteristics...), in addition to the moments for the fantastic photographic records that the places provide. This journey is high energy with what nature provides us.
title: What the eyes see, memory records.

review_text: Ashley was a wonderful guide and Mario a smooth driver. Started the day with Ashley’s commentary on the way on to a winery in Casablanca. I appreciated how effortlessly she switched between Spanish and English translation. Then, we headed to La Sebastiana (my personal reason for booking this tour) and toured the sights of Valparaiso and Viña Del Mar. It was a full day well spent. Definitely recommend booking! Review of: From Santiago: Valparaíso, Viña del Mar and Neruda Museum Thank you very much for sharing with us your memories and favorite moments of this trip. We would appreciate being able to see through photos perhaps how much you could know with this tour by tagging us on our social networks. We are glad that you were able to enjoy and get to know La Sebastiana, which is a very beautiful place full of history. Thank you for recommending us!
title: Definitely recommend!

review_text: Cerro Santa Lucia is great to walk up. It's not as high as Cerro San Cristobal, but still high enough to get some good views of the city. If you're lucky with the weather, you can see the Andes mountains. It's definitely one of the sites you should see while in Santiago!
title: Great views of the city

review_text: Very good knowledge and explaining by the guide. It was much fun, not like a standard round trip with an audio guide in your ear.
title: Very cool trip

review_text: Super organized company with excellent professionals. The guides are very knowledgeable and very lively
title: Vina Del Mar and Valparaiso

review_text: This is a world class museum in a location so unpretentious it is easy to miss. It houses the collection of Carlos Cardoen which is enormous and beautifully displayed. There is a short introductory video where Carlos Cardoen explains a bit about his collection, which takes you from prehistoric times through to the history of modern Chile. This is not to be missed.
title: OUTSTANDING!

review_text: Spectacular activity. Although there is no walking in the park, we had the opportunity to see a puma in action in front of us. The guide, Francisco, with very complete explanations in both Spanish and English. Review of: Full-Day Tour to Torres del Paine National Park from Puerto Natales(First Class)
title: In the Torres del Paine with a puma in action

review_text: Costanera is an interesting road which runs along the coast of Viña Del Mar, thus allowing for some great scenic views of the Pacific Ocean on one side and several interesting buildings on the other. Certainly would recommend traveling on this road to any tourist.

review_text: I was very well looked after at the agency by Walter to take the Astronomical Tour. He answered all my doubts and helped me make sure everything went the way we wanted. The tour was very pleasant! Good professionals and diverse cocktail! I recommend!

A gente ama saber que você se sentiu bem desde o primeiro contato até o último passeio! Obrigada por embarcar com a gente nessa jornada cheia de descobertas. Volte sempre, viu? 💜

review_text: All perfect. I have gone on many vineyard tours and wine tasting, but without a doubt this is a wonderful experience, all thanks to the pleasant and instructive hostess and guide Fernanda. You can see his passion and knowledge. Review of: Small Group Wines and Flavours Guided Walking Tour

review_text: I did a very ling hike....more than 8 hours, slowly, enjoyable, perceiving each moment of the walk, up to the top hill, along this unique, amazing peace of Nature! In this beautiful Araucaria Forest, I felt magic sensation, I can't explain! Along the hike I founded splendid waterfalls, and so many birds absolutely not afraid of human presence.......fantastic!
title: Life is wonderful!

review_text: Excellent attention from reception to the end, all very professional and delicate, they are always asking if we are comfortable.
title: Attention 10/10

review_text: Fabulous 3 day tour – Michael (The German Pirate) is great! Day 1 - Michael picked us up from Star Princess along with two German couples that we met on the ship and gave us an amazing tour. Experienced Chile’s Wall Street, funiculars, amazing views, old and new and learned quite a bit about life in Valparaiso and Chile (he speaks English, German and Spanish). Saw a historical old Anglican church. Very informative and knowledgeable, seems to know everyone and everything and we saw great spots off the beaten path. Shared a cold beer in an old German bar (try to pick up the white mug), had a nice lunch with a view – thoroughly enjoyable, highly recommend, a great time had by all. Made nice suggestion for dinner at La Concepcion as we stayed in Valparaiso and he took the others to Santiago. Day 2 – Picked up at Hotel Manoir Atkinson (very nice hotel) along with a young astronomer PhD student from Bamberg and took us sightseeing. Toured the beautiful coast, Casablanca valley wine and champagne taste testing, Isla Negra Casa de Pablo Neruda, Quintay whale village for fresh local Congrio fish lunch, visited Chilean friend’s home and museum, strolled an amazing beach – great day. Day 3 – Tour and transfer to Santiago – saw Vina del Mar, Renaca, Concon, Horcon (an old hippie village) where we saw pelicans and ate ceviche and watched a boat being brought out of the water by horse, visited a waterfront cemetery, Papudo and Zapallar (most expensive area), walked to see penguins and beautiful breathtaking views. Drove us through the coastal mountains to Santiago – great information, felt so comfortable. What an experience - it was so worthwhile and would highly recommend to anyone visiting Valparaiso and area. GREAT JOB MICHAEL – KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK. You are a terrific guide and nice person. Keep on smiling !!! Review of: Discover the treasures of Valparaiso with a local
title: Amazing Experience - Totally Worthwhile - Highly Recommend

review_text: Visiting the Paine Tower National Park was one of the experiences we will carry with us forever, and this was made possible mainly thanks to Jhon. From the first moment he proved to be an exceptional guide: competent, passionate and incredibly attentive to every detail. He quickly learned the names of the whole group (17 people), and exposed his knowledge of the park making us feel completely immersed in the wilderness. We spotted and photographed closely: guanaco and condor as well as beautiful landscapes. I highly recommend Jhon and Jorge as escorts for those who want to visit the Paine park and the Cueva del Milodon. Review of: Transporte Compartido de Puerto Natales a Lago Grey (RT o OW) Grazie mille per il tuo meraviglioso commento! Siamo lieti che la tua esperienza nel Parco Nazionale Torres del Paine sia stata indimenticabile. Jhon e Jorge saranno sicuramente felici di sapere quanto il loro lavoro e la loro passione abbiano contribuito a rendere speciale il loro viaggio. La tua descrizione cattura perfettamente la magia della Patagonia: natura selvaggia, incontri ravvicinati con la fauna locale, panorami mozzafiato. e non meno importante condividere momenti indimenticabili con persone meravigliose. Speriamo di darvi il benvenuto di nuovo in futuro.
title: An unforgettable experience thanks to Jorge y Jhon!!!

review_text: This tour was probably the hilight of my trip to Chile. The whole day was amazing, despite experiencing a freak snow storm! The crew improvised and still made the day special. If you are going to do one thing while you are here, I recomend this experience. Review of: Santiago: Cajón del Maipo, Hot Springs, Waterfall & Chilean BBQ
title: A unique experience

review_text: this is a very nice, short walk up a small hill overlooking much of Santiago. you will be rewarded with a panoramic view of the city and also the Andes to the north/east, assuming there's not much smog about. there are also a small garden, a catholic sanctuary, a small shop, and some limited dining facilities at the top. the elevation gain is only about 1000 feet (300 meters), and the grade is not steep. in parts the surface is a bit irregular, but most all people will have absolutely no trouble at all navigating it. to get to the trail, simply walk several hundred meters along the road that winds to the left (west) of the visitor information booth at the north end of Avenida Pio Nono - this road (Manuel Mackenna) will bring you to an obvious (though i don't think obviously sign-posted) trail veering up the hill a bit more steeply to your right. alternatively you can take the cable car if you're pressed for time or don't want to walk. just don't do what we did right before we walked to the top on a hot (high 90s F) late afternoon in January - polish off a whole pizza and guzzle a couple of (at the time) refreshing local beers right before we took this otherwise enjoyable stroll….
title: short walk for great views, just be prepared...

review_text: This seems to be a less popular area of the park, although not obvious to me why that is so. It is yet another jaw dropping location within the park, with the laguna back dropped by the Torres del Paine. On a sunny day, with gleaming snow topped mountains, the blue lake, the yellow flowers, the grazing horses, it was spectacular. As was the wind off the lake....! Just up the road from the ranger station, there is a fabulous hike up and over a hill densely populated by guanacos, and with a good slice of forest. So good, we went twice.
title: Superlative

review_text: A great museum to get a lesson in the coup subsequent dictator ship and human rights violation in the 1970-80's.
title: A must-see for visitors to Chile

review_text: JP was amazing. Great tour, got to explore a bit, the information was interesting, food and wine were fantastic. Overall, a lot of fun and will sign up again when we come back. Review of: Full-Day Valparaíso Private Tour with Vehicle Thank you very much! It is always a pleasure to serve and also receive the appreciation of our most appreciated customers for a job well done!
title: JP is amazing!

review_text: We visited this second largest Hill in Santiago with the Statue of the Virgin Mary, Immaculate Conception, at the top. We walk up the Steep dirt path which would have been even more arduous on a very hot day. Church at the top and the views are pretty amazing and less Santiago is having a very smoggy day. The funicular was not working, but the sky way gandola was interesting and fun. It was very dry and there was not much in bloom in the park until you got to the Landscaping at the top.
title: Lovely park with a steep climb path or a slow long climb path to the top.

review_text: Great museum - full of information. Pay the extra fee for the audio presentation (available in English and many other languages). Even in Spanish, you would be lost I think the cost was like $2,000 pesos. It is FREE to enter the museum. Plan to spend 3-4 hours. Wear comfortable shoes. Bring a sweater because it can get pretty chilly in this place and you are not going to want to rush out. Beautiful building with a tremendous amount of information. VERY EASY TO GET TO. Just take the Metro (Line #5/the Green line) to the "Quinta Normal" station. You should walk upstairs to Matucana Street. The museum is literally right across the street from the station. Step outside of the station, walk towards the street and the museum should be directly to your left. (Big green, glass building). Walk to the rear of the building and you will find the main entrance there. PLEASE, IF YOU FOUND THIS REVIEW HELPFUL THEN CLICK ON THE BUTTON BELOW: "Did you find this review helpful?" I TRY TO PROVIDE AS MUCH DETAILED INFORMATION AS POSSIBLE AND I JUST LIKE TO KNOW IF I AM HELPING PEOPLE ALONG THE WAY. THANK YOU.
title: Great Museum to Visit/Easily Accessible by METRO.

This guy REALLY loves the city of Santiago and will show you the off the beaten path parts of the city you would never find on your own. We had a 7 hour layover and his taxi driver friend picked us up at the airport. 30 minutes later we were on our bikes flying around the city. Its a great way to spend a few hours. Highly recommend this guy and his company. Thanks Andreas.

review_text: We chose to come to these thermals as they are cheapest ones in Pucon (by about 1/3 of the price of others). From Pucon we took a $3 bus to right outside Los Pozones. The place is quite run down and difficult to figure out which pool is which. I would say they are still a little pricey for what you are getting at the end of the day compared to other thermal pools I have visted. If you are on a budget however and are wanting to relax, I would reccomend these thermals as you still get to experience relaxing in the hot water!
title: Cheapest hot thermals in Pucon

review_text: I was so excited to finally get the opportunity to visit Lapostelle in December with a group of girlfriends. My husband and I tried to go previously but were unable to as this is one of the few wineries in Chile that doesn't allow children. The building itself is spectacular - an architectural wonder, with a spiral staircase going underground and all of the wine making process happening via gravity (with the wine moving downward in the building with each stage). The cellar at the bottom looks like it is from a James Bond movie - all glass, with the entrance forming the tasting table, so you look down into the cellar as you taste the wines. The wines in the tasting were awesome and included a few wines I had not tried before. I've been to a lot of wineries in Colchagua Valley, Casablanca Valley, Maipo Valley and near the coast (Leyda Valley) and this was my favourite tasting tour. Highly recommend!
title: Spectacular facility, excellent tasting

review_text: Our family, including two children with little prior horseback riding experience, enjoyed this horseback riding tour twice during our December holiday stay in Santiago. First tour was with Claudia and her sister, Francesca. Absolutely wonderful day, with on-time pickup at the hotel and a quick drive up to the Lo Barnechea area ranch house. The horses were traditional Chilean horses, acclimated to the mountain trails, matched to the kids' capabilities, and responsive to the individual riders. The trails themselves go up and down over a series of ridges and valleys, with spectacular views of the mountains and the city. Natural elements, both flora and fauna abound, with opportunities for photos literally everywhere. Claudia took all our photos for us, so that we could focus on enjoying the ride, and later sent us the photos for download via Google drive. We ended the day with a fantastic picnic lunch of veg, meats, cheeses, fruits, olives, and Chilean wine (Claudia even brought fresh lettuces from her garden for our wraps). Our second time 'round was just as spectacular, this time with Lorraine as our guide. Again, horses matched to capabilities, with a ride up and down through the mountain trails - different routes from the first, and ending with another wonderful picnic lunch. Highly recommend this tour, the guides are very knowledgeable and friendly, the arrieros (Chilean cowboys) take care of everything related to the horse, the views and food are spectacular, and the proximity to Santiago makes it so convenient! Review of: Authentic horseback ride with Chilean Cowboys in the Andes close to Santiago! Hello! Wow what an honour you booked this tour twice with us! Thank you so much and keep us in mind for a next trip to Chile! Warm regards, Suzanne.
title: Horseback Riding in the Andes

review_text: It is very hard to describe Miscanti and Miñiques lagoons - don't be afraid of driving so many kms, your eyes, and also your soul, will thank you!

review_text: Run by Lago Grey Hotel who have monopoly and thus charge what I feel to be an excessive ~US$100 for a less than three hour trip. Went late April with only one sailing per day at 3pm. 35 min walk to the boat across moraine is easy but clearly not for wheelchairs. The glaciar is split into three at the water level by rocks, and each tongue is quite different. Amazing ice bergs including almost translucent green bergs, see photos. Havent seen these before in either Alaska or Antartica. Would recommend.
title: Nice trip, a little expensive.

review_text: The tour was nice, but if I was to do it again, I would look for transfer only, as I don't believe it was worth the money. They pick you up from your accommodation and drop you at your accommodation or within walking distance to it. You'll get to see some nice views and walk around the water retention "lake" and mountains around. The picnic involves crisps, a small glass of wine, some salami, cheese, crackers, cream cheese and juice. You're not going to have it by the water (some pictures may suggest that). You'll visit the town of San Jose de Maipo and walk around main square full of souvenirs and crafts. You can also have lunch in one of the restaurants there. You'll also visit an independent, "chocolate house", where you can buy some treats (there's no tour of chocolate making process). Our van broke down, but the driver was great and organize replacement very quickly. The guide was also great, cracking jokes and making everyone enjoy the tour. To international tourists: Chile is expensive and not really worth a visit. Neighbouring Bolivia has so much more to offer and is far far cheaper! In Chile, there is a discrimination fee at ATMs; every time you're getting cash, you'll need to pay extra. It's a way of greedy banks here, saying "welcome" to foreigners. Review of: Small-Group Cajón del Maipo Full-Day Tour and Picnic Thank you for your comment! We're super happy to know you enjoyed your tour and thank you so much for your feedback that helps us bring a better service to all our costumers. Best regards, MTO Tour Team

review_text: The view from here at night is impressive. You see most of Santiago in a 180 degrees vista. Day time often gives a hazy view but at night you see the whole city lit up. The statue of the Virgin is impressive, and the Chileans say it may be smaller that the one in Rio, but "we have the mother" of the Rio Christ the Redeemer statue. Well worth an hour of your time.
title: You should come at night

review_text: On our trip we visited Santiago, Valparaíso and the Casablanca Valley, and then went down to cold Patagonia, to see penguins in Punta Arenas and enjoy the brutal landscapes of Torres del Paine and the Puerto Natales area. From there we went up to San Pedro de Atacama, where the desert embraced us with its sand and suffocating heat. And finally the Uyuni salt flat, an experience not suitable for all audiences, due to the tiring nature of the tour in a 4x4 jeep, at 5000 meters above sea level. Well, all this, in 17 days and organized spectacularly by Chile on the Go, optimizing times (on this trip we slept very little) and adapting the itinerary at all times to the changes we proposed. Karina was 24x7 as a contact person on WhatsApp, she has been the link between us and the local agencies. We have been informed daily of transfer schedules, pick-ups for excursions, etc. Being 12,000km away, it is very appreciated to have the certainty that someone is on the other side for anything that may happen to you. I recommend 100x100 Chile on the Go, and Argentina on the Go will be the agency we will contact to give us another crazy route through the neighboring country. Delfi, Karina: thank you ☺️
title: Fulfilling dreams: Chile + Bolivia

review_text: We had a Quod Tour with this local company when in Atacama. San Pedro de Atacama is a very small town and is the base of all the excursions in the Atacama Desert (salar, geysers, valleys, etc.). Is a town that rely on tourism and this has caused the flowering of plenty of tour agencies that sometimes are not properly reliable. The spirit of this family owned agency is completely different. They don't hook or stalk the tourist while walking in the center of the town, but work firstly with tour operators. This grant them a stricter control that is trasformed in a very good professionality. All the equipments given were clean, new and of the best quality, so the Quod. I was with my son of 8 and all was managed caring of him, also regarding the size of material. Is clear that the guide / owner knows what he does in every moment. If you are looking for something to do in Atacama out of the ordinary mass activities, I strongly suggest to contact this agency. Review of: Guided Buggy Safari

review_text: SEN is a great opportunity to get to know Chile, Santiago, and loads of people from all over the world! Very enthusiastic staff, lots of fun and amazing journeys - I can only highly recommend this organization that will do everything to make your stay in Chile an unforgettable experience!

Thank you very much Pedro, I continued with that eloquence in explaining
title: The best tour and exquisite tasting

review_text: Fun drive in Summer could be harrowing in winter with numerous switchbacks, some with and some without guardrails. The higher you get the more exposed the surface. The bikingis limited to one lift and a few trails, a limited concession area and seating. Very important,,,, there are no rental equipment here whatsoever. You must bring a bike up or you don't ride. But, there is rarely a crowd for mountain biking, they have a small pump track near the bottom of the lift. Best of all the trails are really fun. Some exposed, some wide open and a bit of flow at the bottom. When it is winter in the Northern Hemisphere, it is perfect riding weather down here. Bone dry and chrystal clear skies. Remember, it's not Whistler so don't compare or you'll be disappointed. It's Chile and it's a blast!
title: Limited facilites but impressive mountain.

review_text: Top-rated tour I ever took with the agency. It was the one with red stones!. Better pricing if you get more people (expensive if solo).

review_text: We are Australians from the West coast and we are unused to the extremes of temperatures that exist here; however, it was worth it to see so many different kinds of flamingos. We've seen them in Africa and it was a surprise to find them having varied appearances. We ate breakfast here and it was brilliant to walk around and view the flamingos.
title: Wow! -12 degrees at 6am.. worth it!

review_text: Such an awesome experience! We loved our day trip to Valparaiso and Viña Del Mar, and highly recommend it for anyone looking to explore these beautiful areas while visiting Santiago. Our tour guide Helen was PHENOMENAL, too! Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago

review_text: I ended up taking three different tours with three different agencies while I was in Atacama (due to scheduling/availability) and Gato Andino’s level of service was definitely superior to the others, even though it was similarly priced. I did the Geysirs tour with them and I can’t say enough wonderful things about our guide Connie. She brought a level of energy and fun that was absolutely needed for a 5am departure. She was also a fantastic photographer and made an effort to ensure our tour was as far from the crowds and as personal as possible. I wish I’d been able to take all my tours with this agency and with Connie in particular.

review_text: It was a wonderful experience. The work done by guide John Pineda was exceptional. He gave us invaluable tourist information. Very nice the way you give that information and you noticed the professionalism and love you have for your work. Driver Jorge also did a very good job. Review of: Full Day Tour to Torres del Paine National Park

review_text: We did the full-day kayak trip on the fjord and it was really amazing! Jass is super friendly and knowledgable about the history and culture of the area. During the transfer to Cochamó, she gave us lots of interesting bits of information, which was great! The fjord was beautiful!! Water so blue and gorgeous views. The kayaking was nice and easy. Definitely a work out for the arms! But doable for beginners. There was no rush for us. We stopped for lunch on a local farm owned by a woman named Yolanda and she had cooked a delicious meal with vegetables and meat straight from her farm! It tasted so fresh and tasty! Yolanda even shared a Mate with us, which was my highlight :) Jass showed us around the farm, giving us information about what was grown there and what they did in their workshops. It is a really wonderful traditional farm. And also, she had been taking pictures with her water proof camera, which meant we didn't have to risk bringing our phones out, but still had great photos from the day! Totally worth the trip!! Review of: Kayaking at Poza
title: Great day of kayaking and visiting a traditional Chilean farm!

review_text: All the expectations we had of this tour, adrenaline, fun and safety were met, all the managers showed professionalism in their work and cared that we understood all the instructions and enjoyed the experience. It should be considered that there is a section that you should walk and climb the banks of the river, this took us by surprise, outside of that everything was what we expected and we got a pleasant memory (the photos are fantastic). Review of: Winter Rafting in Pucon Nos alegra leer tu experiencia! gracias por elegirnos para llevarla a cabo, esperamos verlos en otra oportunidad! :D

review_text: Amazing experience all around. Such a great way to visit the vineyards of Chile. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and personal. A must do for anyone visiting Chile. Thanks so much Frank T for your kind words. Happy you enjoyed our country, our guide and... definitely the wine our land gives up to us! Come back soon! Peter
