review_text: We arrived without reservation, and were seated under the pergola, to one of the finest lunches in Casablanca Valley. We enjoyed their Syrah with two of the most delicious prepared cuts of beef. We were well served and the location was idea, light breeze, sunny day, and delicious foods and wine. What a restful atmosphere! We are happy to recommend Tanino restaurant and the fine wines of Vina Casas del Bosque!
title: Winery and Restaurant an Afternoon Delight

review_text: Visited this winery our last day in Chile and so glad we did. Quality of wine was fantastic. Carlos was knowledgeable and quick to follow up with name of local distributor in our hometown. Dear Jean, Thank you so much for your visit, is always good to see that you really enjoyed from our winery and wines. We wish you a great year, and hope to see you again. Best regards from Viña Maquis, Colchagua valley
title: Beautiful location and quality wines!

review_text: We've been several times, to orchestral concerts and plays. Although the building is now in need to a re-decoration, you can still see its ancient splendour. The box office (to the right a you enter) almost always has tickets available, and they are not expensive by European standards. The quality of the performances is excellent, so it is worth a visit.
title: Good performances and not expensive

review_text: Beautiful lagoons, it's worth taking the trip. I didn't go into the water because it was very cold and there was no facility to change clothes. the guide threw a little water to remove excess salt and changed inside the van. There are other agencies that advise you to go to the bathroom at the entrance to change, but it is a good walk from the lagoon where you are allowed to enter.
title: Beautiful lagoons

review_text: I traveled to Santiago, Chile for business and my wife was able to join me for the trip. After the work trip we decided to stay for a couple of extra days and the W Santiago helped connect us with Daniel and Esteban at Servitour to do some local tours. I didn't realize that the Maipo Valley was so close to Santiago. Servitour put together a phenomenal wine tour for us on short notice in the Maipo Valley. They spoke fluent English and organized private premium tours at Santa Rita Winery and at Haras de Pirque. These were some of our favorite wine tours we have taken in South America. After the wine tours they took us to a great local lunch spot called La Covacha where we enjoyed sensational local cuisine. The ease in which all of this was put together with Servitour was truly amazing. We had such a wonderful and easy time arranging everything that we asked them to put together another tour the following day on short notice, which they executed to perfection. Our experience in the Maipo Valley rivaled that of Mendoza. We were blown away by the beauty of the wineries and the taste of the wine. We would definitely go back for another great adventure. We can't recommend Servitour enough to you all. Review of: Maipo Valley Experience Dear Robert, What an ABSOLUTELY fantastic review! 🤩 It was a true pleasure for Esteban and me to help you and your wife enojoy the Maipo Valley. We're so happy to hear that the wine tours were highlights of your South American travels, as well as lunch :) We pride ourselves on making everything seamless and enjoyable for our guests, and your kind words truly mean a lot to us. We'd love to welcome you back to Chile for another great adventure whenever you're ready! Thanks again for your incredibly kind recommendation. 🙏
title: Phenomenal Experience in the Maipo Valley

review_text: Nia and isaac dupre were our guides, both very friendly, both knowledgeable of the place, attentive and willing that we had a good experience and so it was, recommended
title: Antilen experience

review_text: Was great, the attention of the agency and our Guide Isidora spectacular, had a lot of experience, very nice, exquisite vituperio Review of: Half Day Tour to Valle de la Luna
title: Tour genial

review_text: This is a nice, casual environment for chatting with friends. Good service, good cider, good Chilean-style pub food. The prices are very good also. The entrance is into a patio / walkway off the street first, then you will find doors leading into the pub. This place came on the recommendation of locals two years ago on my first visit to Temuco, and I go back every time I’m in town. It is a consistent experience. Definitely would recommend.
title: Nice pub environment, Chilean cider

review_text: The tour (21.000 clp) is a 2 hour ride from La Serena. The tour takes a boat around Punta Choros where you may see Humbolt Penguins (depending on the season). 50/50 chance of seeing dophins on your boat ride (we saw two). Walked around the Isla Damas for about an hour.
title: A must see excursion

review_text: The afternoon tour of the national park end here so tourists can view the sunset which is spectacular. The colours change as the sun descends and it is beautiful.
title: Sunset views are ever changing

review_text: Even in the rain, the ride was really cool. The winery is beautiful! But the guide really made all the difference! Special thanks to the guide Germán! He was very helpful, friendly and fun throughout the tour. We were a family with our young son and the guide made the tour a lot of fun for him too! Tasting of 3 very different wines. If you're not in a hurry, at the entrance you can also taste premium wines (paid extra). Shop with a variety of souvenirs. Review of: Undurraga Sibaris Tour Ticket
title: We liked the tour.

review_text: We were a group of 6. Only two made it to the top because we were going to fast. I made it together with somebody from Texas to the top. My nightmare started when we went down. The guide was more or less running down over a slippery surface. At the beginning I was somewhat capable to follow. After a third of our way down we met another group going up (they started 20 min after us so you can see how fast we were up and down). Our guide waited for us when he saw the group. After the group passed he continued going down ignoring that we asked for a break. He said later (later was at the car!). The problem was that he had my water in his backpack. He was so fast that I could not even ask for my water. After a short period of time I lost clear visual contact and were not totally clear what the best way going down would be. I felt twice because of the slippery ground. I was lucky only to fell on my hips (The bruises reminded my for a couple of days on this tour). Our "guide" was so far ahead that he not even noticed this! So bottom line our "guide" left his group, the people he is responsible for, alone!!! I still struggle to believe this. When I finally arrived at the car he wasn't asking how we are doing. He pushed us in the car and started (the car was already running when I arrived). I was totally exhausted with headache and thirsty. Even to weak to complain. My wife's experience during the same tour with this "guide" was as bad as mine but different. We complained at the agency. They recommended to write the owner Christian a WhatsApp what we did. Long story short he was more or less ignoring us, not even apologizing and saying he will take care that something like this will not happen again! I asked him 3 times. His response was he has to talk to his guys but he never came back with an answer. We were lucky that we did this tour after our outstanding horseback riding tour. Otherwise I would not be sure that we would be capable to do the horseback riding tour. Stay away from this company if you want for sure a great and secure volcano tour! They are not taking responsibility and have a bad customer service.
title: A sad and dangerous experience!

review_text: Tough first 3/4 hrs, but the final lookpoint had one of the best views I've ever seen in my entire life. Try to go on a clear day or when there are high clouds so you can see all the volcanoes. Very beautiful old forests along the way and the Sanctuary adm gives you a really nice map of the trail. Only 30mins outside Pucon. Totally worth It.
title: Tough but you'll not regret it

review_text: The view was incredible and the wines spectacular. The tour was private and we appreciated everything that was possible to know. Indo pro Chile was perfect as well as the guide. Thank you very much for the tour.
title: Spectacular tour

review_text: This experience was exceptional. The vineyards were fantastic and there wasn’t a bad wine. I will say, Vinamar was definitely my favorite tasting. If you can, upgrade to the 5 tasting flight, well worth it and the tasting of that flight is one of my favorite drinks of all time. Gabriel, the driver, was also exceptional. He always went out of his way to ensure all attendees were taken care of and any possible problems avoided. Very good attention to detail by Gabriel. He’s also personable, which adds to the experience. Bottom line: don’t do a wine tour unless it’s with this company and Gabriel. Finally, the lunch we had was easy top 3 meals I’ve ever had. Easily!! Review of: Exclusive wineries in Casablanca Valley & Tanino Restaurant
title: Exceptional…. Chef’s kiss of excellence for this tour.

review_text: Easy to find and hike forest preserve with very few visitors! My family of 4 took a taxi from the ship port for about $10 each way to the reserve and then hiked on our own in the reserve. No entrance fee--but very helpful park rangers who got us to the pathway and gave us a map. The hike was like a fairy tale forest and beautiful. Very windy and cold at the top so wear layers! good signage in park and wonderful day trip from our cruise ship
title: Fairy inspired forest hike

review_text: very well organized tour, visiting small wineries. Person to person approach visiting family owned small wine producers. I strongly reccomend them!
title: Enjoyable wine tour!!!

review_text: A fantastic insight into the life of explorers and crew back in the 1500s. Full sized replica of Magellan's ship as well as one of (more recent) HMS Beagle. Crawl in/around/over and get a real sense of conditions in those times - accentuated by being in May on the Straits of Magellan to reinforce how lousy the weather conditions can be. Just wandered around - plenty of information on boards around the ships - Best 5000 pesos I've ever spent ! Access by car, taxi, colectivos ( I think), or local bus to the hospital and a 2.5 km walk. Thoroughly recommended.
title: Ship Musseum Punta Arenas

review_text: I found it great and had a beautiful view when going down the cable car. Near the cable car there is an ice cream shop and some refrigerators selling drinks. I suggest that when you go down, go walking to the SKY Costanera, stay very close! Que ótimo que você aproveitou a vista! E sua sugestão é excelente! Caminhar até o SKY Costanera depois do teleférico é uma ótima maneira de continuar aproveitando a vista incrível de Santiago. 😍 Agradecemos o feedback e esperamos que tenha uma próxima experiência ainda melhor!
title: Great walk

review_text: It was easily accessible to all travellers and beautiful. We would not have seen it on our own but it was part of the Cruceandino tour.
title: The cascades were a surprise part of the lake crossing tour

review_text: I have seen Stomp recently in this theatre with my gf. Both of us thought it was a great show, one of the best I have seen for my part. Music and performance deserve a go.
title: A great show

review_text: The best thermals of Chile of that there is no doubt, very good attention very clean the impeque baths and the best of all beer and sandwiches and pizza lol thank you thermals of the sun for giving peace and being able to visualize nature.
title: The most beautiful place of chili

review_text: Love the trip our guide Sebastian and driver Poncho were attentive . The group was small which is always very nice . Thank you for a lovely day Review of: Maipo Valley Wine Tour with 4 vineyards from Santiago. A perfect option to enjoy wines, landscapes and nice company. We're glad you had a great time. Thank you for your review.
title: Wonderful day

review_text: This was another gem, away from the big crowds of TdP. - no cost, no pretense, just beauty and about 10 miles beyond airport - very close to town. Just follow the road (9) north out Puerto Natales and watch for the sign on your left fork Laguna Sofia. We drove up fr a last morning, dawn walk, and wish that we had left more time for hiking much further. Parking is adjacent to a beautiful dark gravel beach, which is about a half mile long and a nice walk. On our return, we realized that there was a nice trail to the left along the edge of the lagoon under the bluff, and we only went out about 15 minutes on this. It looked as if we could have gone much further, but our flight beckoned. It should be noted that there is probably parking for 20-30 cars, and 4-5 groups were camping. Review of: Trekking Laguna Sofia
title: Patagonia Beauty not more than 20 minutes from airport

review_text: I can't say enough about Torres del Paine. It was an incredible experience to finish the W trek in TDP. The scenery cannot be beat anywhere you look. There are glaciers to see, mountains to climb and gorgeous lakes admire and more. Whether you are camping or using the refugios, the facilities are great and the park is well organized. The park is clean, you get fresh air and you can even drink the pure stream water! Trails are very well marked and you cannot have a bad experience here. DON'T MISS IT!! - Adriane and Manu RoamandFind.com
title: FANTASTIC, AMAZING, SUPERB Experience

review_text: Our tour with Raul(the driver) and Christian our tour guide was absolutely incredible and I cannot recommend them enough. Christian was very knowledgeable about not only the main points of interest but also about the local flora and fauna, animals, history, heritage and monuments. Raul our driver had a super comfortable ride and was a safe driver. We had an absolute blast with the both of them! They stop at all of the awesome photo locations and have no problem letting us spend time at any and all locations. Review of: Private Torres del Paine & Milodon, departing from Punta Arenas Dear friend, Thank you for sharing your amazing experience with us on the Full Day Torres del Paine Private tour. We are thrilled to hear that you had an incredible time with our team of guides, Raul and Christian. It's wonderful to know that Christian's extensive knowledge and passion for the region enhanced your tour. From the main points of interest to the local flora, fauna, history, heritage, and monuments, he made sure to provide you with a comprehensive and insightful experience. We take pride in our guides' expertise and their ability to share fascinating information with our guests. We're also glad to hear that Raul's driving made you feel safe and comfortable throughout the journey. Your safety and comfort are always our top priorities, and we're delighted that Raul provided a smooth and enjoyable ride. It brings us joy to learn that you had an absolute blast with both Christian and Raul. Their willingness to stop at all the awesome photo locations and allow you to spend time at each spot shows their dedication to ensuring you have a memorable and personalized tour experience. Thank you for recommending our tour and guides. Your kind words mean a lot to us, and we truly appreciate your support. If you ever plan to visit the area again, we would be honored to welcome you back and provide you with another incredible adventure. Warmest regards, The Amigos Patagonia Team
title: Amazing tour and guides!

review_text: Worth a visit, great spot to have happy hour drinks in the 'patio' area. But if eating walk the side streets, especially at weekends, which have great restaurants and seating on the pavements
title: Trendy area, best in the evening

review_text: Under excellent company, made the tours, all went out perfect. Sometimes it's late, but it's something that happens in life. A matter of minutes, right? No more traffic. I bought with the boys at the Central Market. A store in the Central Market of Santiago. The phone I used as a contact is 569-2745-2809. This was the contact phone I used to be able to know where the store is, I went there to meet. And then I bought it there. There I was able to pay by card, but also had the option of Pix. The service was very good, it was wonderful. I recommend it to everyone, okay? I did the Walk by the Sun in the Mountains. I took the Cajón del Maipo tour in Balce, and that contained the hills. I took the tour to Valparaíso and Vinha do Mar and Isla Negra with a winemaker and the largest pool in the world. Or the second major, if I'm not mistaken. The boys explained it to me. So thank you for your patience, thank you very much. I recommend 100%.
title: Best experience thanks to Alfatur Chile

review_text: Wonderful day going through Valparaiso and Vina Del Mar! Our tour guide Salvador was super engaging throughout the day and made some really good stops throughout that provide a ton of opportunity for good photos and great historical context. Also loved his musical additions during the commute out from Santiago that added a great personal touch to the experience. Loved the boat ride tour in Valparaiso as well! Thank you for making this visit to Chile incredible :) Review of: Full Day Guided Tour Viña del Mar and Valparaíso from Santiago
title: Salvador and the Wonderful Trip to Valparaiso and Vina del Mar

review_text: The tour is worth it just to visit the stunning location and facilities of the Destilería. The tour is professionally done and shows you each part of the process and offers a tasting down in the cellars of at least three of their piscos. Afterwards, you can stop at their restaurant for another drink and some food. Highly recommended!
title: Excellent tour

review_text: It was a great experience , two types of pengunis sharing the same habitat isnt very common plus we could take great pictures We were very lucky and spotted whales and dolphins couldnt ask for more, thanks to the staff in route sur travel they did an amazing job
title: Chiloe , penguins and nature

review_text: Truly the most amazing desert beauty I've ever seen! It's not cheap to go to & stay in San Pedro, you really can't leave Chile without having seen this place. 3 days / 2 nights is plenty of time for San Pedro
title: Compulsory stop

review_text: Termas de Chillan is a place full of trees and pines, the landscapes are breathtaking. It has two nearby volcanoes and you can see the smokes. I am not a pro skier so the snow and ski routes were ok for me and my family.
title: Wonderful landscapes..still expensive

review_text: Couldn't say enough positive things about the Venture team. They made our trip so unique/perfect/flexible. My friends and I did a 9 day horse trip through a few areas and they were able to find bespoke cabins for us to stay at that we never would have had access too. The chefs they hired for us were hands down some of the best food and I loved that I just didn't have to worry about a thing. Patagonia has such variable weather that it also felt so helpful to have them on the ground and able to change the itinerary based on what the conditions are. I travel very often and it's rare that I think someone else can plan a trip better than I can, in this case I bow down to the venture team and wouldn't 1000% recommend them to make your trip easier, better, and more authentic. I'll be going with them again in the future. Thank you so much for your thorough and wonderful review. We enjoyed planning your unique adventure in Patagonia. We truly strive to make each traveler's trip exactly what they are dreaming of and also to include some experiences that you don't expect, to enhance your entire trip. We can't wait to see you again! All the best, Carrie
title: 15/10. absolutely made our trip better

review_text: A very enjoyable and comprehensive tour of the highlights of Santiago. Franco is an excellent guide and gave us a good insight into the history of Santiago and Chile. Highly recommended.
title: Frano is a great guide

review_text: We had a really good experience, all tours were puctual, the breakfast and lunchs included were high quality and the tour guides also amazing. They were always ready to answer our doubts through whatsaspp. O strongly recommend!! Good afternoon! We are happy with your satisfaction. Thanks for the feedback.
title: Great experience!!!

review_text: First of all, despite my many attempts to book this tour, it was made impossible by the front desk staff - just to make sure I am not reviewing the tour itself, but the service. We got so tired of going there in person over and over to confirm and reconfirm our tour while being greeted by the grumpiest people ever that we decided to book elsewhere. So if you want a place you can call, email and talk to nice people about your tour, this is not the place.
title: Extremely rude and disorganized

review_text: We visited the Space tour and had a Canadian guide, who was very informative, engaging, helpful and entertaining. Firstly we had an explanation on the beginnings of astronomy and the various constellations in view, done in such a way that I think I will remember them easily in future. We then got to focus the telescopes on many interesting objects, especially Jupiter and some nebulae. There were a lot of people, but we still managed to get some good telescope time. The best was when the moon was just coming up and everyone had mostly gone back insid for hot chocolate, and the woman there then trained the telescope on the moon so we could see it rise. She also called another person out to help us to photograph it which we really appreciated. We then had a good informal Q and A over hot chocolate, discussing various topics on astronomy. Altogether very well organized and well worth the money
title: Great experience under the desert skies

review_text: Jorge is a wonderful communicator and his Introductory Talk last night was v interesting . He guided us through a brief history of Astronomy by asking us question s and inviting us to join the discussion .Using a laser pointer he showed us some stars ,constellations and galaxies . At the break his wife provided some delicious snacks and hot drinks . We were provided with chairs and blankets and electric heaters . After the break we saw wonderful clusters of stars and other wonderful sights through the various telescopes . Jorge pays so much attention to each individual (there were 10 in our group ) and he managed to remember everyone’s name . The evening ended with group and individual photos which Jorge emailed the next day . This is an unmissable tour when in San Pedro . Jorge has passion for his subject and he’s a joy to learn from .
title: An Unmissable Night Of Stargazing

review_text: Views from our window - outstanding!!! Wildlife, Lesser Rhea, Guanacos, pumas, hiking, beautiful sunrise.
title: Esplora Lodge our home in Patagonia

review_text: We did our entire itinerary with Atacama Magic, specifically the Moon Valley, Rainbow Valley, Baltinache and Tatio tour, all the tours were very complete, creating WhatsApp groups to coordinate hotel pickups, adhering to schedules and providing breakfasts, lunches and cocktails depending on the schedule, all the food was delicious, the vans were in good condition and the guides were very friendly, willing to answer all your questions before, during and after the tour, we had to meet Cristian, Carlos and Jonathan, which were 10/10 and made the experience even more interesting with all the geological and historical data that they have in their heads, jsjs also highlights Luis, our driver on two of the tours, who was very friendly and helped us at all times, especially when we arrived late to San Pedro since our hostel was far from the meeting point, so he offered to take us directly, we thank him very much, we would definitely repeat all the tours with the agency.
title: Thanks and the guides and driver

review_text: A truly magical place, beautiful views, paradise surroundings, delighted to visit this place and doubly delighted to be able to return in some future. Very nice experience, highly recommended.
title: A quiet and cozy place to enjoy as a family. A paradise. Appreciate the staff for their excellent care.

review_text: Service was as promised. Pick up prompt and comfortable coach. Shared trip with 18 plus guide and driver. Informative english speaking guide and great driver ; Sebastian, who didn’t prolong the trip by driving slowly. There are some longish legs on the trip and without Sebastian would have been an hour longer. Fabulous scenery, well organised, lunch was “basic” but ok. Don’t think the final leg almost into Bolivia was necessary. But a good day Review of: Altiplanic Lagoons & Piedras Rojas Tour from San Pedro de Atacama
title: Long Day. 400km (240 miles)

review_text: Wonderful, the way subtly lit, the tips very good, the very original peck with desert fruit syrups, sailing and artisan pisco sour, good photos! They teach you to take pictures with your own cell phone, we had time to wait for jupiter! Highly recommended!
title: Recommended 100%!!

review_text: This was one of the best tours that I did during my 14 night visit to Chile. The tour guide Daniel, Trinidad and the driver 'super' Mario were great. The other guests on the tour were Spanish and Portuguese speakers - but Daniel was able to switch back to English to ensure that I didn't loose out in what was being said. Daniel was full of information as we drove to Isla Negra and then Matetic. The poets house was just so peaceful on the Pacific coast and full of history. The winery and its organic biodynamic approach to wine making was interesting with a good tasting provided. Daniel was also the guide on my Santa Rita and Concha y Toro - again, another star performance. Both trips were excellent managed by an excellent tour guide. Review of: San Alfonso del Mar, Veramonte Vineyard, Isla Negra and Algarrobo Delighted to read it Capt007Pugwash and know that we are part of your memorable memories during your 14 nights in Chile. Thank you for recognizing the work of our classmates Daniel. We hope you share your experience in Chile with family and friends. Regards!
title: A well balanced trip between Isla Negra and Matetic

review_text: I did the bicycle ride through the markets in Santiago, although I had a bicycle whit a mobile seat. I enjoyed as I discovered some more corners of the city. I wish the ride includes the Lastarria corner too.
title: Nice ride, could include Lastarria

review_text: Anyone with even a passing interest in stargazing and/or astronomy should do this tour! It's purpose built to show people round which means the telescopes aren't industrial strength but it means the whole place is set up to show the public why Chile is the best place in the world to look at the stars. Our guide had great English and knowledge of astronomy and used a laser pen to point to stars and constellations and tell us about them. Then he fired up the main telescope and let us all see the moon, Jupiter and its moons and a star cluster magnified hundreds of times which was awesome. The guide even took each of our smartphones and took a close up photo of the moon which was a great keepsake. But for me just being outside in the dead of night in the middle of nowhere looking at the Milky Way on a crystal clear night was the highlight. The tour ended with a a fascinating presentation with a film showing us how small and insignificant we are in the universe! It was truly humbling. The only downside was the size of the group, about 20-30 people. We all struggled to fit in to the main telescope observatory and it meant looking at the telescope felt rushed so they could fit everyone in within the time. Overall though a really memorable experience learning lots of new things about the night sky.
title: Amazing stargazing!

review_text: this is a very nice park in the centre, with some old buildings and fountains, popular with locals and tourists
title: nice park in the centre

review_text: We knew very little about Pablo Neruda before visiting this fascinating residence near Cerro San Cristobal. The staff were pleasant and helpful, and the entrance fee of 7000 CLP per person is good value for an audio-guided tour in excellent English that takes 1-2 hours to appreciate fully. Photography is allowed only outdoors and not within any of the buildings. The introductory video was particularly good prior to following the well-marked route. This is a unique residence designed by the owners, Neruda and his third wife Matilde. It is furnished throughout with meaningful objects from all over the world, collected by Neruda on his many travels. We would thoroughly recommend a visit.
title: A very interesting and educational visit

review_text: Excellent tour of Farellones, we enjoyed the first great snowfall of winter, we moved with the genius of Rosita, excellent vibe and attention!!!
title: Tour a Farellones

review_text: We opted for the premium tour which did not disappoint. JP was our guide. He was lots of fun and started the tour with a visit to the extensive gardens behind the vineyard. That alone could be a day long tour. After touring the facility, we retreated to a private room for wine tasting. JP is studying and he certainly taught us a lot about wince appreciation. All in all, a beautiful setting and a wonderful tour guide.
title: Fun tour on a rainy afteroon

review_text: We did a tour to lagoon eyebrow with this agency and it was amazing our guide Francisca is excellent in his work, also very friendly and explained everything in many details. I would definitely recommend this agency to everyone for the quality and also for its affordable prices.
title: Excellent agency

review_text: Booked with Turistik to go up the Andes. The drive up the mountains was amazing. The driver was very acquainted with the hills because one wrong move and over the cliff. He is very alert. As you go up there is a ski resort(no snow when I visited its summer) the resort is desolate. But the views are amazing. One could clearly see the snow capped mountains and glaciers in the distant. The guide spoke spanish since I could only be accommodated in that group. But he was sure to explain to me in basic English so that I could be in the group and not felt left out. The tour is very cheap. The Chileans and very nice people. I wish them the best. We appreciate your comment dear traveler, it is very important for us to know about your experience.
title: Half Day Los Andes/The Andes Tour

review_text: It might take a long trip to get there, but it is well worth the effort. The scenery is spectacular and the common routes are well-supported. Just keep in mind book camping or refugio spots well in advance.
title: World-class hiking destination

review_text: We faced a 14 hour wait for our flight and decided to book a birding guide for the day. We contacted Victoria at Albatross Birding and she suggested several options for the day. She was very efficient from first contact to payment. We spent a very pleasant day with Edwin French looking for target species. His knowledge of the area and its birds combined with his friendliness made for very enjoyable day. We highly recommend Edwin for a birding guide and Victoria for her enthusiastic attention to details.
title: Coastal birding trip near Santiago.

review_text: We booked our 3 day Uyuni tour from Lithium in San Pedro in April 2018 and although we were skeptical at first (due to reading lots of reviews) but after our Hostel owner recommended them, we were sure they were the best choice - and we were not disappointed. We were a group of 6 in a reliable Toyota 4x4 and we were not moved around between companies (as some reviewers indicated) Our driver; Carlos, was great - he was careful, friendly and informative. We felt safe in his care for the entire duration of the trip & he is quite the cook ! (the lunches were fantastic!) You could tell he cared about the landscapes and the wildlife of Bolivia. Carlos even took us for Sunset in Uyuni (even though it was not part of the tour) & assisted us in finding a hotel in Uyuni when we had nothing arranged. Super helpful! The breakfasts were simple but good (Breakfast is not as important of a meal for South Americans, so no complaints there). Lunches were big and delicious. The dinner on our first day (hostel in Villamar) was lacking, but the next dinner (salt hotel in Uyuni) was better. We would recommend going with Lithium Aventura for your Uyuni tour. All the tour companies charge between CLP$90,000 - 120,000 this 3 day/2 night trip but you definitely feel the service is better with Lithium (they are even recommended by the Tourism office in San Pedro) The places you visit on this tour are OUT OF THIS WORLD beautiful !!! ****But make sure you have some good (fresh) Coca leaves or Altitude sickness pills ready for Day 1 (you go up to 4,900m and most people feel quite ill - I know i did!)
title: Great Agency & Driver

review_text: Good traditional museum. Could perhaps benefit from some updating. Very eclectic collection with some interesting displays.
title: Traditional museum

review_text: We had the most beautiful fascinating experience star gazing. Jorge is wonderful guide and teacher. His place is amazing. His telescopes and the view unforgettable. As the night got colder (be prepared!) his wife served us delicious snacks and hot drinks. We can easily say that it was the best experience we had in Atacama. Highly recommend.
title: Star gazing with Jorge

review_text: The guide Marcelo is great, very patient and explains everything to us, the whole biological and geological part of the tour! Super approved!
title: Passeio Ruta dos Salares

review_text: Took the tour on the recommendation of our hotelier. This lovely Brazillian couple moved to Chile in 2011 to pursue their dream of becoming winemakers. Because her husband (Marcus) always wanted to make red wine, these are the couple's signature wines in a valley known for its white wines. Angela revels in their beginnings when most locals told her and Marcus that they were fools to grow red grapes in the Valley. But it turns out their wines are some of the most renowned in the country (get her to tell you the story when Costco came a knocking). Prices are a little high, but Angela says they're worth it. Definitely recommend. Thank you very much for your lovely words, it was such a pleasure to meet you here. Hope you enjoy the rest of your time in Chile. Salud!!!

review_text: We recently went on the Astronomy tour in San Pedro de Atacama given by the enthusiastic!!! Jorge Corante! This is definitely an exceptional tour, if only because Jorge is so energized and excited about astronomy. First he pointed out Venus, Saturn, and Jupiter in the sky, and then he gave us a brief history of astronomy which was followed by our looking through one of his many telescopes at Jupiter. We then took a break for “snacks” which were more than snacks – hot soup, beverages, cheeses, meats, etc. It was starting to get cool so we bundled into provided blankets. Jorge then proceeded to focus his many telescopes on stars, constellations, galaxies, double stars, and the like. We would follow his voice in the dark to view the findings. He could just not stop!!! Kid in a candy store!! We got back to the hotel around 1:30 am and fortunately, did not have an early start on Monday. We can definitely recommend this tour and Jorge.

review_text: I never thought I'd have so much fun on a walking tour. It took three hours, but it felt like it only lasted 30 minutes. I'd definitely recommend doing this on your first day in Santiago, so that you have an idea of which spots you want to go back to. Franco was one of the tour guides that spoke English, so we went with him. He was great, and painted a vivid picture of all the historical events that took place in Santiago. When he brought us to the President's palace, he pointed to where the tanks rolled in, snipers were stationed, and even pointed out some bullet holes that were still present from the historic event that took place there in the 70's. Franco had great humor, plethora of knowledge, and was very efficient during the tour. I included some vids of the walking tour in my Youtube video. You can search "Chile 2018 Stanley" and it should be the first hit. Happy touring!!!

review_text: Los Dominicos Village is very easy to get to on the Red Line Metro- it is a very short walk from the Station. It is a very pleasant little set up, with many more shops than I was expecting. You'll find a fantastic assortment of jewelry- most of it made with Chilean stones like Lapis Lapzuli and the Flower Stone. There are shops with handcrafted leather products, wood carving (watch the carver at work), items made from local copper, clothing, bags, pottery, childrens toys. There are a couple of little cafes. There are also a couple of pet shops and a LOT of caged birds. Whilst the cages looked well cleaned and maintained, there is definitely overcrowding happening and I couldn't help feel sorry for the animals. There are no activities, as such, to do in this village. It is a great local crafts shopping experience, where you can buy from the actual artisans, but that is all.

review_text: Great day tour from Punta Arenas to see Parque Pinguino Rey (King Penguin Park) with Turismo Fin del Mundo. Overall, very good tour with informative guide Paula and driver Antonio. The guide told us information along the way and made sure we knew the schedule, stop by stop. From 7:30 am to about 9:00 pm, it was a long day with quite a bit of unnecessary driving on a small, cramped bus with one ferry ride and a lunch stop in Porvenir before getting to the penguin park. The penguin park costs 17,000 pesos for foreigners (why charge more for foreigners?) to be paid with credit card because the cashier doesn't have change. Only one hour at the penguin park--lots of cute penguins! Instead of going back the way we came, which would have cut about two hours of driving time, we drove north, took another ferry, and drove back to Punta Arenas. Unclear why the long route to get home when it could have been shorter. Enjoyable day tour, though, particularly if you are a fan of seeing king penguins and some beautiful landscape at the south end of Chile.

review_text: Mirasol, is a Local beach located in Algarrobo, specifically in an area called Mirasol too. This area is also known by the locals as "Algarrobo Norte". This IS NOT A BEACH TO SWIM!!!. But, It's a beach where you can spend all day perfectly fine. You can have a nice pic nic (please if you do so, bring back your trash; let's all take a good care of our home). OR you can walk!. From this beach walking south, in aprox 5 kms you will find Downtown Algarrobo. A place where you can eat delicious sea food, enjoy a nice cold beer, or a hot coffe, depending on your mood, and walking through the different arts & crafs galleries - "ferias artesanales" in spanish (probably a useful word to learn if you go there, because it's a good reference point). It's a quiet, but very, very beautiful place. Locals are very welcoming and you can find hostals & hotels, or you can either rent an apartment, or a house... It's up to you. Now, if you aren't much of fan of crowded places, I would recommend to visit this place during the week, or weekends that aren't hollidays. It tents to get a little packed. Oh!... I forgot to mention the BIGGEST pool in the WORLD is here!!!... on your walk from Mirasol to Downtown, you can find it in San Alfonso del Mar. (You can't get in, it's a private condo, but you can take pictures from the beach, they all look pretty good). So, Connectivity. You can get to Algarrobo from Santiago, or Valparaíso. You can take a bus (aprox $6,000 CHILEAN pesos), or you can rent a car and go there. There are plenty of ways to get around in Algarrobo; Local busses, taxies (with a fixed fare-black ones- , and with fares that varies depending on the time...these are known as "colectivos", and are yellow). So, again, if you ever have the chance to run away from Santiago, or just feel in the mood to disconnect yourself and going to the beach, Algarrobo is BY FAR the place to go. Only an hour 15 mins away from Santiago (or 90 mins bus ride) and you can find peacefulness and amazing views.

review_text: My boyfriend and I recently took our first trip to Chile - Santiago, Valparaiso and Wine Country. Mauricio of Chilean Wine Lovers made our trip enjoyable, memorable and stress free. We spent several days visiting various wine regions and wineries and each had its own appeal. While some of our tours were not totally private, we did enjoy upgraded wine tastings and special attention. At several wineries we had private tours, VIP treatments and one winemaker even cooked lunch for us himself - One of the highlights of our visit! Mauricio also took us to the best local places to dine (in my opinion always the best!), shopping in Pomaire for authentic pottery, to Quintay (a quaint fishing village with fabulously fresh seafood) and provided interesting commentary and suggestions along the way. He also arranged all of our lodging and did a great job selecting well-located, charming boutique hotels. He's truly a nice guy, incredibly knowledgeable about Chile, wine and food and loves to entertain. Overall, our expectation were exceeded and I would gladly recommend him to anyone visiting Chile, particularly if you are a wine and food lover.

review_text: We had a wonderful experience with Tours 4 Tips in Chile. A great way to see the city from a local's point of view and get to know more about the people than just the famous sights. Our first time was in Valparaiso with Camilo for a guide, he was excellent and very enthusiastic, great explanations and tips for more places to visit ourselves plus things to eat and try while in Chile. During the tour he also paid for our transport on the trolleybus and elevator plus we were offered free alfajores tasting and drinks at the end. All in all fantastic service for something that has not got a fixed price nor any obligations, but after such a great time there's no way you wouldn't tip! When in Santiago we first did the OffBeat tour (10am) through markets and to the cemetery and we loved our guide Vincent! Once again, a lot of enthusiasm and love for the city, a lot of great suggestions, interesting stories. Also this time at the end the group got all together toasting with a terremoto (local drink), great atmosphere. After two great tours we decided to do also the third one offered, which is the Santiago Highlights at 3pm. This time I must say we were a little disappointed compared to the other two. We are not sure whether the problem was in the tour itself or in the guide or maybe a mix of the two. For a starter, we didn't really like the fact that at the beginning of the tour the guide stated that the average tips received on this tour was higher than what our other two guides had told us. At first I thought "that's a bit cheeky!", but then I wondered whether maybe this tour was more popular and interesting making genuinely people want to tip more. But as the tour went on I didn't feel that was the case. I didn't feel there was anywhere near as much enthusiasm coming from the guide, nor that the itinerary itself was as interesting as the other two. Nor did it feel the guide had gone the extra mile to give us a great service, I mean it's not all about getting free drinks etc. But it's those little unexpected attentions that make for an even more special experience. My suggestion would be if you're going to do all three tours, start with Santiago highlights so it's just gonna get better.

review_text: The Resort is not very luxurious, the rooms are neither too large nor too sophisticated but are comfortable and quiet. The bathroom is tight and has no heated floor. Hotel offers all the essential services for skiing and it is possible to rent or buy equipment. The slopes are wide and well ⁇ ined. The lifting means (telecoms, gondola and others) are slow compared to Europe and the USA, which is good for those who need to rest between descents, but bad for those who want to enjoy the day to the fullest. I imagine that those who go skiing for the first time should be quite lost: the hotel does not offer a concierge or something like that to guide those who do not have experience and do not know Things to do or where to go to rent equipment or hire instructors. There are good ski instructors, even for beginner children and adults. It is not very cheap to hire them: $60 to $75 per hour, depending on how many hours you hire, but they offer good service. The restaurants of the hotel left a little to be desired, except the French, which is comfortable, has good service and good menu. The 2 bars (who doesn't like a drink after skiing?) do not meet the demand and often do not find a place to sit. The service also needs to be improved: it is too time-consuming, the attendants are not very cordial and do not realize when we call them. More than once we wait for the drinks until (20 or 25 minutes later) the drinks are delivered along with the food. It was not possible to transfer the bill in the room (I do not know if it is always so, but I had to pay at the bar every time), which forced us to go out to ski with a credit card to be able to go straight to the bar afterwards. The hotel is not very accessible: it has many stairs and those with locomotion problems will have difficulty to move around. Despite the downsides, I think it is a great place to stay when the goal is to ski in June/July/August.
title: Great place to ski, but it takes attention to some details.

Caught cable car to see the views, went downtown through several barios and saw local life, incredible murals and historic and important buildings and plazas. Went through the area where the demonstrations take place (at a safe time) and ended up at a very pleasant craft market. Daniel’s command of English excellent and he was very easy to understand and to ask questions of. He also offered to take photos of us without us having to ask. We feel we have had a very good introduction to Santiago. Review of: Private Santiago and Neighborhoods Tour with Artisan Village Thanks so much for your review, Susan and Rodney! We really appreciate it! So glad you had a great time exploring Santiago's landmarks and neighborhoods. Daniel enjoyed being your guide and sends his best. Regards, Sean Tour Coordinator Chile Dream Tours

review_text: Had rented a car in San Pedro de Atacama and drove the trip up there relatively early in the morning. Gods a beautiful drive. So the actual drive up there was actually next to more spectacular than the place itself. We saw wild donkeys, flamingos, alpacas and a fantastic morning sun, so do yourself a favor to take plenty of time for the actual drive up there if that's what you choose. We drove at 7am from San Pedro, and it was absolutely perfect, because then all the tour buses were on their way home, and we almost had El Tatio to ourselves. Perfectly timed. El Tatio is of course world class and I hope the attached pictures show a little bit of the extremely beautiful scenery, but Jesus it's hard to reproduce via a mobile phone. The staff at the entrance are really nice and the toilets up there are actually quite surprisingly in very good condition, so even for delicate souls like myself, it was no problem. The best trip in Chile so far
title: Most beautiful drive with a fantastic destination

review_text: Cancagua is a perfect place to go to relax and have fun. Its natural location is beautiful, facing the lake and on the hillside with native species. Its architecture is beautiful, cared for and respectful of the surroundings. The pools are clean, independent of each other and their water is warm. The service is wonderful, I recommend massages. We tried different things to eat and drink and everything was very rich. It's for family, friends or couples. Muchas gracias por tu comentario, nos alegra saber que viviste una experiencia increíble en Cancagua, esperamos verte nuevamente pronto. Tambien te invitamos a conocer nuestro nuevo servicio de Biopiscinas Termales; son piscinas temperadas a orillas del Lago Llanquihue ¡una experiencia única! Saludos, Equipo Cancagua

Buy some food from one of the street vendors at the metro stop!

review_text: World White Travel is super professional, and my husband and I highly recommend traveling with them. We did a 3 days tour with them from San Pedro de Atacama to Uyuni, and everything was great! The food was plentiful and healthy. Our English-speaking driver was amazing: in the way he drove, the way he explained things along the way, took our pictures at Salar de Uyuni, and the way he reacted to unexpected situations. There's only maximum 6 people in the car, not including the driver, and one of the guys in our group had a really bad altitude sickness attack while in the car. Our driver not only reacted quickly to head straight to the hospital, but he also had an oxygen tank to help him immediately. With his quick and sensible thinking, we felt like we were in good hands. The guy then recovered quickly, and it was all okay. We did not even miss any of the stop, as our driver went back to the spot (train cemetery, which was super cool by the way).
title: Perfect 3 days Uyuni tour from San Pedro de Atacama

review_text: There are a lot of culinary options at Patio Bellavista and all of those I've tried very very very good. They have from ice-cream and natural juices to restaurant specialized in fish. The place itself is very nice and clean and the location is very good. After you had dinner you can go to a bar just by walking a few blocks (since is very close to the pubs area). I strongly recommend visiting Patio Bellavista.

review_text: Our transfer to San Antonio was so convenient to get us to our cruise ship and also visit a winery and the town of Valparaiso. Our guide Chris was an excellent tour guide who talked along the way. He has insights to the history and culture of Chile. The Winery of Case de Bosque gave us tastings in a room full of barrels. They let us tour the vineyards with strong vines growing. The gardens were beautiful, and wine tasted delicious. Next we went to the town of Valparaiso which was an hour and half walking tour of the town full of colorful murals. Chris guided us with every step and took us to two churches. He gave us several options for lunch with a view of the ocean. The transfer was stress free and took us right to our ship. Review of: Transfer to San Antonio port prior cruise with tour in Valparaiso and Casablanca
title: Transfer to San Antonio Stress Free with our Informative Guide Chris

review_text: I decided I wanted to do the W trek pretty late in the game, so I knew I wanted a company to sort out all of the details for me. I must have emailed over 6 companies, but Ricci was the only one to give me a personalized reply, and his actual number to contact with all of the answers to my questions. Ricci provides a specialized, unique experience that I would recommend to ANYONE. Everything was scheduled for me (i.e. buses from El Calafate to Puerto Natales, bus into the park, all refugios, the ferry, etc.) He truly believes in making everyone comfortable -- I got to stay in his place the night before and the night after the W trek and he provided a home cooked dinner and breakfast. Overall, I had no problems along the way. Everything was scheduled correctly except one bus ticket on the way back that Ricci completely reimbursed me for. I am forever grateful that I decided to book my trek to the W with Ricci and his company. Highly, highly recommended!!! Thanks for the wonderful photos!

title: Exploratory Tour of Valparaiso

review_text: We, my parents and I, contacted Ecotours Chile for services while staying 5 days in Santiago. Cristian Cosignani, the owner, recommended excursions and hotel accommodations for our stay. The staff is great: sharp at the schedules, friendly, and all those things that make one´s stay very good. We stayed at the Hotel Torremayor, excellent. Lots of restaurants, small shoppings and a very safe neighborhood. We chose a half day city tour for the first day, and visited several points of interest. In the end, we visited a fantastic lapis lazuli store, and Cerro San Cristobal with its fantastic view. Beautiful and friendly Santiago. On the next day, we went on a full day tour to Valparaiso and Viña del Mar. We had lunch in a beautiful seafood restaurant , just like a castle in front of the sea, and celebrated my father´s 78th birthday. Gorgeous views and sceneries. Another day we went to the Maipo Valley and visited Concha y Toro winery. On our way, we visited a local place to eat empanadas and enjoy a glass of wine. Later, we enjoyed lunch in a local restaurant, with music and good food. Very good picks !!
title: Santiago, Chile with the best

review_text: Philippe was great and very smart. We got to see many different parts of town and learned many local things including local mysteries. Review of: Santiago Highlights, Parks and Politics Bike Tour
title: Fun, learning, calm, nice

review_text: Maurício and his team are very helpful and thoughtful with clients all the time. The tours will only take 10 people maximum, which makes it much better for you to explore and have a more flexible experience. also his equipments are good and well prepared to make all the tours. And there's no minimum number of people to make a tour. In two occasions it was only me and my girlfriend making the tour. Best thing: THE FOOD! Maurício cooks very well and serves a good ammount of food for everyone in very special locations (go to instagram and you'll see the photos). Oh, and he's also a very good photographer =)
title: Excellent service! Would recommend it to anyone going to San Pedro.

review_text: This park is a must-see when in this area. We happened to catch a perfect photo-op day to capture some of the most memorable images we have seen traveling anywhere else on this earth. Highly recommended and a short drive from the port.
title: Volcanoes, forests and spectacular views

review_text: Excellent organization and the incredible human team, Pablo and Alex in the agency, the fantastic guides, Hugo for transmitting his enthusiasm and thank you Christopher for all your explanations, your good music and the beautiful photos and let's not forget the drivers for their professionalism and expertise at the wheel. In short, great. ¡Gracias por compartir tu experiencia con nosotros! --- ¡Nos alegra saber que tuviste una gran experiencia con Alabalti!
title: A magical and unforgettable experience

review_text: The view at the top of Cerro San Cristobal is incredible - it's a must see. The walk is tough, though, but you can hire a taxi to take you most of the way if you'd like. There are restaurants on the hill as well, but I haven't eaten in any of them. The statue of the Virgin Mary at the top of the hill is beautiful. A really nice place for an afternoon walk.
title: Awesome View, Great Walk!

review_text: Perfect. The Guide - Tomás - is very attentive and well prepared. The experience was fantastic. I highly recommend the tasting AND the sensational wines!!!!
title: Fantastic

review_text: Nice place to go to enjoy views from the top of Santiago. Rey quiet place too. Not on the top,of the list if you’re visiting but nice nevertheless.
title: Lovely view

review_text: This museum was free on Sunday. It was not far from our place and we walked. the front entrance into the foyer is grand. I wasnt into most of the paintings that we saw, but that was my personal taste. I am glad we went and saw it. The sculptures were great. There are bathrooms and a museum shop.
title: Nice old building.

review_text: We recently spent several days in Santiago and Valle Nevado. Christian Barrio was our guide throughout our trip. He was an amazing tour guide and his various tours really gave us a feel for the area. Especially the day in Valparaiso where he took us walking through the winding alleys and streets with their graffiti art displayed everywhere.. Thank you Christian and Upscape Tours

review_text: We arrived with a tour group after a long bumpy bus ride. The salt flat terrain is out of this world and when we arrived we saw three types of flamingos very up close. Many other birds and some small mammals. On this clear sunny days we were also treated to a smoke belching volcano.
title: Amazing!

review_text: We took a tour(more like a transportation service) there and only had about 2 hours. We would have stayed longer. It's in the valley and beautiful landscape. The hot spring is not super hot (enough to get you warm since it's at high altitude and the air is cold!). The facility is nice too. Well maintained. The dressing rooms are clean and there are lockers. Bring you own locks or we just put our stuff by the side of the pools. There are 8-9 pools along the creek. Hotter the first few according to the guide(though we didn't try the lower ones so not sure). Lower ones have the benefits of being quieter because of fewer people. There is a short hike up from the hot spring. Not bad and view is gorgeous.
title: Stay as long as possible

review_text: Excellent visit and a good opportunity to learn more about the history of the Valley and Pisco. The tour was spectacular and very complete, in addition to the very friendly and cordial treatment.
title: Tour

review_text: Incredible tour with great guide Victor who introduced us the cities in various perspectives. Both cities have their different attractions that are worth seeing. Go and return from the hotel search within the plan passed by the agency. Safe driving by driver Marcos. Review of: Coastal Gems: Viña del Mar & Valparaíso
title: Amazing coastal tour in Chile

review_text: My husband and I greatly enjoyed our tour to the penguin colony with ChiloeAustral Tours (tucked away upstairs in the Feria Artisan Building in Ancud). We had no prior booking and our trip was basically planned to suit our interests and timing - made more enjoyable by our guide - Luis - a very professional young man - who was able to give us the tour in English (not at all the norm). Luis was able to give us information on the flora and fauna as well as the history and mythology of the region. Not only were we happy to be able to see the penguins but also got some interesting insights into the local culture. It was a very worthwhile afternoon and to be able to make the most of it I would highly recommend that you request Luis to accompany you on your tour.
title: Great English Guided Tour to Chiloe Penguin Colony

review_text: We did some tours with the company Morandé, the guides were very nice, the drivers very kind and good. I highly recommend.

It is located within the Bario Bellavista neighbourhood. The nearest met station.is about 400 metres away. The atmosphere is very relaxing.
title: Out of the world atmosphere

review_text: The Branco guide was an excellent host on the walk to Cajon del Maipó. The San Jose Volcano Natural Thermal Tour gave us a unique experience. From El Salvador a greeting to Chilean entrepreneurs. A brotherly embrace.

review_text: Upon starting our journey in San Pedro there seemed to be millions of companies offering the same tour, with the same services. After looking at reviews and doing some research we were still struggling with a decision. We walked in to World White office to get even more information from a different company to compare with what seemed the hundreds of others we already had. The receptionist was wonderfully helpful and explained the entire tour to us, showing us photos of accommodation and what to expect along the way. We booked a tour for the following day and couldn't have made a better choice! The company was wonderfully professional and helpful. Our driver, Jorge made our trip! He was so helpful, always checking that we had everything we needed and such a funny guy (even with our limited Spanish understanding!). The accommodation was amazing (they gave us sleeping bags on the first night free of charge- legends!). The food was plentiful and really good- lots of fruit and veg also :) And Jorge took such pride in his car- we felt completely safe the entire time. Couldn't recommend World White enough- thanks so much for the great tour!!
title: AMAZING! Could not recommend enough!!!

review_text: Very good tour, I highly recommend it! The guide is very friendly, he knows a lot and the tours are very personalized, a pleasant experience

review_text: We visited several wineries when in Santa Cruz and this was definitely our favourite. The only reason I haven’t given 5 stars is that there isn’t a cafe or restaurant where we could have a coffee or lunch had we wanted to but I understand this is to be the next project! We visited without a reservation and were warmly welcomed by Marcello who spoke good English. He organised a tour for us and even brought us a complimentary taster glass of wine while we waited. The tour was probably one of our best ever and we learned a lot even though we have done wine tours all over the world! After the tour we tasted 3 different wines, all of which were very pleasant and reasonably priced. Our only regret was that we had to rush off as our taxi arrived, booked by Marcello at our request but unfortunately a bit too prompt!! What lovely words! Thank you very much! We are very glad you enjoyed your visit with us, and Marcelo will be delighted to read your comments.
title: Very friendly and welcoming winery with good value wines

review_text: Siempre Verde made our visit to Chiloe absolutely perfect. My wife and I traveled with our children (ages 5 and 8). Rather than rent a car, we contracted with Siempre Verde to pick us up and return us to the airport in Puerto Montt, as well as arrange for two days of tours. Jose was right on time when we arrived, and on the way to Castro (after crossing on the ferry to the island) we stopped for a delicious lunch in Ancud with beautiful views of the . In Castro we stayed in a palafito (recommended by Jose). He picked us up promptly at 10 am the following day, and we spent the middle part of the day hiking in the national park, followed by a delicious late lunch of empanadas and cazuela at a restaurant on the road back to Castro. On day 3, Jose again picked us up promptly and took us on a memorable tour of Isla Quinchao, followed by lunch on the wharf in Dalcahue. We spent some time in the feria artesanal and then let the kids play in a playground across the street from the city's main wooden church (currently under renovation). We then returned to Castro, where we toured the very beautiful cathedral in the main square, then we took a boat tour of the Castro fjord. After Jose dropped us back at the palafito, we dined in a seafood restaurant (Octavio's} right on the water (recommended by Jose). As Jose had forewarned us, the food was great, but the service was slow. However, since we were in no hurry whatsoever, this was not an issue. Jose's knowledge of the island's history, its flora and fauna (especially its birds) was extensive. He speaks English very well and has a very tender way with kids. Jose travels armed with binoculars, birding books and snacks, so whatever contingency arises, he's well-prepared. You would be hard pressed to find a better guide for your visit to Chiloe.
title: Unforgettable Visit

review_text: This park has beautiful old growth Sycamore and palm trees along the wide walking paths. A great green space in a the middle of the city. A large play ground for children, many benches and grassy areas. A great place to hang out and people watch.
title: Beautiful park and green space

review_text: We did this trip before Perito Moreno glacier and overall liked it better. Reason is because of the different shapes and colours in the ice, rather than the rather cliff edge style of Moreno. But you can't get out and walk and there is no viewing from the land as you find at Moreno. Might be that whichever you see first, you prefer. Warnings about the walk to the boat are to be heeded, though. You can get a courtesy bus from the hotel if you book there, but you still have a couple of km on foot, first over a very bouncy suspension bridge over a wide and rapid river, then the shingle spit, which is well over 1km long. Going it is OK because the wind is behind you, but coming back you face a slog into a wind typically up to 100kph. That and walking on loose shingle is a bit of a test, but exhilarating. We took the path up the island to the viewpoint before starting back and that is lovely, but again, very windy. You can't go all the way round the island because path on the other side seems to be out.
title: A lovely boat trip to the glacier

review_text: Perfect service. They arrived on time for the return trip (4 am) with polite drivers who helped with the suitcases and backpacks. They gave a chip to each adult in the group, which is one less thing to worry about on the trip. The tip from the blog nos no chile was perfect! Communication on zap with Elis from VMB answered all doubts before arriving at the airport. It's definitely worth the comfort, tranquility and safety.

review_text: Really cool museum, and learned so much about Chilean history. I say this is a Must, because spending anytime in Santiago and Chile you should know about the history of the country...in this case, recent history. The museum is free and you pay very little to use the headset (definitely get this). It is a little out of the ways from the center of the city, but worth the extra mileage. Spent 3 days in Santiago and this was our favorite most memorable part of the city...very moving!
title: Must see in Santiago

review_text: Most of the Tour Operators tell You"You need a 4x4 vehicle to go there"NOT TRUTH.I did all my traveling in a Small Chevrolet Car that I rent from Budget in Calama Airport,Most Tour Operators tell you that you need to be there at Sunrise,is good but Not Necesary,Is a fee for the entrance,2.500 for Chileans 5.000 for Others,If Yo7u never been in a Gayser,worth to visit this ones.
title: You will Feel like if you are in another planet

review_text: We did the afternoon tour on Thursday, November 26, with Joachim, who was from Bolivia, I believe. He was a wealth of information about Chilean history and the sights around the area. I was suspicious of some of his statements at first, but as I went on paid wine and coastal tours the next two days, I found he was spot on with his words. I highly recommend him. He is very friendly and enjoys Santiago and Chile. The so-called 4 hour tour was only a little over 3 hours. We started about 3:20 and ended around 6:30 in Bellavista section of town. We had a cheap, quick, tasty lunch before the tour at Nuria just across from the square by the cathedral. It was a great tour with some walking and then a long, stop at a restaurant. It could have been done in 2 1/2 hours, if necessary. Even though the group was large, I give Joachim a gold star for his tour!
title: Great Introduction by Joachim

review_text: I took the Pereira hike as the base hike was fully booked. I was disappointed as it felt second best.HOWEVER this hike was totally undersold! The guide JUAN PABLO was excellent, the scenery stunning and we only saw 3 other people over the 8km hike. We saw cave paintings; lots of wildlife AND the most awesome - a PUMA. Absolutely fantastic. An opportunity to experience the real Torres cel Paine away from the crowds.
title: Fantastic hike

review_text: It costs 10.000 Pesos entrance fee- and it is really not beautiful. It is just a white hole with water in it. We went there by car and as we saw this we did not enter. There are Lagunas which are more beautiful around.

Tom picked us up right on time we visited Veramonte, Bodega Re and Viña mar. Veramonte was our favourite. We had a wine tasting there with a great specialist. Bodega Re was also fantastic, the innovative methods they use are just so inspiring.... And Tom is fantastic as well.

review_text: We made eight tours in Atacama with Pukarumi. We highlight the excellent online service, the excellent service in the store in the city centre at Rua Domingo Atienza 419 (Victor) and the performance of the sensational guides Isidora and Lucas who made the excursions both instructive and fun
title: No need to look for another agency, go straight to Pukarumi

review_text: We had a lovely day trip to Valparaiso, Chile. Francisca spoke perfect english and was very knowledgable about the culture and history of her country. We were taken to a good restaurant that was reasonably priced. All in all it was a good experience.
title: Valparaiso, Chile Tour

review_text: We did the Viña del Mar and Valparaiso day tour... The pick up time wasn't as scheduled, we waited 1 hour in the hotel and the drop off was unorganized, we had to wait in the Parque Arauco mall for another separate shuttle instead of going in larger buses. Most of the tour was in a small and unconfortable bus. Maybe this was because we did the portuguese/spanish tour instead of english/spanish tour. On the same day there was also a english/spanish tour with a larger bus. The tour isn't cheap, cost us 34,000 clp per person. The guide, Katia, gave poor explanations and showed little knowledge of the region and history. She started a sentence and rarely concluded, leaving us to think whatever we wanted. Nothing interesting and enriching was passed on by our guide. The tour starts in thecity of Valparaiso, which has some nice views, but Turistik still haven't found the best way to show it. You then go to a lunch in Enjoy del Mar... terrible food, terrible service, terrible price.. only this that is good there is the view to the beach. After that, you have 10 mins for a quick stroll at the beach and they stop at a Faba store for you to buy Lapislazuli. After that, the tour is over. Bottomline: you spend 85% of the tour in the bus, the guide wasn't very well trained, the driver seemed like a kart driver and the bus was very uncomforable. definitely not worth the buck spent. Would recommend trying Turistour, we did some tours with them in the Volcano and Lakes region and they were superb or rent a car. I would never recommend a Turistik tour to anyone! We appreciate your comment dear traveler, it is very important for us to know about your experience.
title: Tour Viña del Mar + Valparaiso = not worth your $

review_text: A block up the main street from the Santa Lucia metro stop, this is a nice (yes somewhat touristy) place to go in search of local crafts. There are plenty of shops to go through even though the feria itself isn't all that large. Prices can be negotiated, you can get a discount for paying in cash, and the shops will accept U.S. dollars. As with everywhere in Santiago, watch your valuables to avoid being pick-pocketed.

I would definitely recommend this tour, preferably at the beginning of your time in Valparaiso so you know what to visit and where to look at in this beautiful town.

review_text: At the entrance everything seems small, but you will be surprised how big it is and full of streets that take you to many tents of crafts. You can stay for more than an hour just visiting the tents and has very good craftsmanship. Just pay attention to the prices that are a little salty! But it has a nice atmosphere and an amazing view of the Andes mountain range!
title: It's worth it.

review_text: We found this place on Trip Advisor and decided to give it a go. Not disappointed! San Jose de Maipo is a short (45 mins) bus ride from the Bellavista de Florida bus station and only cost 1000 Pesos per person. A cute little town with a couple of good local options for lunch. Ruta Vertical is located about 500m to the north of the main town square (Plaza dad Armas). We were the only 'gringos' on the day we went but that wasn't a problem at all. We were helped initially by Phillipe who ran us through all the safety precautions and tips to make our trip enjoyable. Our guide on the river was Gonzalo who claimed his English was poor but was more than able to communicate with us throughout our hour long run down the Rio Maipo. He was VERY enthusiastic and fun. The whole Ruta Vertical team where awesome!
title: Awesome day trip from Santiago

review_text: We did a full day tour of the Casablanca Valley, stopping at four vineyards, and spanning about 9 hours. Mick gave us a fantastic, informative tour as he took us from one vineyard to another. I'd highly recommend this. Mick shows you a great day. Ask him about his really cool foundation.
title: Fantastic wine tour

review_text: At 8 Million bottles per year, this is a massive operation, though they are quick to tell us that there are others more than twice as large. The vats are huge, the the barrel room is massive (30,000 barrels in one room!). Everything is done large scale and fast. And everything looks efficient, clean, and well run. The tour was also presented by a very personable English speaking guide, who made the entire experience enjoyable. Then, they give a 30% discount on all wines bought that day after you have completed the tour. The wines are quite good, and rather inexpensive. We ended up buying 6 bottles. (would have gotten more, but that is the import allowance when we fly home) Review of: Small Group Wines and Flavours Guided Walking Tour Thanks for your comments! We are glad to know that you had enjoyed your visit at MontGras and hope to see you again in the next future for tasting some new wines. Cheers!
title: Well done and well presented mass production

review_text: I did the Caravana Ancestral a few days ago and it was something else!! I learnt so much about Lickantatay culture (also know as Atacameños) and their relationship with nature and animals. Loved every minute of this tour, and absolutely admire their culture and the passion they put into showing it to others. Monica guided the tour (thanks!!) and I had the chance to meet 3 of the llamasn and Edu the dog, they were awesome! . At the end of the tour I had a great breakfast at Marisol's house. Thank you guys for such a great morning!! I really can't wait to come back and try the other excursions you have. Un gran saludo desde Santiago ;) muchas gracias María por revivir este viajes desde el origen lickan antay. saludos
title: Caravana Ancestral, something else!

review_text: This in another country is always a bit stressful. This is the first time I’ve decided to use a tour. I thought that this was an excellent use of time and showed a lot of the countryside, a lot of history and local culture was shared.
title: Time well spent

review_text: Amazing and otherworldly landscapes, the best way to see it is rent bicycles and we spent 5-6 hours cycling there and back and just taking it slow and admiring the scenery and stopping off at all the spots. Better than rushing through on a tour bus with 20 other people. And on a bike, you have the places to yourself most of the time. A must-do if you are in San Pedro de Atacama.

review_text: Awesome, 4-person tour with a fabulous guide! You start early in the morning (6:00-6:30 am) and drive to the flamingo reserve. We were the first to enter the park and enjoyed a nice walk prior to breakfast. Breakfast was very nice, including hot eggs. After another hike, we headed to a small village (Socaire) where we interacted with a woman knitting gloves and purchased incredible volcanic rocks. We had a nice stroll through Tocanic village where we made our way around the water and lush fruit trees. I'm not sure our hike was supposed to be part of the tour but it was a great spot! I highly recommend this tour. Make sure they don't try to put you on another tour if the # of sign-ups is low. You are paying for a small group and it was part of why the tour was great (in addition to the guide). Review of: Small-Group Tour Altiplanic Lagoons Red Stones & Flamingo Reserve Thank you sbgLosAngeles for such a sparkling review! We're delighted that you chose our company! There's nothing we love more than showing travellers some of our favourite South American gems! We always strive to deliver the best quality experiences, and we're thrilled to hear that we met your expectations. We sincerely appreciate you offering to continue recommending our service to your network of friends and family. Thanks again, and hopefully we'll have a chance to travel together in the future! Safe travels, Luna from Say Hueque

review_text: The place is much more smaller than the maps show. In the center of the park is located the Anfiteatro Viña del Mar, but it is dissapointing. It is a good place for walking an hour, take your children to play on the park, but nothing else.

review_text: Absolutely amazing experience, but not for the faint of heart. Details about the torture and detainment of Chilean citizens under the Pinochet regime may be disturbing to some, but they are neither over- nor under-emphasized, and visitors can choose to read (or not read) the many details in the written parts of the exhibits. If you do not speak Spanish some of the exhibits may be difficult to understand, however some parts of the museum did have English translations and the guides there are also extremely helpful (I am not sure if there is a cost for an English-speaking guide though). The museum also does a good job of contextualizing the events surrounding the rise and fall of the Pinochet regime within the geopolitical context of the time and broader issues of human rights.
