review_text: We had a great day with Eugene. We visited two wineries and had a wonderful lunch overlooking the vineyard in the valley. Eugene was a great host who was gracious and knowledgeable (and spoke perfect English). We enjoy wine and the wine of the two wineries that we visited were excellent. The vehicle was clean and we felt very safe. We highly recommend this tour and operator. Review of: Casablanca Valley & Casa del Bosque - 3 Vineyards - Full day
title: Highly recommend this Tour

review_text: We had a hire car and drove to the Elqui Valley up the steep and winding roads, taking in fantastic views of the mountainous deserts and the lush river valley floor where vineyards grow and small charming little villages punctuate the way up to Elqui.
title: Don't Miss the Elqui Valley

review_text: I went on a private 4 day tour with my parents to Salar de Uyuni and it was amazing. Miguel was the best guide. He showed us a few secret spots and routes where there were no other tour groups and it was amazing. He even showed us to a reflective pool in the salt flats when it's not even the season it. He was really friendly and helpful. I would recommend Miguel and this company to anyone. Food was pretty good. Accomodation was a bit cold but it's winter so that's expected. You'll love it.
title: Amazing tour with Miguel!

review_text: The Valparaiso Heritage and Interpretation Center in the Villa Victoria is a family operation run by Kenneth and Victoria Pugh. They have spent more than a year lovingly restoring one of the few houses to have survived the 1906 earthquake and, as a family in period costume, interpret Valparaiso history. They do it in the best way, through stories and a nice multimedia presentation. Before and after our tour Victoria treated us to coffee and tea. They even have Internet. This is an excellent way to get to know and understand Valparaiso. After the tour we sat down with a map of Valparaiso and they gave me a much better idea of how to get around than the people at the tourist information bureau. After the tour we were able to set out on our own to find some of the places they talked about and gain a much better understanding of where we were and why it was important. I strongly recommend this house as an introduction to Valparaiso. Thanks for your valuable comment that has been followed by many visitors, using Villa Victoria as an introduction to Valparaiso. We love to host our guests, as is our place. We are proud of our history and we are most happy when the experience us useful for our visitors.
title: A great first stop in Valpo

review_text: I had the pleasure of making the ascent to the Eyes of the Salt with Allmountain and I can only recommend it. From the beginning, the service was exceptional, the team was very professional, attentive and with a great knowledge of the mountain. The logistics were perfectly organized and the guides, in addition to being experts, showed a great passion for what they do, making sure we were always well prepared and safe throughout the tour. The ascent was an unforgettable experience, and everything before and after it is formidable, not only for the beauty of the landscape, but for the human and professional quality. If you are looking for a safe, well-planned experience with high quality guides, I definitely recommend Allmountain for any adventure in Chile. A 10 out of 10! ¡Erika! Que lindo tu comentario, nos emocionan tus palabras. Nos encantó la energía y motivación que entregaste durante toda la expedición. Esperamos volver a verte pronto. Un fuerte abrazo de parte de todo el equipo de Allmountain Chile.

title: There is few options to reach the top

review_text: If you're new to the city & not totally fluent in Spanish, this tour, led by our enthusiastic guide Vivi, was a great way to get acquainted. We spent four hours walking, eating (Mercado Central & Bellavista sections of the city) and even navigating the subway system. Vivi answered all of our questions and customized our destinations since we had already done the Hop On/Off bus and a bit of investigation the day before. Be ready to walk!!!
title: A Bite of Santiago

review_text: Wherever I go in the world if there is a waterfall I head for it. This is not a huge waterfall but it is still dramatic and the surroundings are so peaceful it makes it special
title: Can’t beat a nice waterfall

review_text: Great wine tasting but the tour dragged a little. All in all a fun day and a decent value for the expense.
title: Fun day, great wine, good value

review_text: We took this tour January 2016 with 8 couples. Our tour started with a pick-up at the cruise port in Valparaiso and was to end in Santiago at our hotels. There were problems right from the start. Our van had no room for luggage – the driver had to take out seats to fit in the suitcases, and they ended up piled up to the roof of the van. Our tour of Valparaiso was fine and our guide was great. Lunch, which was to be a quick stop as we ordered in advance, took over one hour. And the service at the restaurant was awful. Once we left Valparaiso, the guide and driver argued with each other as to how to get to the winery. After several stops, one of which found us hitting a big pothole, which sent the luggage flying, we finally arrived to taste some wines. It only got worse as we headed to Santiago. Neither the driver nor the guide had a map or GPS of Santiago and we were staying at 4 different hotels. Arguments continued between the driver and the guide, neither one of them seemed able to follow directions or a map given to them at one of the hotels. After driving around for well over an hour, we finally got to all the hotels. Thank you for letting us know your opinion of your experience here. I am so sorry that you felt that you had a bad experience. Please allow me to inform certain things that occurred that day. The day before your tour, the original driver got sick and a replacement driver had to come. He did make a mistake not to bring the van configured to the specific amount of people in his service that day. I told him to take out a row of seats, which was how it should have arrived in the first place. He also had his own ideas as to how to get to the different places and our guide had a very hard time giving him instructions. I, personally am not satisfied with this replacement driver either and I have made sure that he will not be driving a van for us again. Sadly, his poor work soils everybody else´s efforts. Regarding lunch, since it´s high season, it´s sometimes hard to find places to eat (that are reservable and reliable) that are not full and have quick service, specially since in Chile, lunch is considered the main meal of the day. The good places tend to offer full sit down lunches which usually take a good while, and those who are in a hurry go to the fast food places, which, adding all of the people interested, end up taking a good while as well. I hope that you liked our local empanadas though. I have talked to the manager of the restaurant regarding service. We´re at the moment evaluating if we continue with this restaurant under new procedures or incorporate another option for a quick lunch service. Please believe me that I´m personally very sorry that your overall experience was less than desired. We´re not used to having our clients feel like they had a bad experience and it really makes us very sad and worried. You can bet that we´re doing everything that we can about it. Thank you once more for taking your time explaining everything. I hope that your overall trip to South America was great! All my best, Cristián Blanco
title: Would not recommend this company

review_text: The Lapostolle winery is located in a privileged microclimate in Clos Apalta, a subsection of Colchagua. Surrounded on three sides by mountains, it receives the right amount of rain when it counts and gets the cool Pacific breeze at the right time. Adjacent to the winery is a B&B, which is small, luxurioous and extremely well-appointed. the food is delicious and the hotel is centrally located, within easy reach of most Colchagua wineries. Our visit to Clos Apalta was somewhat mixed. The palce is beautiful and the winery is modern, scrupulously clean, light and spacious. Our guide outdid himself to show us the winery and explain the history and the winemaking process. We then descended to the tasting room, which is in the middle of the cellar, at the lowest level. While the palce is beautiful, it is very cold and lighting is dim at best. Therefore, tasting wine is not ideal, especially reds that need to show color and transparency. We had tasted Clos Apalta before and it is an excellent wine. Tasting it on site, you wouldn't know it. The surroundings are wrong for a satisfying wine tasting. They should move it up to the sculpture garden at the top or the adjacent multipurpose hall.
title: Great wines, beautiful location

review_text: If you want to see a side of Santiago that is off the beaten track, with a fun, knowledgeable, multi-lingual guide, then City Trekking Guide Day Tours is for you! Sven came and picked me up from where I was staying and from then on it was a one-on-one tour of all sorts of interesting places that I am sure I wouldn't have found for myself. He was full of information about travelling and living in Santiago, and the tour was a combination of walking and public transport. After asking me a few questions about what I like and what I had seen already, Sven really tailored the trip to places that he thought would interest me and kept tweaking the tour throughout the day. We went to some beautiful areas and I saw many different facets of a fascinating city. When I went on the tour, a public transport card was included in the price, as well as a uniquely Chilean drink called a 'Mote con huesillo' , lunch at a gorgeous market and then capped off the day with a 'Terremoto' drink at a great traditional restaurant. They have half days available, but the my full day tour went by so quickly and enjoyably you should go for a full one if you've got time. I highly recommend a day with City Trekking Guide Day Tours, wear your walking shoes, take some water and prepare for a fabulous day! Sorry for my late reply, I really appreciate your nice reference and I'm glad you enjoyed Santiago. It was great to meet you and I hope we can stay in touch. In case you come back to Chile, please do not hesitate in contacting me again, Best regards from Santiago
title: Great city, great guide, great day!

review_text: Hernán Correa and his outstanding team saved our vacation in Chile. A tour operator that we had contracted, cancelled our tour the night before. I asked the hotel personnel for assistance and they quickly contacted the owner of America Fun Travel on a Sunday night. He was able to set up a private custom tour within hours through his personal contacts with the vineyards. The crew arrived promptly at the agreed time with a comfortable vehicle. The driver, Don Julio, managed the complicated traffic with composure at all times. The guide, Paulina, was a pleasant and interesting woman that shared with us her vast knowledge of culture, history and socio-political issues of Chile and Latin America. It was enjoyable to see the dynamics of camaraderie between them. If you wish to have a memorable, high quality experience in Chile, this is your tour operator.
title: Memorable luxury tour with knowledgeable and polished personnel

review_text: Felipe was our guide during our honeymoon and he was amazing! We got to see puma up close and spent time at some breathtaking spots!!! He is a great guy!! Hi Brian! We were so lucky to spot the puma! One of the biggest attractions in this National Park! Thank you for your review! You make me feel so cool! Best, Felipe.

review_text: I had two different experiences with the tours. I did three: Portillo/Laguna del inca, Termas Hills and Embalse In Portillo and Embase I had wonderful days, with amazing guides and drivers who showed a lot about the Chilean culture and left the day light. A kiss for Coqueiro/Diego and Ang/Mario. Already on the day of Thermas was only the driver Ivan, who was in a damaged hurry, accelerating everyone and this made the tour not so cool, since we had little interaction in a group 🙁 I will leave the 5 stars thinking a lot on the first day, that I met amazing people and had the best guide in the world. The Coqueiro is really different, the tour is another with him! Whoever receives the itinerary and has it in charge will be very lucky ❤️ Ps: Picnic at the end is wonderful, dreaming of that cheesecake so far haha
title: Very good experience overall.

review_text: My girlfriend and I (From Australia) had a lovely intimate star gazing night with Rene, with only another couple on our tour (4ppl in total). Rene had lots of amazing information, a great telescope, good communication and we had a magical experience. Highly recommend and I am still sending Rene cool info we have found about the stars / galaxies we observed. Thanks Rene! Woop,woop,woop 5 stars!!!! thank youso much Archietait!!! Thankyou very much for your opinion. Your review is very important to us so we can improve the service to make every night unique.I am so glad you had an amazing experience. Also thank you for recomending us. I would love to attend your friends anytime!!! Cheers mate! Regards, Rene.
title: Fabulous, fantastic and strongly recommend

review_text: Daniella, our guide, was very friendly, helpful and informed ... and her tour was interesting and informative. You could tell that her heart was into her subject matter.
title: Great tour

review_text: Many people choose to walk/jog/cycle to the summit of the hill but it is accessible by car although parking is at a premium at the top. Whichever route you choose the view over the city is well worth the effort, particularly on a clear day in the evening at sunset. There are various stalls selling a variety of artifacts of a touristic nature together with refreshments etc.
title: Terrific view

review_text: The museum is on 3 floors. It carefully and thoughtfully covers Chile’s human rights record under Pinochet. Most of the explanations are in Spanish - there are numerous photos and videos. Many personal accounts are included of the horrors of the time.
title: Very moving and thoughtful museum

review_text: Casa Colorada is the oldest colonial building in Santiago de Chile, built in 1769. It is located in the city centre only a few steps away from the Plaza de Armas and and it currently houses the Museum of Santiago. The declaration of independence of Chile was sugned in this building.
title: The oldest building in Santiago

review_text: Wonderful!! Very functional!! Comfortable and the attendant was very attentive (Catalina Green). I really enjoyed it, we even managed to complete the itinerary! Review of: Cable Car, Funicular and Sightseeing Bus in Santiago one day Prezado viajante, ficamos felizes em saber que gostou do seu passeio com nossa equipe, muito obrigado por compartilhar sua experiência conosco. Esperamos ansiosamente por sua próxima visita!
title: Wonderful!!

review_text: Walking downtown Santiago de Chile you are obliged to stop by this building, it’s a presidential palace. It looks quite fancy, all shining in the sunlight and surrounded by the Chilean flags. It’s unfortunate there were fences around when I visited - hopefully that’s temporary ;) a must - see in the capital of Chile.
title: The White House of Chile

review_text: My wife, daughter, and I stopped here for a wine tasting. Jose Antonio gave us an informative tour of the winery. Then we had lunch paired with Neyen wines. I liked all 3 wines I tasted: 2015 Neyen, 2014 Neyen, and 2012 Neyen. I purchased 2 of the wines to take back to the USA to save and savor in 5-10 years.
title: Good pairing with lunch

review_text: The truth is that the place in general is very nice. Good treatment from everyone, good food at a good price. And the beautiful penguins!!! We loved the excursion Review of: Puerto Montt: Full day Chiloe Island visiting Penguins in Puñihuil
title: Wonderful day in Chiloe

review_text: The tours in San Pedro de Atacama gave me incredible experiences. Valle de la Luna amazed me with its lunar landscapes, while the astronomical tour revealed a stunning starry sky. In Valle Arco-Iris, the colorful formations enchanted me, and in Laguna Cejar, I was able to float in the salty waters. The Geyser del Tatio was impressive, and the Hidden Lagunas of Baltinache surprised me with their crystal clear waters. Each tour was a unique opportunity to delight in the natural beauty of the region! Review of: Unique 3-Day Tour in San Pedro de Atacama
title: Discover the wonders of San Pedro de Atacama

review_text: I’m so glad we did this w/this group. Catalina, our guide was the absolute best. We speak very little Spanish & she made sure we understood the directions in Spanish & English for our safety. We’re very grateful for this extra help. The rafting was incredibly exciting. We turned at one point & were able to view Volcano Orsono. We had several breaks where we could get out & play around. They even let you walk a path & take a jump into the rapids for fun. The pictures are OK. I imagine it’s hard to get good clear images. Review of: Rafting rio Petrohue Thank you very much for such a good comment, we are very happy that you enjoyed the activity with Catalina : )
title: You rock Catalina❤️

review_text: I never thought I could enjoy so much astronomical observations, the celestial views through the telescope were amazing (have you ever seen before a "broken star" ?...), the astronomers always take care that we do see everything well, and they can answer virtually any question! And, due to the very limited groups, we got plenty of time to observe, without any "queuing effect". More expensive than other observatories in the area but well worth it indeed !
title: Outstanding!

review_text: The area is well set out with walkways and information boards. You can get close enough to the lagoons to see the flamingos and other birds without disturbing them. Plenty of the flamingos were in flight - a delightful sight. The sunset was lovely and the light on the mountains behind the lagoons was beautiful.
title: Sunset flamingos

review_text: Enjoyed the sea lions; they were the highlight of the day. The funicular was not worth it. Walking in Valparaiso was nice. Our guide was fantastic! Flower clock was lovely. Review of: Valparaiso Port and Vina del Mar Full-Day Tour from Santiago
title: Valparaiso

review_text: Wow! Just wow! If you do anything on your travels to Atacama, sign up for this adventure! I’ve never been one for astronomy but this was a once in a lifetime experience. Bundle up as the night gets cold, there are blankets to keep warm as well as a fire part way through. Rodrigo was very knowledgeable and has a clear passion for astronomy. It was great just to hear him share his knowledge with us for a night! Review of: Astronomical Tour "Under the Atacama Night" Thank you for your words! It is always a pleasure to see that you enjoyed your time under the sky with us.
title: Once in a lifetime!

review_text: a very good and well planned tour. The guides are very nice and show and explain everything to you. The places you visit are breathtaking. I can recommend this tour to everyone!!!
title: breathtaking 3 day tour!

review_text: Very good experience! We flew quite low and saw all the good scenery. The pilot was very nice and the service was great! However, maybe bring insect repellant when visiting as some tours do involve nice picnic places that involve nice scenery and some annoying flies. Also bring water shoes as it may be required. Overall, great experience.
title: Good scenery

review_text: We went to do the park day in the Farellones park and the guide Chico Mineiro accompanied us. It proved to be well organized with timetables and routes. During the road he was quoting important points about the local economy, history and other interesting points about Chile. It is well-humored and handled well with somelittle problems that arose with our group during the tour. I would do the tour again with Travel Chile and Chico Mineiro. Chico hugs 😄
title: Great guide

review_text: Congratulations to the Moto Travel team, I participated in the Santa Cruz tour experience, from October 12 to 13, this year. Excellence planning and execution, together with a tremendous logistical support that included security support before an event of the activity, first class snacks at all rest points, first quality hotel accommodation, restaurants at the same level and as if that were not enough, with a selection of high resolution photos capturing all the adrenalinic and relaxing moments of the tour, ideal to keep alive the memories of such extraordinary experience. The icing on the cake, the painstaking selection of interior paths in the area selected by our Guide (Juan Pablo Silva) and the warm and constant support of Ghislaine, leaving a mark of quality and reliability, certainly prepare a new departure. CONGRATULATIONS! Osvaldo Ilabaca Bustamante Gracias, siempre tratamos de que sea una experiencia viajar junto a nosotros, y no solo sea el andar en moto, la idea es que sus vacaciones sean inolvidables y logren tener una experiencia para siempre, te esperamos en la próxima aventura
title: Tour Experience Santa Cruz

review_text: It will be almost impossible for me to describe in words the amazing experience i had with the aguaventura team!!!! I found aguaventura in the net before I arrived to Chile. the web site is very friendly and give you in details a varied of adventure around Pucon. When I arrived to Pucon I entered the aguaventura office and immediately welcomed by one of the office team (Manuel). He explained to us on all the activities that the office has to offer and on activities we can do alone. He really knew how to recommend on the things that will fit us . My dream was to climb the volcano with snowboard on my back and to surf all the way down. The day before climbing we came to the office to look with the guide at the weather forecast the guide really understand the business and decided that tomorrow will be good weather for climbing. We started the climb 8 people 3 guides and Manuel from the office team. During the climbing 3 people walked much slower than the group and one of the guide stayed with them. At the middle of the mountain the board was too heavy for me and I didn't climb as fast as the group so one guide continue with the group and the other one encouraged me to continue and climb with me step by step and he really did all the different. At the last hour of climbing Manuel suggested to take my board so I could climb easier to the top. We reached the top of the volcano the view was breath taking so as the smoke from the volcano we put the mask and we could breath easily. And then started the fun part we surf and ski from the top to the bottom the guide with ski and me with a snowboard waxed properly by the guys at aguaventura. No way I could do it the top without that A Team of aguaventura!!!!!!!! Thnx to you guys my dream came true!!!!! Professional team from a to z. C U next time!!!
title: To reach the top!!!

review_text: Traveling with Sileia Tours was amazing, from Josi's service to the service providers, everyone is very careful and cares about our well-being, everything is very organized and both the cafes and the snacks are extraordinary. It was to be just one walk I ended up closing three, of so competent that they are!
title: The best company on Caracoles street

review_text: I went to the fonda in Parque O'higgins on 17.9. Food was really cheap and terremotos. There was a big tent in the middle which had artists and opportunity to dance cueca. There was also a lot of sellers who you could buy souvenirs. Entry fee was 5000 clp. Not the best fonda i have visited but it was a good experience.
title: Fonda 2018

review_text: Francisco was prompt on pickup at the hotel and after a few more pickups, we were off to Valparaiso! Francisco gave a running commentary on both Santiago, the road to Valparaiso and the towns themselves. There were opportunities to walk down the streets and visit the high points in the city. I wish we had more time to walk the streets and go up one of the funiculars. The trip to Vina Del Mar consisted of lunch at a nice restaurant (not included) and a visit to a monument and the floral clock. Would have preferred more time on the streets here too. Francisco made the trip and I enjoyed the very much. It is a good introductory to the city if you are not staying there. Review of: Historic Valparaiso and Viña del Mar from Santiago Hello, Greetings from Gray Line Chile. Thank you very much for taking time to share your experience with our TripAdvisor community. It makes us very happy that your stay in Chile was of your liking. We hope having you again in our country enjoying a new destination with Gray Line Chile. Best regards, The Gray Line Chile Team
title: Great way to see Valparaiso

review_text: Pretty little walk with roses. Fairly clean too in that part of the city, so that was nice. It's not a terribly large square and there are dogs roaming around it, but hats pretty normal for down at the port we found. Worth walking through and right across from the original library and main square.
title: Nice walking area w roses

review_text: Lovely trip to a unique place on the planet, with lots of fauna and excellent human environment. Highly recommended to those who want to experience the wonderful experience of seeing cougars in their environment.
title: Traveling with Albatross Birding is a must!

review_text: I was lucky enough to snag a last minute tour on my last day in Santiago. But because of the civil unrest, some areas were no longer part of the tour. But Ignacio went out of his way to direct me get to the place I wanted to see. Then, made sure to pick me up when he saw me near another stop. During the tour, he gave great information about the city, had a great attitude and made the tour very enjoyable for all of us. Thanks so much!! Review of: Cable Car, Funicular and Sightseeing Bus in Santiago one day We appreciate your comment dear traveler, it is very important for us to know about your experience.
title: Ignacio was great!

review_text: I went hiking with Igor along the Sauce river near El Toyo and it was a great day. Igor made sure that I was comfortable with the level of hiking and we criss crossed across the river a number of times, navigating around the terrain to keep it interesting. Ended up at a glacial pool with a waterfall for a perfect swim midday and some delicious melon. On the ride home we stopped to enjoy some pastel de choclo and some empanadas, which was above and beyond! Service was great, Igor was very friendly and fun to talk to and, hike was great, would recommend to anyone!
title: Hiking El Toyo

review_text: We had a wonderful stay on our recent trip to Northern Patagonia. Service is excellent and friendly personnel. The all you can eat "asado" is a must. Hopefully corona will be over soon so we can make our own choice from the buffet.
title: Relaxing stay over

review_text: What a great day - you meet your guide in a local cafe, discuss the menu options, meet the others in your group (if there are any others) and then head to the market to buy the ingredients, talk to local stall holders then head tot he well equipped kitchen to prepare your feast. We were a family of four with two adult children and shared our experience with a young Canadian couple. Our host/teacher Carolina was fantastic and I couldn't fault the experience. Well worth doing.
title: Fabulous, informative, cooking fun for all the family

review_text: I didn't actually go on a trip with Amity Tours, as I was cycle-touring through the region independently. However, I needed a bicycle box for an upcoming flight and contacted Amity to see if they could get one for me. Cristian, the general manager and co-founder, could not have been more helpful. Not only did he hold on to a box for me for several weeks, but he also delivered it to my hostel and refused to accept a single peso from me by way of thanks. I can only imagine how good his - and Amity's - client service is towards people who are paying.
title: Excellent client service

review_text: Excellent Dew Guide and chauffeur George always available. Very friendly and the information given by dew was very interesting. The beautiful place. Super recommended Review of: Full Day Trip to Cajón del Maipo Yeso Reservoir + Picnic
title: Visit to the maipo drawer excellent

review_text: It s just a great hole, If you stay in puerto Natales just for a day, it s better to go directly to the natural Park Torres del Paine, because one full day is still very short for this natural atraction.
title: Not worth the trip

review_text: Hugo met us at the designated time and place where he said he would meet us. Hugo is extremely well versed in English and knowledgeable about Chile and the history of its culture. He was very patient and accommodating for our group of six. I would highly recommend him as a tour guide in the future.
title: Valparaiso, Vina Del Mar, Santiago

review_text: We made a visit with Jonathan, the manager of the Valpotop agency. We were 6 people for a very well structured 3 hour visit. The visit begins with a historical overview which allows us to establish the dates and important events in the evolution of Valparaiso. The visit continues with the discovery of 2 districts of Valparaiso. Through the murals that characterize the city, Jonathan teaches us a lot about this art and what it expresses, particularly recent history and the political situation in Chile. Jonathan gave us an informative, lively, and never boring visit. The clarity of his words and his generosity are the best introduction to the discovery of this city. Well done and thank you to him! Review of: The Tour of Valparaiso in French on foot and in a small group
title: An exciting and endearing visit

review_text: We loved our Horseriding tour with Desertour and our guide Alexis!! Great horses, nicest guide and smooth organization with Joao! Thank you😊😊 29 de out. de 2022 lucyhoenen Best Horseriding! Avaliação do Tripadvisor: Desertour Atacama We loved our Horseriding tour with Desertour and our guide Alexis!! Great horses, nicest guide and smooth organization with Joao! Thank you😊😊
title: Best Horseriding!

review_text: We entered the park through the Lenca entrance. It was a bit rough since it's a dirt road to get to the park entrance. You park on the road leading up to the park. You walk next to a rive most of the way, passing one waterfall and several Alerce trees that are quite tall and old. Lots of plant life and trees to learn about while hearing the peaceful sound of the lake. If you are adventurous and want to do the Laguna Chaiquene & Triángulo (9.5 km/5.5 mi), you have to arrive before 11 am, and reach Chaiquene before 1 pm, otherwise you will be denied that second hike, but you can still go to the first lake. Other notes: -Foreigners pay 6000 CLP, in cash. -There are no trash bins, so take your trash. -There is only 1 full bathroom around the 2.5 km mark after the start, so be ready. -There are some parts where you have to ascend without rails nor bars to hang on to. -Go earlier the better to avoid crows (and go to the second lake) -You can't fully swim in either lakes, but you can submerge on it.
title: Good hike through a National Park with Alerces

review_text: We went there today (sunday) there were no tours available but we had a great tasting. Very nice and friendly staff. We could visit the cellars and he gave us a brief story about the winery. He spoke very well in english! We tried a lot of the wines and had a great cheese platter. I would definitely recommend this winery. I've been to a lot of wineries and this one is certainly in my top 5. Thnx for the great hospitality!
title: Friendly staff and very good wines

review_text: We purchased round trip ticket from Calama to San Pedro de Attacama at the Calama Airport. The one way trip came without any problems. However, the way back was bad. First, TransVIP gave us a phone number to book the way back. It was impossible, nobody answer the phone (we tried 5 times). We left one phone message and we sent a email. However TransVIP did not come to do the way back I recommand you to not purchased any thing from this Bad Company.
title: Do not purchase round trip ticket

review_text: Great landscape, Beautiful views. Guide was really nice, friendly and fun! The food at the end of the tour was awesome Review of: Tour to Vallecito and Magic Bus
title: Great Half Day experience

review_text: Exploring Cajon del Maipo is a wonderful way to spend a day. Leisurely meander through the towns, stopping for empandas, bread or ice cream along the way. Enjoy the scenery, the distant snow capped mountains, the quiet agricultural landscape, the river running parallel to the road. Do take the time to stop at roadside kiosks to sample local honey, nuts and other Chilean delights...you won't regret the slight detour!
title: A breath of fresh air

review_text: I closed a package with Deyd for the Atacama Desert and the Salar de Uyuni. Everything was perfect, tours leaving on time, excellent guides (Kristhel and Nina are wonderful) and great meals. Besides, of course, the incredible landscapes... The itinerary is personalized, sent in advance, everything is well planned and thought out in relation to acclimatization, first days trips at lower altitude, then others at higher altitude, for example the climb to Lascar Volcano was on our 5th day. The guide Esteban was incredible, he gave all the emotional support that a mountain climb requires. I was positively surprised by the crossing to Uyuni, many people talked about the troubles they went through and honestly I have nothing but praise! Even though I booked the package with a shared room, they put us in a private room for the 3 nights of accommodation. The guide Grover was always very attentive, the food was excellent and to top it off with a flourish we arrived at sunset on the mirrored Salar, it was beautiful! The only thing I have to comment on in relation to Deyd's service was that at times the response via WhatsApp was a little slow, but he never stopped responding to me and provided all the support, including currency exchange, what to take and how to get there. wear for each outing. Thank you very much Deyd, we will definitely be back, there wasn't time to do all the tours possible 😅 I already miss the Desert ❤️
title: Atacama has my heart forever ❤️

review_text: We did the E bike tour to the lakes with JP. You could choose if you wanted a workout ie turn the electric off or cruise either way the electric on. There was four of us in the group and JP made sure we had a good time and was very knowledgeable about the local wildlife Thanks great tour
title: Great EBike Lake tour

review_text: The experience with Zerando Chile and tourist guide Alleff Silveira was simply exceptional! From the first contact made by my girlfriend, the company demonstrated professionalism, impeccable organization and genuine commitment to providing an unforgettable trip, until when we made a larger transfer, and we did not realize, they informed that it would be returned. Alleff Silveira is an extraordinary guide, knowledgeable, attentive and passionate about what he does. Their dedication and charisma made each moment even more special, ensuring not only well-planned tours, but also a true immersion in the culture and beauty of Chile. I recommend Zerando Chile without hesitation! If you’re looking for a unique experience, with a service of excellence and a guide that turns every detail into amazing memories, this is the perfect choice! Oie, fico extremamente feliz com seu feedback, ele é muito importante pra nós. Ficamos satisfeitos que nossa equipe contribuiu de forma positiva pra sua viagem ser ainda mais incrível, esperamos vocês novamente conosco :)
title: Fantastic Experience in Chile

review_text: This neoclassical building It's a must in your visit to Santiago, you can get as close as you want to take some pictures and the police men around will help you very friendly in your visit. Below the building you'll find a cultural centre( with free Wi-fi) where you find very nice and unique shops and get some souvenirs.
title: Must see

review_text: I don't usually write reviews but I need to let everyone know that Bicicleta Verde tours were the best! My husband and I booked 3 private tours (vina, valparaiso and Santiago) and had great guides, (Camilo and Hector) very knowledgeable and great company. We took a group tour to Casablanca Vineyard with Camille and had a fabulous time (and great wine). Highly recommend this company, they helped with restaurant, hotel and transportation suggestions. Hey Polankids! Thanks a lot for your stellar review and your positive feedbacks! It’s really important for us to know that you appreciated the tours! You already did a few tours but if you come back in the region, we will be thrilled to make you discover other hidden places in Santiago. Why not try the Graffiti tour? It’s a different, but amazing way to discover the town. Salou, Peter.
title: Various City Tours

review_text: Review Chiefflon del Diablo. Pay ticket 9,000 peso/person Inside there are accommodation for mines. Can take photo. After there is tourist guide take to see coal cave. Before go to cave have to wear safety gear. Inside the cave is wet and cold. Beware your head too. Guide tour tell about story of place. This place is interesting place for family, freind. Let to come there
title: First time in Chieflon del Diablo Mine

review_text: My husband and I took an excellent tour with Turistik. Our guide DANIEL gave us lots of history,geographical information about the two cities we visited. We even stopped at a winery on our way to Valparaiso and got to sample a white and red wine. DANIEL lead us on a 45 minute walking tour through Valparaiso. What an eye opener, very poor city. I took many pictures. We then went to Vina Del Mar a very beachy seaside touristy destination where we had lunch and free time to explore on our own. I would give this tour company 5 stars!! Review of: Valparaíso and Viña del Mar Full Colors We appreciate your comment dear traveler, it is very important for us to know about your experience.
title: February 13th tour

review_text: Amazing experience. I loved it. The guide Frank was very polite and helpful with his tips, besides all the cultural knowledge he taught us along the tour. Alex was an excellent driver, conducted us safely all the way. I would definitely recommend them! Review of: Full Day Tour to Piedras Rojas, Altiplanic Lagoons and Chaxa
title: Must do experience

review_text: Along the coast, see the caves and the beautiful ocean and rocks... If you are on a cruise and only have time to see either the desert or this area, go to the ocean caves. Stunning!
title: Don't miss this easy walk

review_text: Francisco, our guide, gave us an excellent tour thanks to his knowledge and kindness, he gave us time to enjoy each place we went to, without rushing, but respecting the established schedules. It is also worth mentioning Gerardo, the driver, who handled responsibly and who cooperated with the guide to let us fully enjoy all the beauty of this tour. In addition, they both put together an exquisite breakfast. We totally recommend it, it exceeded all our expectations.
title: San Pedro de Atacama: El Tatio Geysers Tour

review_text: Claudio walked us around Santiago’s historic city center and wove interesting tales of Chile’s history. We learned a lot and will always view the Chilean people itch respect. Review of: The best walking tour in Santiago de Chile
title: Great overview of Santiago and it’s history.

review_text: Take my recommendation and wake up early for this one – it will be worth it. We got here at 6:30 a.m. in the morning and it was just simply stunning. The change, the scenery, everything about it was just awesome. A little tip – make sure you get your jacket along because the weather change here is crazy! It went from 3 degrees to 15 degrees in a matter of 30 minutes, so be prepared! Worth every bit of time spent there!
title: Fantastic experience

review_text: We were disappointed by this area having been told it was a must see in Santiago. Actually we found it to be a little seedy, and the only place in Santiago where we did not feel completely safe. Just a feeling - nothing bad happened - just not as relaxed as walking round Las Condes, for example
title: not worth a special visit

review_text: Very rich pisco, and with a history and path of artisanal production, recalling the pisco tradition without falling into the industrial. A great Esteban.
title: Very rich💜

review_text: We did the afternoon tour with Bernie. It was excelent, we had explanations on history as well as culture so it was never boring and we learnt a lot, even my friend who lives in Santiago. And Bernie was full of energy and knowledge and talked a perfect english !
title: Excelent

review_text: 1. The best wine we had in the Casablanca region, especially the Sauvignon blanc. 2. The homemade goat cheese was the best cheese I've ever had in Chile 3. The pairings - wines + cheeses, fruits, and meats - were inspired. A wonderful education in a gorgeous setting.
title: Amazing wine and cheese tasting!

review_text: A good chance to see gracier in a very close distance. Pretty pricy but this is the view retreating everyday due to global warming
title: Closer look of Gracier

review_text: I selected them because of the great reviews and had a very bad experience. They do not provide the services we hired directly and therefore there were miscommunications with the service providers. We paid more to get a private service. We were willing to pay more because we had young children and made this very clear. However, this was never communicated to the service providers (I saw their mail) and so we ended up paying more with a shared service. i recommend you go directly to the service providers. I did eventually.
title: terrible experience

review_text: I really enjoyed the trip today. Alexis is a great guide and very nice person! Easy to listen and talk to, very funny and fluent in english. He made sure we had all the information we needed. Also before the trip about the weather, so we have been able to dress accordingly. Views have been nice, even with the rainy weather today. Enough time at the breaks and not overloaded with commercial stops. Absolutely recommended! Review of: Small-Group Cajón del Maipo Full-Day Tour and Picnic Thank you for telling us about your experience. We're very happy to hear you had a great time at the Andes with us and our wonderful guide, Alexis, he is super professional and also so passionate about his job he makes this good tour even better. Thank you so much for the recommendations also! Don't hesitate to contact us the next time you or your friends want to come to live another gratifying experience in one of our tours. Best regards, MTO Tour Team
title: Absolutely recommended

review_text: On my last morning jog around Providencia & realizing that because of the cable car not working we had not visited Cerro San Cristobal & decided to run up the hill no matter what! My last chance!!!! Well, what an incredible and unforgettable experience! Not only because of the fantastic view you get of Stgo on a 360°, not only because of the beautiful gardens you run by, not only because the route is full of runners, walkers, cyclists, tourists, but also because when you get to the summit, you are faced with a 22 meter statue of the Blessed Virgin Mary -Virgin of the Immaculate Conception-, that welcomes you with open arms, soft and religious music in the background that warms your soul and a beautiful chapel where one can go and complete the journey by giving thanks to our Lord for his immense love! Best run ever!!!!!! Going to this place is a MUST and visiting at sunset must be amazing! I congratulate the Chileans for keeping & maintaining such beautiful place!
title: Plenty of faith & awesome view!

review_text: We did three tours with Atacama Magic and we loved them all: Valle de la Luna (David & Ignacio), Tatio Geysers (Cristina & Ignacio) and Piedras Rojas (David & Isaky). We loved David’s knowledge, energy and enthusiasm - he made our tours exceptionally fun. David & Isaky in particular were a wonderful pairing. Cristina was a truly lovely guide; very knowledgeable, organized and friendly. Ignacio was a great driver and we always felt safe. We loved the food that was provided. You might pay a bit more but you won’t be disappointed!
title: Great tour agency - highly recommend!

review_text: Experienced guide and highly knowledgeable amateur astronomer Jorge Corante has created a truly incredible experience for visitors to San Pedro de Atacama. Exceeded expectations. I left with a greatly increased knowledge of the history and technology of astronomy, the southern night sky, and star maps. After the lecture Jorge set up scope after scope to look at planets, notable stars of various colors, and star clusters. I felt giddy running from scope to scope to peer into the eyepiece. For me, the most interesting was pointing a telescope at what looked like a cloud and finding that it was in fact a cluster of individual stars. It reminded me of many experiences looking through microscopes and more generally of the stomach-dropping excitement that comes with looking at something familiar through a new lens. In addition to passing along his knowledge, Jorge is a warm and inviting host with infectious enthusiasm. I can't recommend this tour enough.

review_text: We did the tour on 1st May and well, where do I begin? We had read that the Atacama was THE place to do stargazing, and though at first we thought it was one of the more expensive things to do, we didn't hesitate to book as the reviews on Jorge were so good. We were not disappointed! He really was worth every bit spent. In fact, due to various reasons, we actually got a Special Astronomical Tour instead of the one we booked, so had even more time (pickup was around 7pm and we didn't finish until after midnight). As is said in another review - don't eat too much beforehand. He says snacks on his website but it's actually an incredibly good spread of food, including some hot soup. Jorge was incredible. He oozed enthusiasm and so much knowledge, and taught us almost anything and everything about the night sky, the history of astronomy and of course plenty of time to observe things through his many telescopes. We even got a few photos taken of us against a starry night sky and emailed through later. We were equipped with blankets, and he does have some great stand-up heaters, but be warned it still gets quite cold - wear a lot of layers!! If you're in the Atacama, we would strongly recommend doing this. It's one of those once-in-a-lifetime opportunities, and if you choose Jorge we guarantee you won't be disappointed. Thanks for a great evening Jorge!
title: Excellent, enthusiastic and highly informative evening!

review_text: This agencie, is really bad. Because the manager sell to you a private tour with hight price (kind of a double price than the others agencies). The manager does not sell directly to the passengers as he is mostly in charge of coordinating operations. You paid in total 130.000 CLP (185 USD) for 2 half day tours and 2 full day tours, anyone who has travelled understand that this price is clearly below the amount for a private tour. The manager spoke to you explaining all of this when you approached us with your complaints at the office, so we do not understand why you still have doubts and insist on something you never booked with us. review_text: We booked the Hop ON Hop OFF tour. We got off at a stop for the Gondola ride and tool a Turistic shuttle to the Gondola. Turistic operates the Gondola. We made two ticket purchases for the Gondola and were given counterfit money for change on both transactions ( two 5000 peso bills). We did not discover this until we were back at our hotel as we were not familiar with the local currency. After the Gondola ride we returned to the drop off point to catch the shuttle back to the Hop ON Hop OFF bus stop. It never arrived however there was taxi cab parked there. After 30 minutes we decided to just take the cab back to our hotel. When we arrived across the street from our hotel the cab driver suggested we get out there and walk across the street to the hotel as it would be quicker. We handed him cash for the fare (40000 pesos). He then directed out attention to the passenger sun visor where a receipt was being printed. He then exchanged our cash with counterfit cash when we were distracted. He then returned the counterfit cash to us and insisted he could not take it and wanted different cash. We also learned this when we returned to our hotel. All local currency we had for these transactions was obtained from an ATM machine. Coincidence? Or were these two transactions related? We appreciate your comment dear traveler, it is very important for us to know about your experience.
title: Criminal activity

review_text: If you can get a spot on this tour, don't even bother with the other options at the larger observatories. Mamalluca may have a more impressive setup, but del Pangue has the charm, intimacy, and personal investment from the 3 guys running it that make it what it is. These guys are amateur astronomers, but for as knowledgeable as they are of their equipment and subject matter, "amateur" is a misnomer. Between them they can cover tours in English, Spanish, and French. Tour sizes are limited to 5-10 people so you have plenty of time to look at a lot of features in the sky, and while I was there they ran an early tour leaving town around dusk, and late tour a couple hours later. On the occasion I went there were 2 groups of about 7 as they were making up from a cloudy evening the previous night, but with two telescopes on the grounds we didn't even see the other group once we got situated. They have two telescopes, one computer tracking and one that has to moved manually. The latter has the larger mirror and what I was stationed at for the evening. Moving it is extremely easy, but the guides will assist you if you're a bit skittish about it. And even when you're not looking through the eyepiece, just stand off to the side and look up. The views of the night sky there are the most amazing I've ever seen.

review_text: The most beautiful trail race I´ve ever been to. We did the course in 10 hours or so in the context of the "Navarino Trail Race". This wild course is quite dramatic and absolutely enjoyable. You really feel like you are coming back in time to a prehistoric age. Such are the untouched landscapes you experience in this course, which is quite technical. In this 50K trail, different surfaces challenge you: Dirt narrow trails, steep ravines, water crossings, turba (uproar), coastering, small and huge slippery rocks, deep mud, slopes of stones (expect a huge steep slope near Km30 mark or so). All, passing through different landscapes and more than 30 lakes and lagoons. The water of Navarino is said to be the world´s purest. The turba complex system is responsible to filter huge amounts of water as interconnecting so many rivers and lakes. Definitely the most pristine and beautiful place to experience true nature. Bring your GPS along with the course. Otherwise, download a KML, KMZ or GPX file to use with Maps.me or Google Maps.

review_text: La Vega Central houses over 500 fruits, vegetables, meat, and goods stores, and offers a variety of Chilean cuisine. Today, thousands of people pass daily through La Vega’s 60,000 square meters of stalls. In the 19th Century, the area was known as “La Vega del Mapocho” (Mapocho market) and the land was delimited and designated for produce consumption; the construction of La Vega Central started in 1895, with the installation of warehouses made of solid material inaugurated in 1916. Under moonlight, farmers and vendors from around the countryside drive truckloads of fresh fruit and vegetables to this massive fruit and vegetable market. In this place, shop ownersgather to pick the best products to sell in their stalls. They arrive at La Vega between 4 and 5 AM to get the best of the day’s produce, and end around 6 PM, when shops begin to close. Nowadays La Vega Central is a must and has now achieved iconic status in Chile’s capital. I invite you to visit this awesome 100 years old historical site and enjoy its messy, colourful and plenty of history background. Julio Peraldi Cultural and tour guide
title: La Vega doesn't provide just fresh fruits and vegetables at low prices, but also a magical journey into Chile’s past.

This house in Santiago is very well preserved and the tour with audioguides is worth your while if you care at all about the man and his life. It is very expensive, $6,000 pesos per person, for what you get, especially ironic given his political leanings. However, it is a visit that stays with you and you get a deeper understanding of his life after seeing where he lived.

review_text: It’s hard to know where to begin this review — there are far too many elements that went into the experience. So perhaps the best place to start is simply to say that the trip was extraordinary in every way. And in no particular order, to then articulate what made it so special. If it’s possible, set aside the fact that the environment, scenery & wildlife in Antarctica are all so entirely unique that it’s impossible not to be awed by its rare & stark beauty. So turn to the ship. In our case, the Hebridean Sky. She’s lovely. Perfectly appointed. Large enough to feel roomy, small enough to feel intimate. We had a suite with a veranda. We never closed our curtains, and relished the constant gorgeous view we were able to enjoy. Next, consider the staff. First of all, the ratio of staff to passengers was beyond luxurious. I believe we had under 70 passengers and about 75 on staff. Nothing was overlooked, delayed, forgotten. Ever member of the staff was dedicated to the safety & happiness of every passenger. And yet, it all lacked pretension. Our trip was simply filled with happy people, passengers & staff alike. It would be impossible to single out any one staff member for one basic reason: each one was brimming with personality & expertise. I can count on one hand the number of trips we’ve ever taken where we could actually say this. Everyone we dealt with was professional; knowledgeable, & filled with good humor. For any of them that may be reading this, THANK YOU for making our trip unforgettable. We didn’t interact much with the captain & bridge crew, but we know they negotiated the waters with skill. We always felt safe, even when the seas turned turbulent. Every day, nimble planning allowed 2 zodiac excursions to fascinating landings. The zodiac rides were as fun as the destinations themselves. The food on the ship wasn’t merely plentiful — it was also first rate. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, hot drinks upon arrival after an excursion, cocktails & appetizers at the early evening daily recap & update sessions. And then, the fellow passengers. An international collection of highly social well traveled people that were friendly & fun to talk & be with. We’d heard from others that any trip to Antarctica can be great. But the company you travel with can either elevate the experience — or not. We honestly cant think of one negative to report. Everything about our trip with Antarctica 21 was superb. Dear HuntleyNewYork First of all, thank you very much on behalf of the whole Antarctica21 team for taking the time and detailing every single aspect of your trip that made it so special. You're right, Antarctica itself is already a fantastic place to visit, and just being there is great, but I'm happy to hear that we were able to elevate that experience for you. It is a great motivation for us to read reviews like yours, thank you so much again for writing it.
title: Exceptional in Every Way

review_text: Lovely place, complete view of the city. It is recommended to attend in the afternoon to see the mountains because is less foggy than in the morning.
title: Great View!

review_text: I have traveled along the legendary Carretera Austral back in october 2014: using a mix of hitch-hiking and local bus from Puerto Montt to Coyhaique. First and foremost, what you need to know about this area is that: 1) It is very remote. Most of the road is gravel. The other part is partly paved or in the process of. 2) Being remote, the buses around there are more expensive (and fewer) than elsewhere in Chile, although stay very effective; which is why I have decided to try hitch-hiking in the area. 3) It is a rainy area, especially near Chaitén and the Parque Pumalin (which is a MUST stop, and the park is free!). But when the clouds wear off, this is when the magic appears. Blue lakes, snowy peaks, rainforests, glaciers and more. The landscape along the Carretera Austral is simply and purely breathtaking. I would highly recommend anyone visiting the country to take a look at the area as it is one of the last treasure on Earth not being spoiled by man. And the hitch-hiking? It was fine, just be patient ;)
title: Pure Patagonia

review_text: Firstly do not underestimate the time to be spent at this museum. We read and were told that it is easy to do this museum in 2-3 hours - but we spent well over this amount of time because we watched many of the videos and took time to look at the exhibits. Entrance is free, but for English speakers it is possible to hire an audio guide for the equivalent of a couple of $$$AUD. It is well worth the getting the guide as many of the exhibits are in Spanish only. For the most part i thought that the audio guide covered many of the things, although a couple of times it seemed to be lacking some information. (I.e. I'm looking at a wall of writing in Spanish, and the audio guide says 2 sentences about what i am looking at) Some videos have English sub-titles. It covers the events of the Chilean Coop in 1970 very well, and at times can be very somber. I would recommend going over the weekend, because while we were there during the week there were many school groups, making it a little difficult to see some things. The cafe below the museum is quite nice if you need a pick me up afterwards.
title: Allow plenty of time to experience all exhibits

review_text: We visited for lunch and sat in a plaza that opened to other restaurants and people watched and ate much to much delicious cerviche!
title: Some of the best restaurants in the city

review_text: Beautiful lake and from the boat a fantastic view of Osorno volcano,great photograph opportunity, scenery all round beautiful, we had a lovely cruise even if it was a bit overcrowd.
title: Emerald lake

review_text: This experience was amazing. It was a great change of pace from busy and polluted Santiago. The air and sky were so clean, the mountains were breathtaking, and the hot springs were so refreshing on the cool day. The hike itself wasn't very difficult and there wasn't very much action from the volcano, but it was still scenic and worthwhile. The view from the hot springs was phenomenal and there are multiple springs at various temperatures, so it can be comfortable for anyone! This experience was also great logistically. Our guide, Diego, was very knowledgeable and personable. Additionally, our driver, Miguel, was so much more than a driver. He was very personable and took photos and videos with his drone during the day, which he shared with me after. Overall, great experience! Review of: Hiking to the base of the volcano and hot spring Colina from Santiago.
title: Great way to experience Chile's beauty!

review_text: It's an excellent expedition. Driver Guide very attentive. Very good accommodation and food. I recommend it to everyone, especially to the Brazilians

Also, the beach area is large and on warm days covered with singles and families. There are some nice beach restaurants in the area and some have public restrooms, but bring a few coins because they are not free - unless you patronize the restaurant.

review_text: A visible and known spot in the center of Santiago, a good orientation point. It is not open to public, so the interest is just seeing it passing by during a walk or a tour.

review_text: This is a real treat for anyone wanting to see and experience the gentrified side of Santiago. It's generally not that easy to walk around and find places to eat, but, Bella Vista provides you that opportunity. Lots of places from Japanese, to Mexican to American. There are even restaurants just outside that looked really good and fun.

review_text: Communication in the planning stages is excellent via WhatsApp. My guide Felipe was right on time and made my target lifers a top priority. He knows the area well and found every bird I was after and many others in a very pleasant half day tour around Puerto Varas.
title: Awesome Birding in Puerto Varas

review_text: GREAT DAY! This was the highlight of our trip to Santiago! We started out by being picked up from our hostel. We drove about 45-60 min to a small village to take a 15 min break, then went to the small (super picturesque) village at the base of the mountains. The walk is a little hard, and takes about 2 hours there. You stop and eat lunch at the lagoon. The lunch is a hamburger with guacamole, a granola bar, a banana, and a juice box. Definitely enough to fill anyone. The way back is about 1-1.5 hours. My husband and I went during fall so the trees were a beautiful assortment of green, yellows and reds. From there its a 45 min drive to the hot springs, which are jaw dropping!!! Tons if different pools, an amazing view, and at the end the guide set up a little picnic. We ate nuts, olives, meat, cheese, crackers, wine and kiwi juice. Really great day. I highly recommend it!! You arrive home around 10pm, 2.5 hour drive back.
title: Glacier & Hot Springs day tour - Amazing!!

review_text: This is one of the older neighborhoods in central Santiago, very pedestrian friendly. It has lots of good restaurants of different styles and prices. We found ourselves having reason to go there several times during our week in Santiago.
title: Great neighborhood for dining & shopping

review_text: This shopping has a variety of shops. You can find almost everything in this mall: wines, clothes, sport wear, shoes, you can also eat in the food hall, in which you can choose almost any type of food. This is a good option if it is raining in Santiago.
title: Good place for shopping

review_text: This is great place right in the center of Santiago and not far from the plaza de armas. It is a pretty easy walk to the top. and you get to see various fountains and green areas. This place has a lot of history beginning in the 1500's. It was a place of worship for the missionaries, a defensive fort, a cemetery for those were were not Roman Catholic, and astronomical observatory.

review_text: The individuals who work for this organization are exceptional. Each one went out of their way to make our group's tour unique and memorable. Ben who also managed the customization of our volunteer group's itinerary was very welcoming and efficient throughout the process. All staff were so very knowledgeable about the country and each specific site we visited. A true rich cultural experience with La Bicicleta Verde. Thank you so very much for everything.

review_text: Because of the recent floods, we couldn't get into to see the rainbow canyon, but the Yerbas Buenas petroglyphs made the trip worthwhile. Nearly all the petroglyphs can be seen from ground level, making it easy for those with limited mobility. Given that these are 3000-5000 years old, they are in quite good shape. You will see lots of animals that will be familiar to you, and a few that are not. There is also a covered area in the event that your are picnicking. Probably worth 1-2 hours of your time
title: Well-preserved petroglyphs!

review_text: I'm not a snob, I really like classical music and opera. Do you like it too? Then Teatro Municipal is a great place for you to go to spend free time. Though tickets are quite expensive! Seats in Galeria was my solution. The only thing you need to do - to come one hour before performance starts to take a seat in a first line at Galeria. But it's worth it!

review_text: My husband and I booked the Cerro Toco tour through another agency, which passed the tour on to Nortrek. I had contact with them from the moment they created the group to provide more information about the tour that would take place the following day. We were guided by two excellent professionals, very responsible and realistic. It's not a tour for everyone. On the day we took the tour there was approximately 40cm of accumulated snow and the guides were very careful. I wasn't able to complete the climb, but I had a lot of fun! If you decide to take this tour, I recommend signing directly with Nortrek or getting in touch to find out more about all the details of the tour, they are the best to instruct!!! I would like to take this opportunity to thank the guide Carlos for all his attention and care before, during and after the tour. Congratulations on the work!!

review_text: Good range of good beers in a courtyard with very welcome shade. We had pizza and veggie burger which were both nice. Helpful staff let you sample beers. We didn't do the tour as we were too hot and tired.

review_text: My hotel in San Pedro arranged for the transfer service from the Calama Airport to San Pedro and back. After reading some not so great reviews about this and other transfer services, I was a bit nervous. However, when I picked up my baggage at Calama Airport, there was a representative from Transfer Pampa clearly visible who directed me to the counter. They confirmed my reservation and asked me to wait 15 minutes. In 15 minutes, several other travelers and I were led to the van and driven to our hotels in San Pedro. The driver was conscientous and capable, and everything went off like clockwork. The return trip was very smooth as well and I arrived at Calama Airport in plenty of time to catch my flight to Santiago. It could not have been smoother or less brain damage. It was also very reasonably priced. Well-done!
title: Excellent service - on time and professional both directions to and from San Pedro de Atacama

A beautiful green oasis embedded in rock faces. It's a nice surprise you wouldn't expect. I have learned an incredible amount about numerous plants and birds that shape the landscape around Vallenar. For each plant there was information about the usability of its individual components. Just great!! The individual design of excursions is very important to Steffi and is also really practiced. It was a lot of fun. Absolutely recommended and a reason to come back to Vallenar. Thanks🙃👍 Silke

If in doubt just download the maps.me app before hand. 5 PM return bus was right on time and without having to hurry you will be able to complete the hike. If it is wet you might want a hiking pole as there are a few sections that can be steep and slippery. Otherwise the trail is good with just a few places of moderate hand scrambling.

review_text: Had a fun and interesting trip to Cajon del Maipo with a super cheerful guide and great driver. Nice lunch, great wine and stunning views of the Andes just a few hours from Santiago. review_text: Beautiful place , where you can disconnect of the noises of the city, the lake with the purest water of Chile, the aquatic or motorized sport are prohibited in the lake, this way to be able to preserve and remove the pollution of their waters. Unforgettable landscapes, it is something difficult to find places to lodge near the lake, but you can find a few sectors of campings belonging to the community Mapuche. Influence observes great part of his culture, they prove to be nice with the touristas providing that you respect his territory or his "PACHAMAMorA" (mother nature) excess of peace and elax .. perfect to renew energies.

review_text: My travel companion and I were in awe from the amazing scenery of this famous park. On our 1st day we were blessed with a sunny, wonderful day. The all day tour with many photo stops was incredible. From the Las Torres hotel around the park to the horns and then to Grey lake and glacier we took dozens of photos. We saw many guanacos and condors. The wind was fierce that 1st day. During that tour and a later half day tour, we had stops at two different great waterfalls. This park has everything. Whether one comes to hike and camp or stay in accommodations, you need to see this most amazing scenery. However, be prepared for strong winds and rough, chilly weather, even in the summer, high season.
title: Unique, stunning, unforgettable scenery

review_text: The most speculator views of the natural beauty of Southern Chile! A must for any traveller visiting Chile!

review_text: Mary arranged my 10-day hiking trip to Cerro Castillo and Patagonia National Park. One word summarized that experience: Outstanding!! The guides were experienced and attentive. The food was fabulous and plentiful. The logistics were perfect. Mary took full ownership for every aspect of the trip’s success, with her commitment to my safety and comfort underscored by one experience. In short, my transit between the two parks involved a ferry crossing across Lago General Carrera - the largest lake in Patagonia. After learning that the ferry was cancelled due to high wind and waves, Mary sprung into action and quickly arranged for a private, six hour car transport around the lake. When I offered to pay for this extra service, Mary refused my money, explaining that my trip’s success was her responsibility. Nothing else needs to be said. She’s terrific. A perfect host committed to her guests comfort and safety.
title: An outstanding trip to Cerro Castillo National Park and Patagonia National Park

review_text: I wanted to have a horse ride around Puerto Aysén and The hotel where I stayed suggested me to go to la Plancha! The owner is friendly, kind and funny and he talks English ( it is difficult to find someone speaking English). The horse was wonderful and reliable, she was not afraid of anything. I had a relaxing afternoon here, having fun, enjoying the beautiful landscape and learning about the history of the place told by the owner. Furthermore I got the opportunity to taste the typical “tea” named Mate. I suggest it to everyone :) Thank you very much Benedetta for your visit, we had a great time and I hope you have a good return home. We wait for you whenever you want, a strong hug. regards, PD: Spero che per la prossima volta, possiamo parlare italiano, un abbraccio,
title: Relaxing afternoon

review_text: Not worth it for the price charged! (18 thousand pesos), do not recommend! Visit of no more than 10 minutes!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

review_text: The wine tour group size was perfect, just 14 of us. Rodrigo, our driver, did a great job of getting us to each location safely. And the van was clean and ideal for our group size. Nacho, our tour guide, was very entertaining and knowledgeable about Chile and the Maipo Valley. Nacho went above and beyond, by taking candid pictures of the group at each location, and individual/couple photos at the last winery and shared them with the group. He really created an atmosphere for us all to have fun together while enjoying wine tasting at the wineries. Review of: Maipo Valley Wine Tour with 4 vineyards from Santiago. Nacho is one of our many guides that with their unique strategies will aim to ensure memorable experiences. We're glad you had a great time mingling with the other tourist in Maipo Valley. Thank you for your review.

review_text: The tour was so fun and I enjoyed it very much. I traveled alone, but my private guide Christian and driver/coordinator Felipe kept me very good company. We visited three wineries in Maipo valley. I have done tastings in each of them. Each of the estates has its own characteristics and beautiful architectures, and great wines of course. During the trip, Chrisitan shared a lot of wine knowledge with me as well as interesting facts about the city and the country. Review of: Private Tour: Isla de Maipo For Wine Lovers Hello again! How nice you enjoyed all three wineries and its wines and learnt about wine and Chile with Christian. I’ll congratulate him on your behalf. We wish you the best in 2024! Thanks again for the ratio and comment. Kind regards, Juan

review_text: To clarify, these are two completely different places which are several kilometers away from each other. Valle de la Muerte is a small area where you can sandboard (find a tour, there aren't rental places available there). Interesting rock structures, but to be honest I didn't find this nearly as interesting as its counterpart. Valle de la Luna has much more to see. The route is much longer, and even has some trekking spots to get up on the high hills around the valley for a spectacular view. Part of the valley was closed when I went, but even still I was able to spend several hours there.
title: Two different valleys

review_text: Worth the time and the nominal entrance fee to enjoy the décor and architecture of a bygone time maintained by the Club de la Union. Very adjacent the main square so easy to find.
title: Worth a visit

review_text: Went for after dinner drinks. Service was quick and friendly and the views are worth seeing. Found the drinks a little expensive but the highlight is the toilets with the view.
title: Great views of the town and harbour

review_text: The route itself as well as the bunk beds are nice, but we booked a four bed dorm and ended up in a six bed... Also there is no info about what terrain you pass. We even missed the first breakfast because no one knew when it was up. The dining room is shabby and due to missing room cleaning, you gonna run out of toilet paper & co. It's still a nice trip but on accounts of the price, it's a filthy journey with bad (if any!) food! After giving tips the last night, breakfast the last morning was almost not existing... Too much money for too little service!

review_text: I had heard about the wonders of Chiloe's churches dozens of times throughout my life... But I finally understood it when I saw them in person. This is the first church I visited and it is beautiful. It's incredible what they were able to do with the wood, how they shaped it, the curves, the artistry and craftmanship. They are really worth a visit. And each one is very different from the other.
title: Beautiful church!

review_text: Connie did a great job organizing a private tour to 3 wineries as well as a spectacular lunch at Fuegos del Alpalta located within Viña Montes. The tour was a great way for us to learn and enjoy the wine of Colchagua Valley. Montgras, Maquis, and Neyen vineyards offered different experiences (Montgras - a beautiful tour and educational tasting, Maquis - a well rounded tasting of their portfolio, Neyen - a comparison of wine across 2 years. Additionally, Connie also arranged a 1/2 day tour with a tasting at Clos Apalta (amazing wines) and Viu Manent. Viu Manent offered a lovely carriage ride through the vineyard and quality tasting of their wines. Last but not least, Patricio was an amazing host and guide for both of these tours. We enjoyed his company and a great ambassador of the region.
title: A Great Private Tour for Wine Enthusiasts

review_text: This was a bucket list adventure for us and the experience did not disappoint. A professional service with delectable eats, champers and breathtaking views over the Atacama. The pilot was incredible and provided interesting commentary and history about the area. It was a pleasure to celebrate balloonings 250th anniversary!

review_text: Valparaiso is made up of numerous hills (some almost vertical!) which can be bad on the knees, so having this funicular is very practical! Cost only 100 pesos which is very economical! I liked the colourful tracks and the quaint feeling of riding this small funicular train :)

We really thank you for your visit and comments. Is always great to know when visitors enjoy their visit to our winery. We'll congratulate Denis for her work. We hope to receive you once again. Best regards, from Viña Maquis.

review_text: Michael was outstanding to work with booking this tour from 4 months before our meeting until the end of our tour. Our cruise ship switched disembarktion ports on us 2.5 months before our trip. Michael assured us that he would still drive 1.5 hours to pick us up. Michael was so informative about the Chilean history and culture. Not to mention that his linguistic skills are top notch with speaking many languages fluently. Our driver stayed in our van at all times to make sure our luggage was safe for 10 hours that day. It was assuring to know that we could enjoy our sightseeing through the colorful city of Valpraisio and all of our valuables would be safe. Michael shared many before pictures of the city in Valpraision to give us an idea of the changes that occured. We had lunch at a restaurant on the beach in Vina Del Mar. Next we stopped at a winery and enjoyed some of the red and white wines of Chile. Michael suggested that we just buy bottles of wine and share them at the winery. This way we would have bigger servings at a lower cost than the wine tastings. He acted as our Sommelier. It was so enjoyable for our group of 11 to sit at a table overlooking the grapevine fields, laughing, talking and sipping on wine. He dropped us all off safely at our hotels and the airport. Thanks Michael! You are the best tour guide ever in our history of tours.
title: Best Tour Guide and Tour in the history of Cruise Ship Excursions

review_text: The libreria del desierto is adjacent to the house of the owner, Diego, that together with Valentina and Sofia (their lovely 3-years daughter) lives there. The house and bookstore are no less than an architectural masterpieces, built one year ago in Solor, four km from San Pedro de Atacama. At night, when everything around is dark and the lights inside the house are lit up, the house looks like a starship that has just landed in the desert after having travelled through the amazing star-filled sky above. Outside, both the house and the bookstore are made of eco-friendly adobe. Diego has a degree in Philosophy and is not only the owner of the bookstore, but also a writer and editor. The bookstore is the only one within the radius of 100 KM. It might seem like a big (crazy :-) ) bet to open such a business in the desert, but Diego certainly won that bet, as I saw several customers during our six days stay in SPA. You can find the following topics in the bookstore: anthropology, archeology, ethnology, philosophy, history of Chile, kid's books, maps, etc etc Valentina and Diego will offer you a tea while you are choosing the best book for you. The view of the vulcano Licancabur and Juriques from the bookstore is magical, especially at sunset when they are colored in red

review_text: As others have mentioned, the view is simply gorgeous. All of the tourism buses stop here right before sunset, so there's usually a line to take your picture.
